वस्त्रेव भद्रा सुकृता वसूयू रथं न धीरः स्वपा अतक्षम्॥
verses.tr: indra brahma kriyamāṇā juṣasva yā te śaviṣṭha navyā akarma vastreva bhadrā sukṛtā vasūyū rathaṃ na dhīraḥ svapā atakṣam
verses.en: Indra, accept the prayers which now are offered, accept the new prayers, Mightiest! which we utter. Like fair and well-made robes, I, seeking riches, as a deft craftsman makes a car, have wrought them.

verses.sa:
क्व१ स्य वीरः को अपश्यदिन्द्रं सुखरथमीयमानं हरिभ्याम् ।
यो राया वज्री सुतसोममिच्छन् तदोको गन्ता पुरुहूत ऊती॥
verses.tr: kva1 sya vīraḥ ko apaśyadindraṃ sukharathamīyamānaṃ haribhyām yo rāyā vajrī sutasomamicchan tadoko gantā puruhūta ūtī
verses.en: Where is that Hero? Who hath looked on Indra borne on light-rolling car by Tawny Coursers, Who, Thunderer, seeks with wealth the Soma-presser, and to his house goes, much-invoked, to aid him?

verses.sa:
अवाचचक्षं पदमस्य सस्वरुग्रं निधातुरन्वायमिच्छन् ।
अपृच्छमन्याँ उत ते म आहुरिन्द्रं नरो बुबुधाना अशेम॥
verses.tr: avācacakṣaṃ padamasya sasvarugraṃ nidhāturanvāyamicchan apṛcchamanyāṃ uta te ma āhurindraṃ naro bubudhānā aśema
verses.en: I have beheld his strong and secret dwelling, longing have sought the Founder's habitation. I asked of others, and they said in answer, May we, awakened men, attain to Indra.

verses.sa:
प्र नु वयं सुते या ते कृतानीन्द्र ब्रवाम यानि नो जुजोषः ।
वेददविद्वाञ्छृणवच्च विद्वान् वहतेऽयं मघवा सर्वसेनः॥
verses.tr: pra nu vayaṃ sute yā te kṛtānīndra bravāma yāni no jujoṣaḥ vedadavidvāñchṛṇavacca vidvān vahate'yaṃ maghavā sarvasenaḥ
verses.en: We will tell, Indra, when we pour libation, what mighty deeds thou hast performed to please us. Let him who knows not learn, who knows them listen: hither rides Maghavan with all his army.

verses.sa:
स्थिरं मनश्चकृषे जात इन्द्र वेषीदेको युधये भूयसश्चित् ।
अश्मानं चिच्छवसा दिद्युतो वि विदो गवामूर्वमुस्रियाणाम्॥
verses.tr: sthiraṃ manaścakṛṣe jāta indra veṣīdeko yudhaye bhūyasaścit aśmānaṃ cicchavasā didyuto vi vido gavāmūrvamusriyāṇām
verses.en: Indra, when born, thou madest firm thy spirit: alone thou seekest war to fight with many. With might thou clavest e'en the rock asunder, and foundest out the stable of the Milch-kine.

verses.sa:
परो यत् त्वं परम आजनिष्ठाः परावति श्रुत्यं नाम बिभ्रत् ।
अतश्चिदिन्द्रादभयन्त देवा विश्वा अपो अजयद् दासपत्नीः॥
verses.tr: paro yat tvaṃ parama ājaniṣṭhāḥ parāvati śrutyaṃ nāma bibhrat ataścidindrādabhayanta devā viśvā apo ajayad dāsapatnīḥ
verses.en: When thou wast born supremest at a distance, bearing a name renowned in far-off regions, Since then e'en Gods have been afraid of Indra: he conquered all the floods which served the Dasa.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदेते मरुतः सुशेवा अर्चन्त्यर्कं सुन्वन्त्यन्धः ।
अहिमोहानमप आशयानं प्र मायाभिर्मायिनं सक्षदिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: tubhyedete marutaḥ suśevā arcantyarkaṃ sunvantyandhaḥ ahimohānamapa āśayānaṃ pra māyābhirmāyinaṃ sakṣadindraḥ
verses.en: These blissful Maruts sing their psalm to praise thee, and pour to thee libation of the Soma. Indra with wondrous powers subdued the Dragon, the guileful lurker who beset the waters.

verses.sa:
वि षू मृधो जनुषा दानमिन्वन्नहन् गवा मघवन् त्संचकानः ।
अत्रा दासस्य नमुचेः शिरो यदवर्तयो मनवे गातुमिच्छन्॥
verses.tr: vi ṣū mṛdho januṣā dānaminvannahan gavā maghavan tsaṃcakānaḥ atrā dāsasya namuceḥ śiro yadavartayo manave gātumicchan
verses.en: Thou, Maghavan, from the first didst scatter foemen, speeding, while joying in the milk, the Giver. There, seeking man's prosperity, thou torest away the head of Namuci the Dasa.

verses.sa:
युजं हि मामकृथा आदिदिन्द्र शिरो दासस्य नमुचेर्मथायन् ।
अश्मानं चित् स्वर्यं१ वर्तमानं प्र चक्रियेव रोदसी मरुद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: yujaṃ hi māmakṛthā ādidindra śiro dāsasya namucermathāyan aśmānaṃ cit svaryaṃ1 vartamānaṃ pra cakriyeva rodasī marudbhyaḥ
verses.en: Pounding the head of Namuci the Dasa, me, too thou madest thine associate, Indra! Yea, and the rolling stone that is in heaven both worlds, as on a car, brought to the Maruts.

verses.sa:
स्त्रियो हि दास आयुधानि चक्रे किं मा करन्नबला अस्य सेनाः ।
अन्तर्ह्यख्यदुभे अस्य धेने अथोप प्रैद्यु युधये दस्युमिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: striyo hi dāsa āyudhāni cakre kiṃ mā karannabalā asya senāḥ antarhyakhyadubhe asya dhene athopa praidyu yudhaye dasyumindraḥ
verses.en: Women for weapons hath the Dasa taken, What injury can his feeble armies To me? Well he distinguished his two different voices, and Indra then advanced to fight the Dasyu.

verses.sa:
समत्र गावोऽभितोऽनवन्तेहेह वत्सैर्वियुता यदासन् ।
सं ता इन्द्रो असृजदस्य शाकैर्यदीं सोमासः सुषुता अमन्दन्॥
verses.tr: samatra gāvo'bhito'navanteheha vatsairviyutā yadāsan saṃ tā indro asṛjadasya śākairyadīṃ somāsaḥ suṣutā amandan
verses.en: Divided from their calves the Cows went lowing around, on every side, hither and thither. These Indra re-united with his helpers, what time the well-pressed Soma made him joyful.

verses.sa:
यदीं सोमा बभ्रुधूता अमन्दन्नरोरवीद् वृषभः सादनेषु ।
पुरंदरः पपिवाँ इन्द्रो अस्य पुनर्गवामददादुस्रियाणाम्॥
verses.tr: yadīṃ somā babhrudhūtā amandannaroravīd vṛṣabhaḥ sādaneṣu puraṃdaraḥ papivāṃ indro asya punargavāmadadādusriyāṇām
verses.en: What time the Somas mixed by Babhru cheered him, loud the Steer bellowed in his habitations. So Indra drank thereof, the Fort-destroyer, and gave him guerdon, in return, of milch-kine.

verses.sa:
भद्रमिदं रुशमा अग्ने अक्रन् गवां चत्वारि ददतः सहस्रा ।
ऋणंचयस्य प्रयता मघानि प्रत्यग्रभीष्म नृतमस्य नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: bhadramidaṃ ruśamā agne akran gavāṃ catvāri dadataḥ sahasrā ṛṇaṃcayasya prayatā maghāni pratyagrabhīṣma nṛtamasya nṛṇām
verses.en: This good deed have the Rusamas done, Agni! that they have granted me four thousand cattle. We have received Rnancaya's wealth, of heroes the most heroic, which was freely offered.

verses.sa:
सुपेशसं माव सृजन्त्यस्तं गवां सहस्रै रुशमासो अग्ने ।
तीव्रा इन्द्रमममन्दुः सुतासोऽक्तोर्व्युष्टौ परितक्म्यायाः॥
verses.tr: supeśasaṃ māva sṛjantyastaṃ gavāṃ sahasrai ruśamāso agne tīvrā indramamamanduḥ sutāso'ktorvyuṣṭau paritakmyāyāḥ
verses.en: The Rusamas, O Agni, sent me homeward with fair adornment and with kine in thousands. The strong libations have made Indra joyful, when night, whose course was ending, changed to morning.

verses.sa:
औच्छत् सा रात्री परितक्म्या याँ ऋणंचये राजनि रुशमानाम् ।
अत्यो न वाजी रघुरज्यमानो बभ्रुश्चत्वार्यसनत् सहस्रा॥
verses.tr: aucchat sā rātrī paritakmyā yāṃ ṛṇaṃcaye rājani ruśamānām atyo na vājī raghurajyamāno babhruścatvāryasanat sahasrā
verses.en: Night, well-nigh ended, at Rnancaya's coming, King of the Rusamas, was changed to morning. Like a strong courser, fleet of foot, urged onward, Babhru hath gained four thousand as his guerdon.

verses.sa:
चतुःसहस्रं गव्यस्य पश्वः प्रत्यग्रभीष्म रुशमेष्वग्ने ।
घर्मश्चित् तप्तः प्रवृजे य आसीदयस्मयस्तम्वादाम विप्राः॥
verses.tr: catuḥsahasraṃ gavyasya paśvaḥ pratyagrabhīṣma ruśameṣvagne gharmaścit taptaḥ pravṛje ya āsīdayasmayastamvādāma viprāḥ
verses.en: We have received four thousand head of cattle presented by the Rusamas, O Agni. And we, the singers, have received the caldron of metal which was heated for Pravargya.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो रथाय प्रवतं कृणोति यमध्यस्थान्मघवा वाजयन्तम् ।
यूथेव पश्वो व्युनोति गोपा अरिष्टो याति प्रथमः सिषासन्॥
verses.tr: indro rathāya pravataṃ kṛṇoti yamadhyasthānmaghavā vājayantam yūtheva paśvo vyunoti gopā ariṣṭo yāti prathamaḥ siṣāsan
verses.en: Maghavan Indra turns his chariot downward, the strength-displaying car which he hath mounted. Even as a herdsman driveth forth his cattle, he goeth, first, uninjured, fain for treasure.

verses.sa:
आ प्र द्रव हरिवो मा वि वेनः पिशङ्गराते अभि नः सचस्व ।
नहि त्वदिन्द्र वस्यो अन्यदस्त्यमेनाँश्चिज्जनिवतश्चकर्थ॥
verses.tr: ā pra drava harivo mā vi venaḥ piśaṅgarāte abhi naḥ sacasva nahi tvadindra vasyo anyadastyamenāṃścijjanivataścakartha
verses.en: Haste to us, Lord of Bays; be not ungracious: visit us, lover of gold-hued oblation. There is naught else better than thou art, Indra: e'en to the wifeless hast thou given spouses.

verses.sa:
उद्यत् सहः सहस आजनिष्ट देदिष्ट इन्द्र इन्द्रियाणि विश्वा ।
प्राचोदयत् सुदुघा वव्रे अन्तर्वि ज्योतिषा संववृत्वत् तमोऽवः॥
verses.tr: udyat sahaḥ sahasa ājaniṣṭa dediṣṭa indra indriyāṇi viśvā prācodayat sudughā vavre antarvi jyotiṣā saṃvavṛtvat tamo'vaḥ
verses.en: When out of strength arose the strength that conquers, Indra displayed all powers that he possesses. Forth from the cave he drove the milky mothers, and with the light laid bare investing darkness.

verses.sa:
अनवस्ते रथमश्वाय तक्षन् त्वष्टा वज्रं पुरुहूत द्युमन्तम् ।
ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं महयन्तो अर्कैरवर्धयन्नहये हन्तवा उ॥
verses.tr: anavaste rathamaśvāya takṣan tvaṣṭā vajraṃ puruhūta dyumantam brahmāṇa indraṃ mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavā u
verses.en: Anus have wrought a chariot for thy Courser, and Tvastar, Much-invoked! thy bolt that glitters. The Brahmans with their songs exalting Indra increased his strength that he might slaughter Ahi.

verses.sa:
वृष्णे यत् ते वृषणो अर्कमर्चानिन्द्र ग्रावाणो अदितिः सजोषाः ।
अनश्वासो ये पवयोऽरथा इन्द्रेषिता अभ्यवर्तन्त दस्यून्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṇe yat te vṛṣaṇo arkamarcānindra grāvāṇo aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ anaśvāso ye pavayo'rathā indreṣitā abhyavartanta dasyūn
verses.en: When heroes sang their laud to thee the Hero, Indra! and stones and Aditi accordant, Without or steed or chariot were the fellies which, sped by Indra, rolled upon the Dasytis.

verses.sa:
प्र ते पूर्वाणि करणानि वोचं प्र नूतना मघवन् या चकर्थ ।
शक्तीवो यद् विभरा रोदसी उभे जयन्नपो मनवे दानुचित्राः॥
verses.tr: pra te pūrvāṇi karaṇāni vocaṃ pra nūtanā maghavan yā cakartha śaktīvo yad vibharā rodasī ubhe jayannapo manave dānucitrāḥ
verses.en: I will declare thine exploits wrought aforetime, and, Maghavan, thy deeds of late achievement, When, Lord of Might, thou sunderedst earth and heaven, winning for man the moistly-gleaming waters.

verses.sa:
तदिन्नु ते करणं दस्म विप्राऽहिं यद् घ्नन्नोजो अत्रामिमीथाः ।
शुष्णस्य चित् परि माया अगृभ्णाः प्रपित्वं यन्नप दस्यूँरसेधः॥
verses.tr: tadinnu te karaṇaṃ dasma viprā'hiṃ yad ghnannojo atrāmimīthāḥ śuṣṇasya cit pari māyā agṛbhṇāḥ prapitvaṃ yannapa dasyūṃrasedhaḥ
verses.en: This is thy deed, e'en this, Wonderful! Singer! that, slaying Ahi, here thy strength thou showedst, Didst check and stay e'en Susna's wiles and magic, and, drawing nigh, didst chase away the Dasytis.

verses.sa:
त्वमपो यदवे तुर्वशायाऽरमयः सुदुघाः पार इन्द्र ।
उग्रमयातमवहो ह कुत्सं सं ह यद् वामुशनारन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: tvamapo yadave turvaśāyā'ramayaḥ sudughāḥ pāra indra ugramayātamavaho ha kutsaṃ saṃ ha yad vāmuśanāranta devāḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indra, on the farther bank for Yadu and Turvaga didst stay the gushing waters. Ye both assailed the fierce: thou barest Kutsa: when Gods and Usana came to you together.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राकुत्सा वहमाना रथेनाऽऽ वामत्या अपि कर्णे वहन्तु ।
निः षीमद्भ्यो धमथो निः षधस्थान् मघोनो हृदो वरथस्तमांसि॥
verses.tr: indrākutsā vahamānā rathenā'' vāmatyā api karṇe vahantu niḥ ṣīmadbhyo dhamatho niḥ ṣadhasthān maghono hṛdo varathastamāṃsi
verses.en: Let the steeds bring you both, Indra and Kutsa, borne on the chariot within hearing-distance. Ye blew him from the waters, from his dwelling, and chased the darkness from the noble's spirit.

verses.sa:
वातस्य युक्तान् त्सुयुजश्चिदश्वान् कविश्चिदेषो अजगन्नवस्युः ।
विश्वे ते अत्र मरुतः सखाय इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि तविषीमवर्धन्॥
verses.tr: vātasya yuktān tsuyujaścidaśvān kaviścideṣo ajagannavasyuḥ viśve te atra marutaḥ sakhāya indra brahmāṇi taviṣīmavardhan
verses.en: Even this sage hath come looking for succour even to Vata's docile harnessed horses. Here are the Maruts, all, thy dear companions: prayers have increased thy power and might, O Indra.

verses.sa:
सूरश्चिद् रथं परितक्म्यायां पूर्वं करदुपरं जूजुवांसम् ।
भरच्चक्रमेतशः सं रिणाति पुरो दधत् सनिष्यति क्रतुं नः॥
verses.tr: sūraścid rathaṃ paritakmyāyāṃ pūrvaṃ karaduparaṃ jūjuvāṃsam bharaccakrametaśaḥ saṃ riṇāti puro dadhat saniṣyati kratuṃ naḥ
verses.en: When night was near its close he carried forward e'en the Sun's chariot backward in its running. Etaga brought his wheel and firmly stays it: setting it eastward he shall give us courage.

verses.sa:
आयं जना अभिचक्षे जगामेन्द्रः सखायं सुतसोममिच्छन् ।
वदन् ग्रावाव वेदिं भ्रियाते यस्य जीरमध्वर्यवश्चरन्ति॥
verses.tr: āyaṃ janā abhicakṣe jagāmendraḥ sakhāyaṃ sutasomamicchan vadan grāvāva vediṃ bhriyāte yasya jīramadhvaryavaścaranti
verses.en: This Indra, O ye men, hath come to see you, seeking a friend who hath expressed the Soma. The creaking stone is laid upon the altar, and the Adhvaryus come to turn it quickly.

verses.sa:
ये चाकनन्त चाकनन्त नू ते मर्ता अमृत मो ते अंह आरन् ।
वावन्धि यज्यूँरुत तेषु धेह्योजो जनेषु येषु ते स्याम॥
verses.tr: ye cākananta cākananta nū te martā amṛta mo te aṃha āran vāvandhi yajyūṃruta teṣu dhehyojo janeṣu yeṣu te syāma
verses.en: Let mortals who were happy still be happy; let them not come to sorrow, O Immortal. Love thou the pious, and to these thy people-with whom may we be numbered-give thou vigour.

verses.sa:
अदर्दरुत्समसृजो वि खानि त्वमर्णवान् बद्बधानाँ अरम्णाः ।
महान्तमिन्द्र पर्वतं वि यद् वः सृजो वि धारा अव दानवं हन्॥
verses.tr: adardarutsamasṛjo vi khāni tvamarṇavān badbadhānāṃ aramṇāḥ mahāntamindra parvataṃ vi yad vaḥ sṛjo vi dhārā ava dānavaṃ han
verses.en: 1.THE well thou clavest, settest free the fountains, and gavest rest to floods that were obstructed. Thou, Indra, laying the great mountain open, slaying the Danava, didst loose the torrents.

verses.sa:
त्वमुत्साँ ऋतुभिर्बद्बधानाँ अरंह ऊधः पर्वतस्य वज्रिन् ।
अहिं चिदुग्र प्रयुतं शयानं जघन्वाँ इन्द्र तविषीमधत्थाः॥
verses.tr: tvamutsāṃ ṛtubhirbadbadhānāṃ araṃha ūdhaḥ parvatasya vajrin ahiṃ cidugra prayutaṃ śayānaṃ jaghanvāṃ indra taviṣīmadhatthāḥ
verses.en: The fountain-depths obstructed in their seasons, thou, Thunderer! madest flow, the mountain's udder. Strong Indra, thou by slaying e'en the Dragon that lay extended there hast shown thy vigour.

verses.sa:
त्यस्य चिन्महतो निर्मृगस्य वधर्जघान तविषीभिरिन्द्रः ।
य एक इदप्रतिर्मन्यमान आदस्मादन्यो अजनिष्ट तव्यान्॥
verses.tr: tyasya cinmahato nirmṛgasya vadharjaghāna taviṣībhirindraḥ ya eka idapratirmanyamāna ādasmādanyo ajaniṣṭa tavyān
verses.en: Indra with violence smote down the weapon, yea, even of that wild and mighty creature. Although he deemed himself alone unequalled, another had been born e'en yet more potent.

verses.sa:
त्यं चिदेषां स्वधया मदन्तं मिहो नपातं सुवृधं तमोगाम् ।
वृषप्रभर्मा दानवस्य भामं वज्रेण वज्री नि जघान शुष्णम्॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ cideṣāṃ svadhayā madantaṃ miho napātaṃ suvṛdhaṃ tamogām vṛṣaprabharmā dānavasya bhāmaṃ vajreṇa vajrī ni jaghāna śuṣṇam
verses.en: Him, whom the heavenly food of these delighted, child of the mist, strong waxing, couched in darkness, Him the bolt-hurling Thunderer with his lightning smote down and slew, the Danava's wrath-fire, Susna.

verses.sa:
त्यं चिदस्य क्रतुभिर्निषत्तममर्मणो विददिदस्य मर्म ।
यदीं सुक्षत्र प्रभृता मदस्य युयुत्सन्तं तमसि हर्म्ये धाः॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ cidasya kratubhirniṣattamamarmaṇo vidadidasya marma yadīṃ sukṣatra prabhṛtā madasya yuyutsantaṃ tamasi harmye dhāḥ
verses.en: Though he might ne'er be wounded still his vitals felt that, the God's bolt, which his powers supported, When, after offered draughts, Strong Lord, thou laidest him, fain to battle, in the pit in darkness.

verses.sa:
त्यं चिदित्था कत्पयं शयानमसूर्ये तमसि वावृधानम् ।
तं चिन्मन्दानो वृषभः सुतस्योच्चैरिन्द्रो अपगूर्या जघान॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ ciditthā katpayaṃ śayānamasūrye tamasi vāvṛdhānam taṃ cinmandāno vṛṣabhaḥ sutasyoccairindro apagūryā jaghāna
verses.en: Him as he lay there huge in length extended, still waxing in the gloom which no sun lightened, Him, after loud-voiced threats, the Hero Indra, rejoicing in the poured libation, slaughtered.

verses.sa:
उद् यदिन्द्रो महते दानवाय वधर्यमिष्ट सहो अप्रतीतम् ।
यदीं वज्रस्य प्रभृतौ ददाभ विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमं चकार॥
verses.tr: ud yadindro mahate dānavāya vadharyamiṣṭa saho apratītam yadīṃ vajrasya prabhṛtau dadābha viśvasya jantoradhamaṃ cakāra
verses.en: When 'gainst the mighty Danava his weapon Indra uplifted, power which none could combat, When at the hurling of his bolt he smote him, he made him lower than all living creatures.

verses.sa:
त्यं चिदर्णं मधुपं शयानमसिन्वं वव्रं मह्याददुग्रः ।
अपादमत्रं महता वधेन नि दुर्योण आवृणङ् मृध्रवाचम्॥
verses.tr: tyaṃ cidarṇaṃ madhupaṃ śayānamasinvaṃ vavraṃ mahyādadugraḥ apādamatraṃ mahatā vadhena ni duryoṇa āvṛṇaṅ mṛdhravācam
verses.en: The fierce God seized that huge and restless coiler, insatiate, drinker of the sweets, recumbent, And with his mighty weapon in his dwelling smote down the footless evil-speaking ogre.

verses.sa:
को अस्य शुष्मं तविषीं वरात एको धना भरते अप्रतीतः ।
इमे चिदस्य ज्रयसो नु देवी इन्द्रस्यौजसो भियसा जिहाते॥
verses.tr: ko asya śuṣmaṃ taviṣīṃ varāta eko dhanā bharate apratītaḥ ime cidasya jrayaso nu devī indrasyaujaso bhiyasā jihāte
verses.en: Who may arrest his strength or cheek his vigour? Alone, resistless, he bears off all riches. Even these Twain, these Goddesses, through terror of Indra's might, retire from his dominion.

verses.sa:
न्यस्मै देवी स्वधितिर्जिहीत इन्द्राय गातुरुशतीव येमे ।
सं यदोजो युवते विश्वमाभिरनु स्वधाव्ने क्षितयो नमन्त॥
verses.tr: nyasmai devī svadhitirjihīta indrāya gāturuśatīva yeme saṃ yadojo yuvate viśvamābhiranu svadhāvne kṣitayo namanta
verses.en: E'en the Celestial Axe bows down before him, and the Earth, lover-like, gives way to Indra. As he imparts all vigour to these people, straightway the folk bend them to him the Godlike.

verses.sa:
एकं नु त्वा सत्पतिं पाञ्चजन्यं जातं शृणोमि यशसं जनेषु ।
तं मे जगृभ्र आशसो नविष्ठं दोषा वस्तोर्हवमानास इन्द्रम्॥
verses.tr: ekaṃ nu tvā satpatiṃ pāñcajanyaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇomi yaśasaṃ janeṣu taṃ me jagṛbhra āśaso naviṣṭhaṃ doṣā vastorhavamānāsa indram
verses.en: I hear that thou wast born sole Lord of heroes of the Five Races, famed among the people. As such my wishes have most lately grasped him, invoking Indra both at eve and morning.

verses.sa:
एवा हि त्वामृतुथा यातयन्तं मघा विप्रेभ्यो ददतं शृणोमि ।
किं ते ब्रह्माणो गृहते सखायो ये त्वाया निदधुः काममिन्द्र॥
verses.tr: evā hi tvāmṛtuthā yātayantaṃ maghā viprebhyo dadataṃ śṛṇomi kiṃ te brahmāṇo gṛhate sakhāyo ye tvāyā nidadhuḥ kāmamindra
verses.en: So, too, I hear of thee as in due season urging to action and enriching singers. What have thy friends received from thee, the Brahmans who, faithful, rest their hopes on thee, O Indra?

verses.sa:
महि महे तवसे दीध्ये नॄनिन्द्रायेत्था तवसे अतव्यान् ।
यो अस्मै सुमतिं वाजसातौ स्तुतो जने समर्यश्चिकेत॥
verses.tr: mahi mahe tavase dīdhye nṝnindrāyetthā tavase atavyān yo asmai sumatiṃ vājasātau stuto jane samaryaściketa
verses.en: Great praise to Indra, great and strong mid heroes, I ponder thus, the feeble to the Mighty, Who with his band shows favour to this people, when lauded, in the fight where spoil is gathered.

verses.sa:
स त्वं न इन्द्र धियसानो अर्कैर्हरीणां वृषन् योक्त्रमश्रेः ।
या इत्था मघवन्ननु जोषं वक्षो अभि प्रार्यः सक्षि जनान्॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ na indra dhiyasāno arkairharīṇāṃ vṛṣan yoktramaśreḥ yā itthā maghavannanu joṣaṃ vakṣo abhi prāryaḥ sakṣi janān
verses.en: So made attentive by our hymns, Steer! Indra! thou fastenedst the girth of thy Bay Coursers, Which, Maghavan, at thy will thou drivest hither. With these subdue for us the men who hate us.

verses.sa:
न ते त इन्द्राभ्य१स्मदृष्वाऽयुक्तासो अब्रह्मता यदसन् ।
तिष्ठा रथमधि तं वज्रहस्ताऽऽ रश्मिं देव यमसे स्वश्वः॥
verses.tr: na te ta indrābhya1smadṛṣvā'yuktāso abrahmatā yadasan tiṣṭhā rathamadhi taṃ vajrahastā'' raśmiṃ deva yamase svaśvaḥ
verses.en: They were not turned to us-ward, lofty Indra! while yet through lack of prayer they stood unharnessed. Ascend this chariot, thou whose hand wields thunder, and draw the rein, O Lord of noble horses.

verses.sa:
पुरू यत् त इन्द्र सन्त्युक्था गवे चकर्थोर्वरासु युध्यन् ।
ततक्षे सूर्याय चिदोकसि स्वे वृषा समत्सु दासस्य नाम चित्॥
verses.tr: purū yat ta indra santyukthā gave cakarthorvarāsu yudhyan tatakṣe sūryāya cidokasi sve vṛṣā samatsu dāsasya nāma cit
verses.en: Thou, because many lauds are thine, O Indra, wast active warring in the fields for cattle. For Surya in his own abode thou, Hero, formedst in fights even a Dasa's nature.

verses.sa:
वयं ते त इन्द्र ये च नरः शर्धो जज्ञाना याताश्च रथाः ।
आस्माञ्जगम्यादहिशुष्म सत्वा भगो न हव्यः प्रभृथेषु चारुः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ te ta indra ye ca naraḥ śardho jajñānā yātāśca rathāḥ āsmāñjagamyādahiśuṣma satvā bhago na havyaḥ prabhṛtheṣu cāruḥ
verses.en: Thine are we, Indra; thine are all these people, conscious of might, whose cars are set in motion. Some hero come to us, O Strong as Ahi beauteous in war, to be invoked like Bhaga.

verses.sa:
पपृक्षेण्यमिन्द्र त्वे ह्योजो नृम्णानि च नृतमानो अमर्तः ।
स न एनीं वसवानो रयिं दाः प्रार्यः स्तुषे तुविमघस्य दानम्॥
verses.tr: papṛkṣeṇyamindra tve hyojo nṛmṇāni ca nṛtamāno amartaḥ sa na enīṃ vasavāno rayiṃ dāḥ prāryaḥ stuṣe tuvimaghasya dānam
verses.en: Strength much to be desired is in thee, Indra: the Immortal dances forth his hero exploits. Such, Lord of Treasure, give us splendid riches. I praise the Friend's gift, his whose wealth is mighty.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्द्रोतिभिरव पाहि गृणतः शूर कारून् ।
उत त्वचं ददतो वाजसातौ पिप्रीहि मध्वः सुषुतस्य चारोः॥
verses.tr: evā na indrotibhirava pāhi gṛṇataḥ śūra kārūn uta tvacaṃ dadato vājasātau piprīhi madhvaḥ suṣutasya cāroḥ
verses.en: Thus favour us, O Indra, with thy succour; Hero, protect the bards who sing thy praises. Be friendly in the fray to those who offer the skin of beautiful and well-pressed Soma.

verses.sa:
उत त्ये मा पौरुकुत्स्यस्य सूरेस्त्रसदस्योर्हिरणिनो रराणाः ।
वहन्तु मा दश श्येतासो अस्य गैरिक्षितस्य क्रतुभिर्नु सश्चे॥
verses.tr: uta tye mā paurukutsyasya sūrestrasadasyorhiraṇino rarāṇāḥ vahantu mā daśa śyetāso asya gairikṣitasya kratubhirnu saśce
verses.en: And these ten steeds which Trasadasyu gives me, the gold rich chief, the son of Purukutsa, Resplendent in their brightness shall convey me. Gairiksita willed it and so came I hither.

verses.sa:
उत त्ये मा मारुताश्वस्य शोणाः क्रत्वामघासो विदथस्य रातौ ।
सहस्रा मे च्यवतानो ददान आनूकमर्यो वपुषे नार्चत्॥
verses.tr: uta tye mā mārutāśvasya śoṇāḥ kratvāmaghāso vidathasya rātau sahasrā me cyavatāno dadāna ānūkamaryo vapuṣe nārcat
verses.en: And these, bestowed as sacrificial guerdon, the powerful tawny steeds of Marutasva; And thousands which kind Cyavatana gave me, abundantly bestowed for my adornment.

verses.sa:
उत त्ये मा ध्वन्यस्य जुष्टा लक्ष्मण्यस्य सुरुचो यतानाः ।
मह्ना रायः संवरणस्य ऋषेर्व्रजं न गावः प्रयता अपि ग्मन्॥
verses.tr: uta tye mā dhvanyasya juṣṭā lakṣmaṇyasya suruco yatānāḥ mahnā rāyaḥ saṃvaraṇasya ṛṣervrajaṃ na gāvaḥ prayatā api gman
verses.en: And these commended horses, bright and active, by Dhvanya son of Laksmana presented, Came unto me, as cows into the Rsi Samvarana's stall, with magnitude of riches.

verses.sa:
अजातशत्रुमजरा स्वर्वत्यनु स्वधामिता दस्ममीयते ।
सुनोतन पचत ब्रह्मवाहसे पुरुष्टुताय प्रतरं दधातन॥
verses.tr: ajātaśatrumajarā svarvatyanu svadhāmitā dasmamīyate sunotana pacata brahmavāhase puruṣṭutāya prataraṃ dadhātana
verses.en: Boundless and wasting not, the heavenly food of Gods goes to the foeless One, doer of wondrous deeds. Press out, make ready, offer gifts with special zeal to him whom many laud, accepter of the prayer.

verses.sa:
आ यः सोमेन जठरमपिप्रताऽमन्दत मघवा मध्वो अन्धसः ।
यदीं मृगाय हन्तवे महावधः सहस्रभृष्टिमुशना वधं यमत्॥
verses.tr: ā yaḥ somena jaṭharamapipratā'mandata maghavā madhvo andhasaḥ yadīṃ mṛgāya hantave mahāvadhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭimuśanā vadhaṃ yamat
verses.en: He who filled full his belly with the Soma's juice, Maghavan, was delighted with the meath's sweet draught, When Usana, that he might slay the monstrous beast, gave him the mighty weapon with a thousand points.

verses.sa:
यो अस्मै घ्रंस उत वा य ऊधनि सोमं सुनोति भवति द्युमाँ अह ।
अपाप शक्रस्ततनुष्टिमूहति तनूशुभ्रं मघवा यः कवासखः॥
verses.tr: yo asmai ghraṃsa uta vā ya ūdhani somaṃ sunoti bhavati dyumāṃ aha apāpa śakrastatanuṣṭimūhati tanūśubhraṃ maghavā yaḥ kavāsakhaḥ
verses.en: Illustrious is the man whoever presseth out Soma for him in sunshine or in cloud and rain. The mighty Maghavan who is the sage's Friend advanceth more and more his beauteous progeny.

verses.sa:
यस्यावधीत् पितरं यस्य मातरं यस्य शक्रो भ्रातरं नात ईषते ।
वेतीद्वस्य प्रयता यतंकरो न किल्बिषादीषते वस्व आकरः॥
verses.tr: yasyāvadhīt pitaraṃ yasya mātaraṃ yasya śakro bhrātaraṃ nāta īṣate vetīdvasya prayatā yataṃkaro na kilbiṣādīṣate vasva ākaraḥ
verses.en: The Strong God doth not flee away from him whose sire, whose mother or whose brother he hath done to death. He, the Avenger, seeketh this man's offered gifts: this God, the source of riches, doth not flee from sin.

verses.sa:
न पञ्चभिर्दशभिर्वष्ट्यारभं नासुन्वता सचते पुष्यता चन ।
जिनाति वेदमुया हन्ति वा धुनिरा देवयुं भजति गोमति व्रजे॥
verses.tr: na pañcabhirdaśabhirvaṣṭyārabhaṃ nāsunvatā sacate puṣyatā cana jināti vedamuyā hanti vā dhunirā devayuṃ bhajati gomati vraje
verses.en: He seeks no enterprise with five or ten to aid, nor stays with him who pours no juice though prospering well. The Shaker conquers or slays in this way or that, and to the pious gives a stable full of kine.

verses.sa:
वित्वक्षणः समृतौ चक्रमासजोऽसुन्वतो विषुणः सुन्वतो वृधः ।
इन्द्रो विश्वस्य दमिता विभीषणो यथावशं नयति दासमार्यः॥
verses.tr: vitvakṣaṇaḥ samṛtau cakramāsajo'sunvato viṣuṇaḥ sunvato vṛdhaḥ indro viśvasya damitā vibhīṣaṇo yathāvaśaṃ nayati dāsamāryaḥ
verses.en: Exceeding strong in war he stays the chariot wheel, and, hating him who pours not, prospers him who pours. Indra the terrible, tamer of every man, as Arya leads away the Dasa at his will.

verses.sa:
समीं पणेरजति भोजनं मुषे वि दाशुषे भजति सूनरं वसु ।
दुर्गे चन ध्रियते विश्व आ पुरु जनो यो अस्य तविषीमचुक्रुधत्॥
verses.tr: samīṃ paṇerajati bhojanaṃ muṣe vi dāśuṣe bhajati sūnaraṃ vasu durge cana dhriyate viśva ā puru jano yo asya taviṣīmacukrudhat
verses.en: He gathers up for plunder all the niggards gear: excellent wealth he gives to him who offers gifts. Not even in wide stronghold may all the folk stand firm who have provoked to anger his surpassing might.

verses.sa:
सं यज्जनौ सुधनौ विश्वशर्धसाववेदिन्द्रो मघवा गोषु शुभ्रिषु ।
युजं ह्य१न्यमकृत प्रवेपन्युदीं गव्यं सृजते सत्वभिर्धुनिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ yajjanau sudhanau viśvaśardhasāvavedindro maghavā goṣu śubhriṣu yujaṃ hya1nyamakṛta pravepanyudīṃ gavyaṃ sṛjate satvabhirdhuniḥ
verses.en: When Indra Maghavan hath marked two wealthy men fighting for beauteous cows with all their followers, He who stirs all things takes one as his close ally, and, Shaker, with his Heroes, sends the kine to him.

verses.sa:
सहस्रसामाग्निवेशिं गृणीषे शत्रिमग्न उपमां केतुमर्यः ।
तस्मा आपः संयतः पीपयन्त तस्मिन् क्षत्रममवत् त्वेषमस्तु॥
verses.tr: sahasrasāmāgniveśiṃ gṛṇīṣe śatrimagna upamāṃ ketumaryaḥ tasmā āpaḥ saṃyataḥ pīpayanta tasmin kṣatramamavat tveṣamastu
verses.en: Agni! I laud the liberal Agnivesi, Satri the type and standard of the pious. May the collected waters yield him plenty, and his be powerful and bright dominion.

verses.sa:
यस्ते साधिष्ठोऽवस इन्द्र क्रतुष्टमा भर ।
अस्मभ्यं चर्षणीसहं सस्निं वाजेषु दुष्टरम्॥
verses.tr: yaste sādhiṣṭho'vasa indra kratuṣṭamā bhara asmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahaṃ sasniṃ vājeṣu duṣṭaram
verses.en: Indra, for our assistance bring that most effectual power of thine, Which conquers men for us, and wins the spoil, invincible in fight.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र ते चतस्रो यच्छूर सन्ति तिस्रः ।
यद् वा पञ्च क्षितीनामवस्तत् सु न आ भर॥
verses.tr: yadindra te catasro yacchūra santi tisraḥ yad vā pañca kṣitīnāmavastat su na ā bhara
verses.en: Indra, whatever aids be thine, four be they, or, O Hero, three, Or those of the Five Tribes of men, bring quickly all that help to us.

verses.sa:
आ तेऽवो वरेण्यं वृषन्तमस्य हूमहे ।
वृषजूतिर्हि जज्ञिष आभूभिरिन्द्र तुर्वणिः॥
verses.tr: ā te'vo vareṇyaṃ vṛṣantamasya hūmahe vṛṣajūtirhi jajñiṣa ābhūbhirindra turvaṇiḥ
verses.en: The aid most excellent of thee the Mightiest hitherward we call, For thou wast born with hero might, conquering, Indra, with the Strong.

verses.sa:
वृषा ह्यसि राधसे जज्ञिषे वृष्णि ते शवः ।
स्वक्षत्रं ते धृषन्मनः सत्राहमिन्द्र पौंस्यम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā hyasi rādhase jajñiṣe vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ svakṣatraṃ te dhṛṣanmanaḥ satrāhamindra pauṃsyam
verses.en: Mighty to prosper us wast thou born, and mighty is the strength thou hast. In native power thy soul is firm: thy valour, Indra, slays a host.

verses.sa:
त्वं तमिन्द्र मर्त्यममित्रयन्तमद्रिवः ।
सर्वरथा शतक्रतो नि याहि शवसस्पते॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tamindra martyamamitrayantamadrivaḥ sarvarathā śatakrato ni yāhi śavasaspate
verses.en: O Satakratu, Lord of Strength, O Indra, Caster of the Stone. With all thy chariot's force assail the man who shows himself thy foe.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद् वृत्रहन्तम जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
उग्रं पूर्वीषु पूर्व्यं हवन्ते वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: tvāmid vṛtrahantama janāso vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ugraṃ pūrvīṣu pūrvyaṃ havante vājasātaye
verses.en: For, Mightiest Vrtra-slayer, thee, fierce, foremost among many, folk Whose sacred grass is trimmed invite to battle where the spoil is won.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्र दुष्टरं पुरोयावानमाजिषु ।
सयावानं धनेधने वाजयन्तमवा रथम्॥
verses.tr: asmākamindra duṣṭaraṃ puroyāvānamājiṣu sayāvānaṃ dhanedhane vājayantamavā ratham
verses.en: Indra, do thou protect our car that mingles foremost in the fights, That bears its part in every fray, invincible and seeking spoil.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रेहि नो रथमवा पुरंध्या ।
वयं शविष्ठ वार्यं दिवि श्रवो दधीमहि दिवि स्तोमं मनामहे॥
verses.tr: asmākamindrehi no rathamavā puraṃdhyā vayaṃ śaviṣṭha vāryaṃ divi śravo dadhīmahi divi stomaṃ manāmahe
verses.en: Come to us, Indra, and protect our car with thine intelligence. May we, O Mightiest One, obtain excellent fame at break of day, and meditate our hymn at dawn.

verses.sa:
स आ गमदिन्द्रो यो वसूनां चिकेतद् दातुं दामनो रयीणाम् ।
धन्वचरो न वंसगस्तृषाणश्चकमानः पिबतु दुग्धमंशुम्॥
verses.tr: sa ā gamadindro yo vasūnāṃ ciketad dātuṃ dāmano rayīṇām dhanvacaro na vaṃsagastṛṣāṇaścakamānaḥ pibatu dugdhamaṃśum
verses.en: May Indra come to us, he who knows rightly to give forth treasures from his store of riches. Even as a thirsty steer who roams the deserts may he drink eagerly the milked-out Soma.

verses.sa:
आ ते हनू हरिवः शूर शिप्रे रुहत् सोमो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठे ।
अनु त्वा राजन्नर्वतो न हिन्वन् गीर्भिर्मदेम पुरुहूत विश्वे॥
verses.tr: ā te hanū harivaḥ śūra śipre ruhat somo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhe anu tvā rājannarvato na hinvan gīrbhirmadema puruhūta viśve
verses.en: Lord of Bay Horses, Hero, may the Soma rise to thy cheeks and jaws like mountain-ridges. May we, O King, as he who driveth coursers, all joy in thee with hymns, invoked of many!

verses.sa:
चक्रं न वृत्तं पुरुहूत वेपते मनो भिया मे अमतेरिदद्रिवः ।
रथादधि त्वा जरिता सदावृध कुविन्नु स्तोषन्मघवन् पुरूवसुः॥
verses.tr: cakraṃ na vṛttaṃ puruhūta vepate mano bhiyā me amateridadrivaḥ rathādadhi tvā jaritā sadāvṛdha kuvinnu stoṣanmaghavan purūvasuḥ
verses.en: Invoked of many, Caster of the Stone my heart quakes like a rolling wheel for fear of penury. Shall not Puruvasu the singer give thee praise, O ever-prospering Maghavan, mounted on thy car?

verses.sa:
एष ग्रावेव जरिता त इन्द्रेयर्ति वाचं बृहदाशुषाणः ।
प्र सव्येन मघवन् यंसि रायः प्र दक्षिणिद्धरिवो मा वि वेनः॥
verses.tr: eṣa grāveva jaritā ta indreyarti vācaṃ bṛhadāśuṣāṇaḥ pra savyena maghavan yaṃsi rāyaḥ pra dakṣiṇiddharivo mā vi venaḥ
verses.en: Like the press-stone is this thy praiser, Indra. Loudly he lifts his voice with strong endeavour. With thy left hand, O Maghavan, give us riches: with thy right, Lord of Bays, be not reluctant.

verses.sa:
वृषा त्वा वृषणं वर्धतु द्यौर्वृषा वृषभ्यां वहसे हरिभ्याम् ।
स नो वृषा वृषरथः सुशिप्र वृषक्रतो वृषा वज्रिन् भरे धाः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhatu dyaurvṛṣā vṛṣabhyāṃ vahase haribhyām sa no vṛṣā vṛṣarathaḥ suśipra vṛṣakrato vṛṣā vajrin bhare dhāḥ
verses.en: May the strong Heaven make thee the Strong wax stronger: Strong, thou art borne by thy two strong Bay Horses. So, fair of cheek, with mighty chariot, mighty, uphold us, strong-willed, thunder armed, in battle.

verses.sa:
यो रोहितौ वाजिनौ वाजिनीवान् त्रिभिः शतैः सचमानावदिष्ट ।
यूने समस्मै क्षितयो नमन्तां श्रुतरथाय मरुतो दुवोया॥
verses.tr: yo rohitau vājinau vājinīvān tribhiḥ śataiḥ sacamānāvadiṣṭa yūne samasmai kṣitayo namantāṃ śrutarathāya maruto duvoyā
verses.en: Maruts, let all the people in obeisance bow down before this youthful Srutaratha, Who, rich in steeds, gave me two dark red horses together with three hundred head of cattle.

verses.sa:
सं भानुना यतते सूर्यस्याऽऽजुह्वानो घृतपृष्ठः स्वञ्चाः ।
तस्मा अमृध्रा उषसो व्युच्छान् य इन्द्राय सुनवामेत्याह॥
verses.tr: saṃ bhānunā yatate sūryasyā''juhvāno ghṛtapṛṣṭhaḥ svañcāḥ tasmā amṛdhrā uṣaso vyucchān ya indrāya sunavāmetyāha
verses.en: Bedewed with holy oil and meetly worshipped, the Swift One vies with Surya's beam in splendour. For him may mornings dawn without cessation who saith, Let us press Soma out for Indra.

verses.sa:
समिद्धाग्निर्वनवत् स्तीर्णबर्हिर्युक्तग्रावा सुतसोमो जराते ।
ग्रावाणो यस्येषिरं वदन्त्ययदध्वर्युर्हविषाव सिन्धुम्॥
verses.tr: samiddhāgnirvanavat stīrṇabarhiryuktagrāvā sutasomo jarāte grāvāṇo yasyeṣiraṃ vadantyayadadhvaryurhaviṣāva sindhum
verses.en: With kindled fire and strewn grass let him worship, and, Soma-presser, sing with stones adjusted: And let the priest whose press-stones ring forth loudly, go down with his oblation to the river.

verses.sa:
वधूरियं पतिमिच्छन्त्येति य ईं वहाते महिषीमिषिराम् ।
आस्य श्रवस्याद् रथ आ च घोषात् पुरू सहस्रा परि वर्तयाते॥
verses.tr: vadhūriyaṃ patimicchantyeti ya īṃ vahāte mahiṣīmiṣirām āsya śravasyād ratha ā ca ghoṣāt purū sahasrā pari vartayāte
verses.en: This wife is coming near who loves her husband who carries to his home a vigorous consort. Here may his car seek fame, here loudly thunder, and his wheel make a thousand revolutions.

verses.sa:
न स राजा व्यथते यस्मिन्निन्द्रस्तीव्रं सोमं पिबति गोसखायम् ।
आ सत्वनैरजति हन्ति वृत्रं क्षेति क्षितीः सुभगो नाम पुष्यन्॥
verses.tr: na sa rājā vyathate yasminnindrastīvraṃ somaṃ pibati gosakhāyam ā satvanairajati hanti vṛtraṃ kṣeti kṣitīḥ subhago nāma puṣyan
verses.en: No troubles vex that King in whose home Indra drinks the sharp Soma juice with milk commingled. With heroes he drives near, he slays the foeman: Blest, cherishing that name, he guards his people.

verses.sa:
पुष्यात् क्षेमे अभि योगे भवात्युभे वृतौ संयती सं जयाति ।
प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवाति य इन्द्राय सुतसोमो ददाशत्॥
verses.tr: puṣyāt kṣeme abhi yoge bhavātyubhe vṛtau saṃyatī saṃ jayāti priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavāti ya indrāya sutasomo dadāśat
verses.en: May he support in peace and win in battle: he masters both the hosts that meet together. Dear shall he be to Surya, dear to Agni, who with pressed Soma offers gifts to India.

verses.sa:
उरोष्ट इन्द्र राधसो विभ्वी रातिः शतक्रतो ।
अधा नो विश्वचर्षणे द्युम्ना सुक्षत्र मंहय॥
verses.tr: uroṣṭa indra rādhaso vibhvī rātiḥ śatakrato adhā no viśvacarṣaṇe dyumnā sukṣatra maṃhaya
verses.en: Wide, Indra Satakratu, spreads the bounty of thine ample grace: So, Lord of fair dominion, Friend of all men, give us splendid wealth.

verses.sa:
यदीमिन्द्र श्रवाय्यमिषं शविष्ठ दधिषे ।
पप्रथे दीर्घश्रुत्तमं हिरण्यवर्ण दुष्टरम्॥
verses.tr: yadīmindra śravāyyamiṣaṃ śaviṣṭha dadhiṣe paprathe dīrghaśruttamaṃ hiraṇyavarṇa duṣṭaram
verses.en: The food which, Mightiest Indra, thou possessest worthy of renown Is bruited as most widely famed, invincible, O Golden-hued!

verses.sa:
शुष्मासो ये ते अद्रिवो मेहना केतसापः ।
उभा देवावभिष्टये दिवश्च ग्मश्च राजथः॥
verses.tr: śuṣmāso ye te adrivo mehanā ketasāpaḥ ubhā devāvabhiṣṭaye divaśca gmaśca rājathaḥ
verses.en: O Darter of the Stone, the powers which readily obey thy will,- Divinities, both thou and they, ye rule, to guard them, earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
उतो नो अस्य कस्य चिद् दक्षस्य तव वृत्रहन् ।
अस्मभ्यं नृम्णमा भराऽस्मभ्यं नृमणस्यसे॥
verses.tr: uto no asya kasya cid dakṣasya tava vṛtrahan asmabhyaṃ nṛmṇamā bharā'smabhyaṃ nṛmaṇasyase
verses.en: And from whatever power of thine, O Vrtra-slayer, it may be, Bring thou to us heroic strength: thou hast a man's regard for us.

verses.sa:
नू त आभिरभिष्टिभिस्तव शर्मञ्छतक्रतो ।
इन्द्र स्याम सुगोपाः शूर स्याम सुगोपाः॥
verses.tr: nū ta ābhirabhiṣṭibhistava śarmañchatakrato indra syāma sugopāḥ śūra syāma sugopāḥ
verses.en: In thy protection, with these aids of thine, O Lord of Hundred Powers, Indra, may we be guarded well, Hero, may we be guarded well.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र चित्र मेहनास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः ।
राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर॥
verses.tr: yadindra citra mehanāsti tvādātamadrivaḥ rādhastanno vidadvasa ubhayāhastyā bhara
verses.en: Stone-DARTING Indra. Wondrous One, what wealth is richly given from thee, That bounty, Treasure-Finder! bring filling both thy hands, to us.

verses.sa:
यन्मन्यसे वरेण्यमिन्द्र द्युक्षं तदा भर ।
विद्याम तस्य ते वयमकूपारस्य दावने॥
verses.tr: yanmanyase vareṇyamindra dyukṣaṃ tadā bhara vidyāma tasya te vayamakūpārasya dāvane
verses.en: Bring what thou deemest worth the wish, O Indra, that which is in heaven. So may we know thee as thou art, boundless in thy munificence.

verses.sa:
यत् ते दित्सु प्रराध्यं मनो अस्ति श्रुतं बृहत् ।
तेन दृळहा चिदद्रिव आ वाजं दर्षि सातये॥
verses.tr: yat te ditsu prarādhyaṃ mano asti śrutaṃ bṛhat tena dṛḻahā cidadriva ā vājaṃ darṣi sātaye
verses.en: Thy lofty spirit, far-renowned as fain to give and prompt to win,- With this thou rendest e'en the firm, Stone-Darter! so to gain thee strength.

verses.sa:
मंहिष्ठं वो मघोनां राजानं चर्षणीनाम् ।
इन्द्रमुप प्रशस्तये पूर्वीभिर्जुजुषे गिरः॥
verses.tr: maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vo maghonāṃ rājānaṃ carṣaṇīnām indramupa praśastaye pūrvībhirjujuṣe giraḥ
verses.en: Singers with many songs have made Indra propitious to their fame, Him who is King of human kind, most liberal of your wealthy ones.

verses.sa:
अस्मा इत् काव्यं वच उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यम् ।
तस्मा उ ब्रह्मवाहसे गिरो वर्धन्त्यत्रयो गिरः शुम्भन्त्यत्रयः॥
verses.tr: asmā it kāvyaṃ vaca ukthamindrāya śaṃsyam tasmā u brahmavāhase giro vardhantyatrayo giraḥ śumbhantyatrayaḥ
verses.en: To him, to Indra must be sung the poet's word, the hymn of praise. To him, accepter of the prayer, the Atris raise their songs on high, the Atris beautify their songs.

verses.sa: आ याह्यद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं सोमपते पिब । वृषन्निन्द्र वृषभिर्वृत्रहन्तम॥
verses.tr: ā yāhyadribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ somapate piba vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama
verses.en: Come thou to what the stones have pressed, drink Soma, O thou Soma's Lord, Indra best Vrtra-slayer Strong One, with the Strong.

verses.sa: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः । वृषन्निन्द्र वृषभिर्वृत्रहन्तम॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā grāvā vṛṣā mado vṛṣā somo ayaṃ sutaḥ vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama
verses.en: Strong is the stone, the draught is strong, strong is this Soma that is pressed, Indra, best Vrtra-slayer, Strong One with the Strong.

verses.sa: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः । वृषन्निन्द्र वृषभिर्वृत्रहन्तम॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā tvā vṛṣaṇaṃ huve vajriñcitrābhirūtibhiḥ vṛṣannindra vṛṣabhirvṛtrahantama
verses.en: As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunder-armed, with various aids, Indra, best Vrtra-slayer, Strong One with the Strong.

verses.sa:
ऋजीषी वज्री वृषभस्तुराषाट् छुष्मी राजा वृत्रहा सोमपावा ।
युक्त्वा हरिभ्यामुप यासदर्वाङ् माध्यंदिने सवने मत्सदिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: ṛjīṣī vajrī vṛṣabhasturāṣāṭ chuṣmī rājā vṛtrahā somapāvā yuktvā haribhyāmupa yāsadarvāṅ mādhyaṃdine savane matsadindraḥ
verses.en: Impetuous, Thunderer, Strong, quelling the mighty, King, potent, Vrtra-slayer, Soma-drinker, May he come hither with his yoked Bay Horses; may Indra gladden him at the noon libation.

verses.sa:
यत् त्वा सूर्य स्वर्भानुस्तमसाविध्यदासुरः ।
अक्षेत्रविद् यथा मुग्धो भुवनान्यदीधयुः॥
verses.tr: yat tvā sūrya svarbhānustamasāvidhyadāsuraḥ akṣetravid yathā mugdho bhuvanānyadīdhayuḥ
verses.en: O Surya, when the Asura's descendant Svarbhanu, pierced thee through and through with darkness, All creatures looked like one who is bewildered, who knoweth not the place where he is standing.

verses.sa:
स्वर्भानोरध यदिन्द्र माया अवो दिवो वर्तमाना अवाहन् ।
गूळहं सूर्यं तमसापव्रतेन तुरीयेण ब्रह्मणाविन्ददत्रिः॥
verses.tr: svarbhānoradha yadindra māyā avo divo vartamānā avāhan gūḻahaṃ sūryaṃ tamasāpavratena turīyeṇa brahmaṇāvindadatriḥ
verses.en: What time thou smotest down Svarbhanu's magic that spread itself beneath the sky, O Indra, By his fourth sacred prayer Atri discovered Surya concealed in gloom that stayed his function.

verses.sa:
मा मामिमं तव सन्तमत्र इरस्या द्रुग्धो भियसा नि गारीत् ।
त्वं मित्रो असि सत्यराधास्तौ मेहावतं वरुणश्च राजा॥
verses.tr: mā māmimaṃ tava santamatra irasyā drugdho bhiyasā ni gārīt tvaṃ mitro asi satyarādhāstau mehāvataṃ varuṇaśca rājā
verses.en: Let not the oppressor with this dread, through anger swallow me up, for I am thine, O Atri. Mitra art thou, the sender of true blessings: thou and King Varuna be both my helpers.

verses.sa:
ग्राव्णो ब्रह्मा युयुजानः सपर्यन् कीरिणा देवान् नमसोपशिक्षन् ।
अत्रिः सूर्यस्य दिवि चक्षुराधात् स्वर्भानोरप माया अघुक्षत्॥
verses.tr: grāvṇo brahmā yuyujānaḥ saparyan kīriṇā devān namasopaśikṣan atriḥ sūryasya divi cakṣurādhāt svarbhānorapa māyā aghukṣat
verses.en: The Brahman Atri, as he set the press-stones, serving the Gods with praise and adoration, Established in the heaven the eye of Surya, and caused Svarbhanu's magic arts to vanish.

verses.sa:
यं वै सूर्यं स्वर्भानुस्तमसाविध्यदासुरः ।
अत्रयस्तमन्वविन्दन् नह्य१न्ये अशक्नुवन्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ vai sūryaṃ svarbhānustamasāvidhyadāsuraḥ atrayastamanvavindan nahya1nye aśaknuvan
verses.en: The Atris found the Sun again, him whom Svarbhanu of the brood Of Asuras had pierced with gloom. This none besides had power to do.

verses.sa:
को नु वां मित्रावरुणावृतायन् दिवो वा महः पार्थिवस्य वा दे ।
ऋतस्य वा सदसि त्रासीथां नो यज्ञायते वा पशुषो न वाजान्॥
verses.tr: ko nu vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāyan divo vā mahaḥ pārthivasya vā de ṛtasya vā sadasi trāsīthāṃ no yajñāyate vā paśuṣo na vājān
verses.en: Who, Mitra-Varuna, is your pious servant to give you gifts from earth or mighty heaven? Preserve us in the seat of holy Order, and give the offerer power that winneth cattle.

verses.sa:
ते नो मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमायुरिन्द्र ऋभुक्षा मरुतो जुषन्त ।
नमोभिर्वा ये दधते सुवृक्तिं स्तोमं रुद्राय मीळहुषे सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: te no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā maruto juṣanta namobhirvā ye dadhate suvṛktiṃ stomaṃ rudrāya mīḻahuṣe sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: May Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman, and Ayu, Indra Rbhuksan, and the Maruts, love us, And they who of one mind with bounteous Rudra accept the hymn and laud with adorations.

verses.sa:
आ वां येष्ठाश्विना हुवध्यै वातस्य पत्मन् रथ्यस्य पुष्टौ ।
उत वा दिवो असुराय मन्म प्रान्धांसीव यज्यवे भरध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ yeṣṭhāśvinā huvadhyai vātasya patman rathyasya puṣṭau uta vā divo asurāya manma prāndhāṃsīva yajyave bharadhvam
verses.en: You will I call to feed the car-horse, Asvins, with the wind's flight swiftest of those who travel: Or also to the Asura of heaven, Worshipful, bring a hymn as 'twere libation.

verses.sa:
प्र सक्षणो दिव्यः कण्वहोता त्रितो दिवः सजोषा वातो अग्निः ।
पूषा भगः प्रभृथे विश्वभोजा आजिं न जग्मुराश्वश्वतमाः॥
verses.tr: pra sakṣaṇo divyaḥ kaṇvahotā trito divaḥ sajoṣā vāto agniḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ prabhṛthe viśvabhojā ājiṃ na jagmurāśvaśvatamāḥ
verses.en: The heavenly Victor, he whose priest is Kanva, Trta with Dyaus accordant, Vata, Agni, All-feeding Pusan, Bhaga sought the oblation, as they whose steeds are fleetest seek the contest.

verses.sa:
प्र वो रयिं युक्ताश्वं भरध्वं राय एषेऽवसे दधीत धीः ।
सुशेव एवैरौशिजस्य होता ये व एवा मरुतस्तुराणाम्॥
verses.tr: pra vo rayiṃ yuktāśvaṃ bharadhvaṃ rāya eṣe'vase dadhīta dhīḥ suśeva evairauśijasya hotā ye va evā marutasturāṇām
verses.en: Bring ye your riches forward borne on horses: let thought be framed for help and gain of treasure. Blest he the priest of Ausija through courses, the courses which are yours the fleet, O Maruts.

verses.sa:
प्र वो वायुं रथयुजं कृणुध्वं प्र देवं विप्रं पनितारमर्कैः ।
इषुध्यव ऋतसापः पुरंधीर्वस्वीर्नो अत्र पत्नीरा धिये धुः॥
verses.tr: pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ pra devaṃ vipraṃ panitāramarkaiḥ iṣudhyava ṛtasāpaḥ puraṃdhīrvasvīrno atra patnīrā dhiye dhuḥ
verses.en: Bring hither him who yokes the car, your Vayu, who praises with his songs, the God and Singer; And, praying and devout, noble and prudent, may the Gods' Spouses in their thoughts retain us.

verses.sa:
उप व एषे वन्द्येभिः शूषैः प्र यह्वी दिवश्चितयद्भिरर्कैः ।
उषासानक्ता विदुषीव विश्वमा हा वहतो मर्त्याय यज्ञम्॥
verses.tr: upa va eṣe vandyebhiḥ śūṣaiḥ pra yahvī divaścitayadbhirarkaiḥ uṣāsānaktā viduṣīva viśvamā hā vahato martyāya yajñam
verses.en: I speed to you with powers that should be honoured, with songs distinguishing Heaven's mighty Daughters, Morning and Night, the Two, as 'twere all-knowing: these bring the sacrifice unto the mortal.

verses.sa:
अभि वो अर्चे पोष्यावतो नॄन् वास्तोष्पतिं त्वष्टारं रराणः ।
धन्या सजोषा धिषणा नमोभिर्वनस्पतीँरोषधी राय एषे॥
verses.tr: abhi vo arce poṣyāvato nṝn vāstoṣpatiṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ rarāṇaḥ dhanyā sajoṣā dhiṣaṇā namobhirvanaspatīṃroṣadhī rāya eṣe
verses.en: You I extol, the nourishers of heroes bringing you gifts, Vastospati and Tvastar- Rich Dhisana accords through our obeisance - andTrees and Plants, for the swift gain of riches.

verses.sa:
तुजे नस्तने पर्वताः सन्तु स्वैतवो ये वसवो न वीराः ।
पनित आप्त्यो यजतः सदा नो वर्धान्नः शंसं नर्यो अभिष्टौ॥
verses.tr: tuje nastane parvatāḥ santu svaitavo ye vasavo na vīrāḥ panita āptyo yajataḥ sadā no vardhānnaḥ śaṃsaṃ naryo abhiṣṭau
verses.en: Ours be the Parvatas, even they, for offspring, free-moving, who are Heroes like the Vasus. May holy Aptya, Friend of man, exalted, strengthen our word for ever and be near us.

verses.sa:
वृष्णो अस्तोषि भूम्यस्य गर्भं त्रितो नपातमपां सुवृक्ति ।
गृणीते अग्निरेतरी न शूषैः शोचिष्केशो नि रिणाति वना॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṇo astoṣi bhūmyasya garbhaṃ trito napātamapāṃ suvṛkti gṛṇīte agniretarī na śūṣaiḥ śociṣkeśo ni riṇāti vanā
verses.en: Trta praised him, germ of the earthly hero, with pure songs him the Offspring of the Waters. Agn; with might neighs loudly like a charger: he of the flaming hair destroys the forests.

verses.sa:
कथा महे रुद्रियाय ब्रवाम कद्राये चिकितुषे भगाय ।
आप ओषधीरुत नोऽवन्तु द्यौर्वना गिरयो वृक्षकेशाः॥
verses.tr: kathā mahe rudriyāya bravāma kadrāye cikituṣe bhagāya āpa oṣadhīruta no'vantu dyaurvanā girayo vṛkṣakeśāḥ
verses.en: How shall we speak to the great might of Rudra? How speak to Bhaga who takes thought for riches? May Plants, the Waters, and the Sky preserve us, and Woods and Mountains with their trees for tresses.

verses.sa:
शृणोतु न ऊर्जां पतिर्गिरः स नभस्तरीयाँ इषिरः परिज्मा ।
शृण्वन्त्वापः पुरो न शुभ्राः परि स्रुचो बबृहाणस्याद्रेः॥
verses.tr: śṛṇotu na ūrjāṃ patirgiraḥ sa nabhastarīyāṃ iṣiraḥ parijmā śṛṇvantvāpaḥ puro na śubhrāḥ pari sruco babṛhāṇasyādreḥ
verses.en: May the swift Wanderer, Lord of refreshments listen to our songs, who speeds throuih cloudy heaven: And may the Waters, bright like castles, hear us, as they flow onward from the cloven mountain.

verses.sa:
विदा चिन्नु महान्तो ये व एवा ब्रवाम दस्मा वार्यं दधानाः ।
वयश्चन सुभ्व१ आव यन्ति क्षुभा मर्तमनुयतं वधस्नैः॥
verses.tr: vidā cinnu mahānto ye va evā bravāma dasmā vāryaṃ dadhānāḥ vayaścana subhva1 āva yanti kṣubhā martamanuyataṃ vadhasnaiḥ
verses.en: We know your ways, ye Mighty Ones receiving choice meed, ye Wonderful, we will proclaim it. Even strong birds descend not to the mortal who strives to reach them with swift blow and weapons.

verses.sa:
आ दैव्यानि पार्थिवानि जन्मापश्चाच्छा सुमखाय वोचम् ।
वर्धन्तां द्यावो गिरश्चन्द्राग्रा उदा वर्धन्तामभिषाता अर्णाः॥
verses.tr: ā daivyāni pārthivāni janmāpaścācchā sumakhāya vocam vardhantāṃ dyāvo giraścandrāgrā udā vardhantāmabhiṣātā arṇāḥ
verses.en: Celestial and terrestrial generations, and Waters will I summon to the feasting. May days with bright dawns cause my songs to prosper, and may the conquered streams increase their waters.

verses.sa:
पदेपदे मे जरिमा नि धायि वरूत्री वा शक्रा या पायुभिश्च ।
सिषक्तु माता मही रसा नः स्मत् सूरिभिर्ऋजुहस्त ऋजुवनिः॥
verses.tr: padepade me jarimā ni dhāyi varūtrī vā śakrā yā pāyubhiśca siṣaktu mātā mahī rasā naḥ smat sūribhirṛjuhasta ṛjuvaniḥ
verses.en: Duly to each one hath my laud been offered. Strong be Varutri with her powers to succour. May the great Mother Rasa here befriend us, straight-handed, with the princes, striving forward.

verses.sa:
कथा दाशेम नमसा सुदानूनेवया मरुतो अच्छोक्तौ प्रश्रवसो मरुतो अच्छोक्तौ ।
मा नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यो रिषे धादस्माकं भूदुपमातिवनिः॥
verses.tr: kathā dāśema namasā sudānūnevayā maruto acchoktau praśravaso maruto acchoktau mā no'hirbudhnyo riṣe dhādasmākaṃ bhūdupamātivaniḥ
verses.en: How may we serve the Liberal Ones with worship, the Maruts swift of course in invocation, the Maruts far-renowned in invocation? Let not the Dragon of the Deep annoy us, and gladly may he welcome our addresses.

verses.sa:
इति चिन्नु प्रजायै पशुमत्यै देवासो वनते मर्त्यो व आ देवासो वनते मर्त्यो वः ।
अत्रा शिवां तन्वो धासिमस्या जरां चिन्मे निर्ऋतिर्जग्रसीत॥
verses.tr: iti cinnu prajāyai paśumatyai devāso vanate martyo va ā devāso vanate martyo vaḥ atrā śivāṃ tanvo dhāsimasyā jarāṃ cinme nirṛtirjagrasīta
verses.en: Thus thinking, O ye Gods, the mortal wins you to give him increase of his herds of cattle: the mortal wins him, O ye Gods, your favour. Here he wins wholesome food to feed this body: as for mine old age, Nirrti consume it

verses.sa:
तां वो देवाः सुमतिमूर्जयन्तीमिषमश्याम वसवः शसा गोः ।
सा नः सुदानुर्मृळयन्ती देवी प्रति द्रवन्ती सुविताय गम्याः॥
verses.tr: tāṃ vo devāḥ sumatimūrjayantīmiṣamaśyāma vasavaḥ śasā goḥ sā naḥ sudānurmṛḻayantī devī prati dravantī suvitāya gamyāḥ
verses.en: O Gods, may we obtain from you this favour, strengthening food through the Cow's praise, ye Vasus. May she who gives good gifts, the gracious Goddes. s, come speeding nigh to us for our well-being.

verses.sa:
अभि न इळा यूथस्य माता स्मन्नदीभिरुर्वशी वा गृणातु ।
उर्वशी वा बृहद्दिवा गृणानाऽभ्यूर्ण्वाना प्रभृथस्यायोः॥
verses.tr: abhi na iḻā yūthasya mātā smannadībhirurvaśī vā gṛṇātu urvaśī vā bṛhaddivā gṛṇānā'bhyūrṇvānā prabhṛthasyāyoḥ
verses.en: May Ila, Mother of the herds of cattle, and Urvasi with all the streams accept us; May Urvasi in lofty heaven accepting, as she partakes the oblation of the living,

verses.sa: सिषक्तु न ऊर्जव्यस्य पुष्टेः॥
verses.tr: siṣaktu na ūrjavyasya puṣṭeḥ
verses.en: Visit us while she shares Urjavya's food.

verses.sa:
प्र शंतमा वरुणं दीधिती गीर्मित्रं भगमदितिं नूनमश्याः ।
पृषद्योनिः पञ्चहोता शृणोत्वतूर्तपन्था असुरो मयोभुः॥
verses.tr: pra śaṃtamā varuṇaṃ dīdhitī gīrmitraṃ bhagamaditiṃ nūnamaśyāḥ pṛṣadyoniḥ pañcahotā śṛṇotvatūrtapanthā asuro mayobhuḥ
verses.en: Now may our sweetest song with deep devotion reach Varuna, Mitra, Aditi, and Bhaga. May the Five Priests' Lord, dwelling in oblations, bliss-giving Asura, hear, whose paths are open.

verses.sa:
प्रति मे स्तोममदितिर्जगृभ्यात् सूनुं न माता हृद्यं सुशेवम् ।
ब्रह्म प्रियं देवहितं यदस्त्यहं मित्रे वरुणे यन्मयोभु॥
verses.tr: prati me stomamaditirjagṛbhyāt sūnuṃ na mātā hṛdyaṃ suśevam brahma priyaṃ devahitaṃ yadastyahaṃ mitre varuṇe yanmayobhu
verses.en: May Aditi welcome, even as a mother her dear heart-gladdening son, my song that lauds her. The prayer they love, bliss-giving, God-appointed, I offer unto Varuna and Mitra.

verses.sa:
उदीरय कवितमं कवीनामुनत्तैनमभि मध्वा घृतेन ।
स नो वसूनि प्रयता हितानि चन्द्राणि देवः सविता सुवाति॥
verses.tr: udīraya kavitamaṃ kavīnāmunattainamabhi madhvā ghṛtena sa no vasūni prayatā hitāni candrāṇi devaḥ savitā suvāti
verses.en: In spirit him, the Sagest of the Sages; with sacrificial oil and meath bedew him So then let him, God Savitar, provide us excellent, ready, and resplendent treasures.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्र णो मनसा नेषि गोभिः सं सूरिभिर्हरिवः सं स्वस्ति ।
सं ब्रह्मणा देवहितं यदस्ति सं देवानां सुमत्या यज्ञियानाम्॥
verses.tr: samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhirharivaḥ saṃ svasti saṃ brahmaṇā devahitaṃ yadasti saṃ devānāṃ sumatyā yajñiyānām
verses.en: With willing mind, Indra, vouchsafe us cattle, prosperity, Lord of Bays! and pious patrons; And, with the sacred prayer by Gods appointed, give us the holy Deities' lovingkindness.

verses.sa:
देवो भगः सविता रायो अंश इन्द्रो वृत्रस्य संजितो धनानाम् ।
ऋभुक्षा वाज उत वा पुरंधिरवन्तु नो अमृतासस्तुरासः॥
verses.tr: devo bhagaḥ savitā rāyo aṃśa indro vṛtrasya saṃjito dhanānām ṛbhukṣā vāja uta vā puraṃdhiravantu no amṛtāsasturāsaḥ
verses.en: God Bhaga, Savitar who deals forth riches, Indra, and they who conquer Vrtra's treasures, And Vaja and Rbhuksan and Purandhi, the Mighty and Immortal Ones, protect us!

verses.sa:
मरुत्वतो अप्रतीतस्य जिष्णोरजूर्यतः प्र ब्रवामा कृतानि ।
न ते पूर्वे मघवन् नापरासो न वीर्यं१ नूतनः कश्चनाप॥
verses.tr: marutvato apratītasya jiṣṇorajūryataḥ pra bravāmā kṛtāni na te pūrve maghavan nāparāso na vīryaṃ1 nūtanaḥ kaścanāpa
verses.en: Let us declare his deeds, the undecaying unrivalled Victor whom the Maruts follow. None of old times, O Maghavan, nor later, none of these days hath reached thy hero prowess.

verses.sa:
उप स्तुहि प्रथमं रत्नधेयं बृहस्पतिं सनितारं धनानाम् ।
यः शंसते स्तुवते शम्भविष्ठः पुरूवसुरागमज्जोहुवानम्॥
verses.tr: upa stuhi prathamaṃ ratnadheyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sanitāraṃ dhanānām yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate śambhaviṣṭhaḥ purūvasurāgamajjohuvānam
verses.en: Praise him the Chief who gives the boon of riches, Brhaspati distributor of treasures, Who, blessing most the man who sings and praises, comes with abundant wealth to his invoker.

verses.sa:
तवोतिभिः सचमाना अरिष्टा बृहस्पते मघवानः सुवीराः ।
ये अश्वदा उत वा सन्ति गोदा ये वस्त्रदाः सुभगास्तेषु रायः॥
verses.tr: tavotibhiḥ sacamānā ariṣṭā bṛhaspate maghavānaḥ suvīrāḥ ye aśvadā uta vā santi godā ye vastradāḥ subhagāsteṣu rāyaḥ
verses.en: Tended, Brhaspati, with thy protections, the princes are unharmed and girt by heroes. Wealth that brings bliss is found among the givers of horses and of cattle and of raiment.

verses.sa:
विसर्माणं कृणुहि वित्तमेषां ये भुञ्जते अपृणन्तो न उक्थैः ।
अपव्रतान् प्रसवे वावृधानान् ब्रह्मद्विषः सूर्याद् यावयस्व॥
verses.tr: visarmāṇaṃ kṛṇuhi vittameṣāṃ ye bhuñjate apṛṇanto na ukthaiḥ apavratān prasave vāvṛdhānān brahmadviṣaḥ sūryād yāvayasva
verses.en: Make their wealth flee who, through our hymns enjoying their riches, yield us not an ample guerdon. Far from the sun keep those who hate devotion, the godless, prospering in their vocation.

verses.sa:
य ओहते रक्षसो देववीतावचक्रेभिस्तं मरुतो नि यात ।
यो वः शमीं शशमानस्य निन्दात्तुच्छ्यान् कामान् करते सिष्विदानः॥
verses.tr: ya ohate rakṣaso devavītāvacakrebhistaṃ maruto ni yāta yo vaḥ śamīṃ śaśamānasya nindāttucchyān kāmān karate siṣvidānaḥ
verses.en: With wheelless chariots drive down him, O Maruts, who at the feasts of Gods regards the demons. May he, though bathed in sweat, form empty wishes, who blames his sacred rite who toils to serve you.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टुहि यः स्विषुः सुधन्वा यो विश्वस्य क्षयति भेषजस्य ।
यक्ष्वा महे सौमनसाय रुद्रं नमोभिर्देवमसुरं दुवस्य॥
verses.tr: tamu ṣṭuhi yaḥ sviṣuḥ sudhanvā yo viśvasya kṣayati bheṣajasya yakṣvā mahe saumanasāya rudraṃ namobhirdevamasuraṃ duvasya
verses.en: Praise him whose bow is strong and sure his arrow, him who is Lord of every balm that bealeth. Worship thou Rudra for his great good favour: adore the Asura, God, with salutations.

verses.sa:
दमूनसो अपसो ये सुहस्ता वृष्णः पत्नीर्नद्यो विभ्वतष्टाः ।
सरस्वती बृहद्दिवोत राका दशस्यन्तीर्वरिवस्यन्तु शुभ्राः॥
verses.tr: damūnaso apaso ye suhastā vṛṣṇaḥ patnīrnadyo vibhvataṣṭāḥ sarasvatī bṛhaddivota rākā daśasyantīrvarivasyantu śubhrāḥ
verses.en: May the House-friends, the cunning-handed Artists, may the Steer's Wives, the streams carved out by Vibhvan, And may the fair Ones honour and befriend us, Sarasvati, Brhaddiva, and Raka.

verses.sa:
प्र सू महे सुशरणाय मेधां गिरं भरे नव्यसीं जायमानाम् ।
य आहना दुहितुर्वक्षणासु रूपा मिनानो अकृणोदिदं नः॥
verses.tr: pra sū mahe suśaraṇāya medhāṃ giraṃ bhare navyasīṃ jāyamānām ya āhanā duhiturvakṣaṇāsu rūpā mināno akṛṇodidaṃ naḥ
verses.en: My newest song, thought that now springs within me, I offer to the Great, the Sure Protector, Who made for us this All, in fond love laying each varied form within his Daughter's bosom.

verses.sa:
प्र सुष्टुतिः स्तनयन्तं रुवन्तमिळस्पतिं जरितर्नूनमश्याः ।
यो अब्दिमाँ उदनिमाँ इयर्ति प्र विद्युता रोदसी उक्षमाणः॥
verses.tr: pra suṣṭutiḥ stanayantaṃ ruvantamiḻaspatiṃ jaritarnūnamaśyāḥ yo abdimāṃ udanimāṃ iyarti pra vidyutā rodasī ukṣamāṇaḥ
verses.en: Now, even now, may thy fair praise, O Singer, attain Idaspati who roars and thunders, Who, rich in clouds and waters with his lightning speeds forth bedewing both the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोमो मारुतं शर्धो अच्छा रुद्रस्य सूनूँर्युवन्यूँरुदश्याः ।
कामो राये हवते मा स्वस्त्युप स्तुहि पृषदश्वाँ अयासः॥
verses.tr: eṣa stomo mārutaṃ śardho acchā rudrasya sūnūṃryuvanyūṃrudaśyāḥ kāmo rāye havate mā svastyupa stuhi pṛṣadaśvāṃ ayāsaḥ
verses.en: May this my laud attain the troop of Maruts, those who are youths in act, the Sons of Rudra. The wish calls me to riches and well-being: praise the unwearied Ones whose steeds are dappled.

verses.sa:
प्रैष स्तोमः पृथिवीमन्तरिक्षं वनस्पतीँरोषधी राये अश्याः ।
देवोदेवः सुहवो भूतु मह्यं मा नो माता पृथिवी दुर्मतौ धात्॥
verses.tr: praiṣa stomaḥ pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ vanaspatīṃroṣadhī rāye aśyāḥ devodevaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyaṃ mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt
verses.en: May this my laud reach earth and air's mid-region, and forest trees and plants to win me riches. May every Deity be swift to listen, and Mother Earth with no ill thought regard me.

verses.sa: उरौ देवा अनिबाधे स्याम॥
verses.tr: urau devā anibādhe syāma
verses.en: Gods, may we dwell in free untroubled bliss.

verses.sa:
समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।
आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि॥
verses.tr: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni
verses.en: May we obtain the Asvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance. Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sa:
आ धेनवः पयसा तूर्ण्यर्था अमर्धन्तीरुप नो यन्तु मध्वा ।
महो राये बृहतीः सप्त विप्रो मयोभुवो जरिता जोहवीति॥
verses.tr: ā dhenavaḥ payasā tūrṇyarthā amardhantīrupa no yantu madhvā maho rāye bṛhatīḥ sapta vipro mayobhuvo jaritā johavīti
verses.en: May the Milch-cows who hasten to their object come harmless unto us with liquid sweetness. The Singer, lauding, calls, for ample riches, the Seven Mighty Ones who bring enjoyment.

verses.sa:
आ सुष्टुती नमसा वर्तयध्यै द्यावा वाजाय पृथिवी अमृध्रे ।
पिता माता मधुवचाः सुहस्ता भरेभरे नो यशसावविष्टाम्॥
verses.tr: ā suṣṭutī namasā vartayadhyai dyāvā vājāya pṛthivī amṛdhre pitā mātā madhuvacāḥ suhastā bharebhare no yaśasāvaviṣṭām
verses.en: With reverence and fair praise will I bring hither, for sake of strength, exhaustless Earth and Heaven. Father and Mother, sweet of speech, fairhanded, may they, far-famed, in every fight protect us.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवश्चकृवांसो मधूनि प्र वायवे भरत चारु शुक्रम् ।
होतेव नः प्रथमः पाह्यस्य देव मध्वो ररिमा ते मदाय॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavaścakṛvāṃso madhūni pra vāyave bharata cāru śukram hoteva naḥ prathamaḥ pāhyasya deva madhvo rarimā te madāya
verses.en: Adhvaryus, make the sweet libations ready, and bring the beautiful bright juice to Vayu. God, as our Priest, be thou the first to drink it: we give thee of the mead to make thee joyful.

verses.sa:
दश क्षिपो युञ्जते बाहू अद्रिं सोमस्य या शमितारा सुहस्ता ।
मध्वो रसं सुगभस्तिर्गिरिष्ठां चनिश्चदद् दुदुहे शुक्रमंशुः॥
verses.tr: daśa kṣipo yuñjate bāhū adriṃ somasya yā śamitārā suhastā madhvo rasaṃ sugabhastirgiriṣṭhāṃ caniścadad duduhe śukramaṃśuḥ
verses.en: Two arms-the Soma's dexterous immolators-and the ten fingers set and fix the press-stone. The stalk hath poured, fair with its spreading branches, the mead's bright glittering juice that dwells on mountains.

verses.sa:
असावि ते जुजुषाणाय सोमः क्रत्वे दक्षाय बृहते मदाय ।
हरी रथे सुधुरा योगे अर्वागिन्द्र प्रिया कृणुहि हूयमानः॥
verses.tr: asāvi te jujuṣāṇāya somaḥ kratve dakṣāya bṛhate madāya harī rathe sudhurā yoge arvāgindra priyā kṛṇuhi hūyamānaḥ
verses.en: The Soma hath been pressed for thee, its lover, to give thee power and might and high enjoyment. Invoked, turn hither in thy car, O Indra, at need, thy two well-trained and dear Bay Horses.

verses.sa:
आ नो महीमरमतिं सजोषा ग्नां देवीं नमसा रातहव्याम् ।
मधोर्मदाय बृहतीमृतज्ञामाग्ने वह पथिभिर्देवयानैः॥
verses.tr: ā no mahīmaramatiṃ sajoṣā gnāṃ devīṃ namasā rātahavyām madhormadāya bṛhatīmṛtajñāmāgne vaha pathibhirdevayānaiḥ
verses.en: Bring by God-traversed paths, accordant, Agni, the great Aramati, Celestial Lady, Exalted, worshipped with our gifts and homage, who knoweth holy Law, to drink sweet Soma.

verses.sa:
अञ्जन्ति यं प्रथयन्तो न विप्रा वपावन्तं नाग्निना तपन्तः ।
पितुर्न पुत्र उपसि प्रेष्ठ आ घर्मो अग्निमृतयन्नसादि॥
verses.tr: añjanti yaṃ prathayanto na viprā vapāvantaṃ nāgninā tapantaḥ piturna putra upasi preṣṭha ā gharmo agnimṛtayannasādi
verses.en: As on his father's lap the son, the darling, so on the fire is set the sacred caldron, Which holy singers deck, as if extending and heating that which holds the fatty membrane.

verses.sa:
अच्छा मही बृहती शंतमा गीर्दूतो न गन्त्वश्विना हुवध्यै ।
मयोभुवा सरथा यातमर्वाग्गन्तं निधिं धुरमाणिर्न नाभिम्॥
verses.tr: acchā mahī bṛhatī śaṃtamā gīrdūto na gantvaśvinā huvadhyai mayobhuvā sarathā yātamarvāggantaṃ nidhiṃ dhuramāṇirna nābhim
verses.en: Hither, as herald to invite the Asvins, come the great lofty song, most sweet and pleasant! Come in one car, joy-givers! to the banquet, like the bolt binding pole and nave, come hither.

verses.sa:
प्र तव्यसो नमउक्तिं तुरस्याऽहं पूष्ण उत वायोरदिक्षि ।
या राधसा चोदितारा मतीनां या वाजस्य द्रविणोदा उत त्मन्॥
verses.tr: pra tavyaso namauktiṃ turasyā'haṃ pūṣṇa uta vāyoradikṣi yā rādhasā coditārā matīnāṃ yā vājasya draviṇodā uta tman
verses.en: I have declared this speech of adoration to mightiest Pusan and victorious Vayu, Who by their bounty are the hymns' inspirers, and of themselves give power as a possession.

verses.sa:
आ नामभिर्मरुतो वक्षि विश्वाना रूपेभिर्जातवेदो हुवानः ।
यज्ञं गिरो जरितुः सुष्टुतिं च विश्वे गन्त मरुतो विश्व ऊती॥
verses.tr: ā nāmabhirmaruto vakṣi viśvānā rūpebhirjātavedo huvānaḥ yajñaṃ giro jarituḥ suṣṭutiṃ ca viśve ganta maruto viśva ūtī
verses.en: Invoked by us bring hither, Jatavedas the Maruts all under their names and figures. Come to the sacrifice with aid all Maruts, all to the songs and praises of the singer!

verses.sa:
आ नो दिवो बृहतः पर्वतादा सरस्वती यजता गन्तु यज्ञम् ।
हवं देवी जुजुषाणा घृताची शग्मां नो वाचमुशती शृणोतु॥
verses.tr: ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatādā sarasvatī yajatā gantu yajñam havaṃ devī jujuṣāṇā ghṛtācī śagmāṃ no vācamuśatī śṛṇotu
verses.en: From high heaven may Sarasvati the Holy visit our sacrifice, and from the mountain. Eager, propitious, may the balmy Goddess hear our effectual speech, our invocation.

verses.sa:
आ वेधसं नीलपृष्ठं बृहन्तं बृहस्पतिं सदने सादयध्वम् ।
सादद्योनिं दम आ दीदिवांसं हिरण्यवर्णमरुषं सपेम॥
verses.tr: ā vedhasaṃ nīlapṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhantaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sadane sādayadhvam sādadyoniṃ dama ā dīdivāṃsaṃ hiraṇyavarṇamaruṣaṃ sapema
verses.en: Set in his seat the God whose back is dusky, Brhaspati the lofty, the Disposer. Him let us worship, set within the dwelling, the red, the golden-hued, the all resplendent.

verses.sa:
आ धर्णसिर्बृहद्दिवो रराणो विश्वेभिर्गन्त्वोमभिर्हुवानः ।
ग्ना वसान ओषधीरमृध्रस्त्रिधातुशृङ्गो वृषभो वयोधाः॥
verses.tr: ā dharṇasirbṛhaddivo rarāṇo viśvebhirgantvomabhirhuvānaḥ gnā vasāna oṣadhīramṛdhrastridhātuśṛṅgo vṛṣabho vayodhāḥ
verses.en: May the Sustainer, high in heaven, come hither, the Bounteous One, invoked, with all his favours, Dweller with Dames divine, with plants, unwearied, the Steer with triple horn, the life-bestower.

verses.sa:
मातुष्पदे परमे शुक्र आयोर्विपन्यवो रास्पिरासो अग्मन् ।
सुशेव्यं नमसा रातहव्याः शिशुं मृजन्त्यायवो न वासे॥
verses.tr: mātuṣpade parame śukra āyorvipanyavo rāspirāso agman suśevyaṃ namasā rātahavyāḥ śiśuṃ mṛjantyāyavo na vāse
verses.en: The tuneful eloquent priests of him who liveth have sought the Mother's bright and loftiest station. As living men, with offered gifts and homage they deck the most auspicious Child to clothe him.

verses.sa:
बृहद् वयो बृहते तुभ्यमग्ने धियाजुरो मिथुनासः सचन्त ।
देवोदेवः सुहवो भूतु मह्यं मा नो माता पृथिवी दुर्मतौ धात्॥
verses.tr: bṛhad vayo bṛhate tubhyamagne dhiyājuro mithunāsaḥ sacanta devodevaḥ suhavo bhūtu mahyaṃ mā no mātā pṛthivī durmatau dhāt
verses.en: Agni, great vital power is thine, the mighty: pairs waxing old in their devotion seek thee. May every Deity be swift to listen, and Mother Earth with no ill thought regard me.

verses.sa: उरौ देवा अनिबाधे स्याम॥
verses.tr: urau devā anibādhe syāma
verses.en: Gods, may we dwell in free untroubled bliss.

verses.sa:
समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।
आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि॥
verses.tr: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni
verses.en: May we obtain the Asvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance. Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sa:
तं प्रत्नथा पूर्वथा विश्वथेमथा ज्येष्ठतातिं बर्हिषदं स्वर्विदम् ।
प्रतीचीनं वृजनं दोहसे गिरा ऽऽशुं जयन्तमनु यासु वर्धसे॥
verses.tr: taṃ pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātiṃ barhiṣadaṃ svarvidam pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase girā ''śuṃ jayantamanu yāsu vardhase
verses.en: As in the first old times, as all were wont, as now, he draweth forth the power turned hitherward with song, The Princedom throned on holy grass, who findeth light, swift, conquering in the' plants wherein he waxeth strong.

verses.sa:
श्रिये सुदृशीरुपरस्य याः स्वर्विरोचमानः ककुभामचोदते ।
सुगोपा असि न दभाय सुक्रतो परो मायाभिर्ऋत आस नाम ते॥
verses.tr: śriye sudṛśīruparasya yāḥ svarvirocamānaḥ kakubhāmacodate sugopā asi na dabhāya sukrato paro māyābhirṛta āsa nāma te
verses.en: Shining to him who leaves heaven's regions undisturbed, which to his sheen who is beneath show fair in light, Good guardian art thou, not to be deceived, Most Wise! Far from deceits thy name dwelleth in holy Law.

verses.sa:
अत्यं हविः सचते सच्च धातु चाऽरिष्टगातुः स होता सहोभरिः ।
प्रसर्स्राणो अनु बर्हिर्वृषा शिशुर्मध्ये युवाजरो विस्रुहा हितः॥
verses.tr: atyaṃ haviḥ sacate sacca dhātu cā'riṣṭagātuḥ sa hotā sahobhariḥ prasarsrāṇo anu barhirvṛṣā śiśurmadhye yuvājaro visruhā hitaḥ
verses.en: Truth waits upon oblation present and to come: naught checks him in his way, this vic tory- bringing Priest: The Mighty Child who glides along the sacred grass, the undecaying Youth set in the midst of plants.

verses.sa:
प्र व एते सुयुजो यामन्निष्टये नीचीरमुष्मै यम्य ऋतावृधः ।
सुयन्तुभिः सर्वशासैरभीशुभिः क्रिविर्नामानि प्रवणे मुषायति॥
verses.tr: pra va ete suyujo yāmanniṣṭaye nīcīramuṣmai yamya ṛtāvṛdhaḥ suyantubhiḥ sarvaśāsairabhīśubhiḥ krivirnāmāni pravaṇe muṣāyati
verses.en: These come, well-yoked, to you for furtherance in the rite: down come the twinborn strengtheners of Law for him, With reins easily guided and commanding all. In the deep fall the hide stealeth away their names.

verses.sa:
संजर्भुराणस्तरुभिः सुतेगृभं वयाकिनं चित्तगर्भासु सुस्वरुः ।
धारवाकेष्वृजुगाथ शोभसे वर्धस्व पत्नीरभि जीवो अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: saṃjarbhurāṇastarubhiḥ sutegṛbhaṃ vayākinaṃ cittagarbhāsu susvaruḥ dhāravākeṣvṛjugātha śobhase vardhasva patnīrabhi jīvo adhvare
verses.en: Thou, moving beauteously in visibly pregnant ones, snatching with trees the branching plant that grasps the juice, Shinest, true Singer! mid the upholders of the voice. Increase thy Consorts thou, lively at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यादृगेव ददृशे तादृगुच्यते सं छायया दधिरे सिध्रयाप्स्वा ।
महीमस्मभ्यमुरुषामुरु ज्रयो बृहत् सुवीरमनपच्युतं सहः॥
verses.tr: yādṛgeva dadṛśe tādṛgucyate saṃ chāyayā dadhire sidhrayāpsvā mahīmasmabhyamuruṣāmuru jrayo bṛhat suvīramanapacyutaṃ sahaḥ
verses.en: Like as he is beheld such is he said to be. They with effectual splendour in the floods have made Earth yield us room enough and amply wide extent, great might invincible, with store of hero sons.

verses.sa:
वेत्यग्रुर्जनिवान् वा अति स्पृधः समर्यता मनसा सूर्यः कविः ।
घ्रंसं रक्षन्तं परि विश्वतो गयमस्माकं शर्म वनवत् स्वावसुः॥
verses.tr: vetyagrurjanivān vā ati spṛdhaḥ samaryatā manasā sūryaḥ kaviḥ ghraṃsaṃ rakṣantaṃ pari viśvato gayamasmākaṃ śarma vanavat svāvasuḥ
verses.en: Surya the Sage, as if unwedded, with a Spouse, in battle-loving spirit moveth o'er the foes. May he, self-excellent, grant us a sheltering home, a house that wards the fierce heat off on every side.

verses.sa:
ज्यायांसमस्य यतुनस्य केतुन ऋषिस्वरं चरति यासु नाम ते ।
यादृश्मिन् धायि तमपस्यया विदद् य उ स्वयं वहते सो अरं करत्॥
verses.tr: jyāyāṃsamasya yatunasya ketuna ṛṣisvaraṃ carati yāsu nāma te yādṛśmin dhāyi tamapasyayā vidad ya u svayaṃ vahate so araṃ karat
verses.en: Thy name, sung forth by Rsis in these hymns of ours, goes to the loftier One with this swift mover's light. By skill he wins the boon whereon his heart is set: he who bestirs himself shall bring the thing to pass.

verses.sa:
समुद्रमासामव तस्थे अग्रिमा न रिष्यति सवनं यस्मिन्नायता ।
अत्रा न हार्दि क्रवणस्य रेजते यत्रा मतिर्विद्यते पूतबन्धनी॥
verses.tr: samudramāsāmava tasthe agrimā na riṣyati savanaṃ yasminnāyatā atrā na hārdi kravaṇasya rejate yatrā matirvidyate pūtabandhanī
verses.en: The chief and best of these abideth in the sea, nor doth libation fail wherein it is prolonged. The heart of him who praiseth trembleth not in fear there where the hymn is found connected with the pure.

verses.sa:
स हि क्षत्रस्य मनसस्य चित्तिभिरेवावदस्य यजतस्य सध्रेः ।
अवत्सारस्य स्पृणवाम रण्वभिः शविष्ठं वाजं विदुषा चिदर्ध्यम्॥
verses.tr: sa hi kṣatrasya manasasya cittibhirevāvadasya yajatasya sadhreḥ avatsārasya spṛṇavāma raṇvabhiḥ śaviṣṭhaṃ vājaṃ viduṣā cidardhyam
verses.en: For it is he: with though to of Ksatra, Manasa, of Yajata, and Sadhri, and Evavada, With Avatsara's sweet songs will we strive to win the mightiest strength which even he who knows should gain.

verses.sa:
श्येन आसामदितिः कक्ष्यो३ मदो विश्ववारस्य यजतस्य मायिनः ।
समन्यमन्यमर्थयन्त्येतवे विदुर्विषाणं परिपानमन्ति ते॥
verses.tr: śyena āsāmaditiḥ kakṣyo3 mado viśvavārasya yajatasya māyinaḥ samanyamanyamarthayantyetave vidurviṣāṇaṃ paripānamanti te
verses.en: The Hawk is their full source, girth-stretching rapturous drink of Visvavara, of Mayin, and Yajata. They ever seek a fresh draught so that they may come, know when thy time to halt and drink thy fill is near.

verses.sa:
सदापृणो यजतो वि द्विषो वधीद् बाहुवृक्तः श्रुतवित् तर्यो वः सचा ।
उभा स वरा प्रत्येति भाति च यदीं गणं भजते सुप्रयावभिः॥
verses.tr: sadāpṛṇo yajato vi dviṣo vadhīd bāhuvṛktaḥ śrutavit taryo vaḥ sacā ubhā sa varā pratyeti bhāti ca yadīṃ gaṇaṃ bhajate suprayāvabhiḥ
verses.en: Sadaprna the holy, Tarya, Srutavit, and Bahuvrkta, joined with you, have slain the foes. He gains his wish in both the worlds and brightly shines-when he adores the host with well-advancing steeds.

verses.sa:
सुतम्भरो यजमानस्य सत्पतिर्विश्वासामूधः स धियामुदञ्चनः ।
भरद् धेनू रसवच्छिश्रिये पयोऽनुब्रुवाणो अध्येति न स्वपन्॥
verses.tr: sutambharo yajamānasya satpatirviśvāsāmūdhaḥ sa dhiyāmudañcanaḥ bharad dhenū rasavacchiśriye payo'nubruvāṇo adhyeti na svapan
verses.en: The worshipper's defender is Sutambhara, producer and uplifter of all holy thoughts. The milch-cow brought, sweet-flavoured milk was dealt around. Who speaks the bidding text knows this, not he who sleeps.

verses.sa:
यो जागार तमृचः कामयन्ते यो जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति ।
यो जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः॥
verses.tr: yo jāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante yo jāgāra tamu sāmāni yanti yo jāgāra tamayaṃ soma āha tavāhamasmi sakhye nyokāḥ
verses.en: The sacred hymns love him who wakes and watches: to him who watches come the Sama verses. This Soma saith unto the man who watches, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जागार तमृचः कामयन्तेऽग्निर्जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति ।
अग्निर्जागार तमयं सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः॥
verses.tr: agnirjāgāra tamṛcaḥ kāmayante'gnirjāgāra tamu sāmāni yanti agnirjāgāra tamayaṃ soma āha tavāhamasmi sakhye nyokāḥ
verses.en: Agni is watchful, and the gcas love him; Agni is watchful, Sama verses seek him. Agni is watchful, to him saith this Soma, I rest and have my dwelling in thy friendship.

verses.sa:
विदा दिवो विष्यन्नद्रिमुक्थैरायत्या उषसो अर्चिनो गुः ।
अपावृत व्रजिनीरुत् स्वर्गाद् वि दुरो मानुषीर्देव आवः॥
verses.tr: vidā divo viṣyannadrimukthairāyatyā uṣaso arcino guḥ apāvṛta vrajinīrut svargād vi duro mānuṣīrdeva āvaḥ
verses.en: Bards of approaching Dawn who know the heavens are come with hymns to throw the mountain open. The Sun hath risen and open the stable portals: the doors of men, too, hath the God thrown open.

verses.sa:
वि सूर्यो अमतिं न श्रियं सादोर्वाद् गवां माता जानती गात् ।
धन्वर्णसो नद्य१ः खादोअर्णाः स्थूणेव सुमिता दृंहत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: vi sūryo amatiṃ na śriyaṃ sādorvād gavāṃ mātā jānatī gāt dhanvarṇaso nadya1ḥ khādoarṇāḥ sthūṇeva sumitā dṛṃhata dyauḥ
verses.en: Surya hath spread his light as splendour: hither came the Cows' Mother, conscious, from the stable, To streams that flow with biting waves to deserts; and heaven is stablished like a firm-set pillar.

verses.sa:
अस्मा उक्थाय पर्वतस्य गर्भो महीनां जनुषे पूर्व्याय ।
वि पर्वतो जिहीत साधत द्यौराविवासन्तो दसयन्त भूम॥
verses.tr: asmā ukthāya parvatasya garbho mahīnāṃ januṣe pūrvyāya vi parvato jihīta sādhata dyaurāvivāsanto dasayanta bhūma
verses.en: This laud hath won the burden of the mountain. To aid the ancient birth of mighty waters The mountain parted, Heaven performed his office. The worshippers were worn with constant serving.

verses.sa:
सूक्तेभिर्वो वचोभिर्देवजुष्टैरिन्द्रा न्व१ग्नी अवसे हुवध्यै ।
उक्थेभिर्हि ष्मा कवयः सुयज्ञा आविवासन्तो मरुतो यजन्ति॥
verses.tr: sūktebhirvo vacobhirdevajuṣṭairindrā nva1gnī avase huvadhyai ukthebhirhi ṣmā kavayaḥ suyajñā āvivāsanto maruto yajanti
verses.en: With hymns and God-loved words will I invoke you, Indra and Agni, to obtain your favour, For verily sages, skilled in sacrificing, worship the Maruts and with lauds invite them.

verses.sa:
एतो न्व१द्य सुध्यो३ भवाम प्र दुच्छुना मिनवामा वरीयः ।
आरे द्वेषांसि सनुतर्दधामाऽयाम प्राञ्चो यजमानमच्छ॥
verses.tr: eto nva1dya sudhyo3 bhavāma pra ducchunā minavāmā varīyaḥ āre dveṣāṃsi sanutardadhāmā'yāma prāñco yajamānamaccha
verses.en: This day approach us: may our thoughts be holy, far from us let us cast away misfortune. Let us keep those who hate us at a distance, and haste to meet the man who sacrifices.

verses.sa:
एता धियं कृणवामा सखायोऽप या माताँ ऋणुत व्रजं गोः ।
यया मनुर्विशिशिप्रं जिगाय यया वणिग्वङ्कुरापा पुरीषम्॥
verses.tr: etā dhiyaṃ kṛṇavāmā sakhāyo'pa yā mātāṃ ṛṇuta vrajaṃ goḥ yayā manurviśiśipraṃ jigāya yayā vaṇigvaṅkurāpā purīṣam
verses.en: Come, let us carry out, O friends, the purpose wherewith the Mother threw the Cow's stall open, That wherewith Manu conquered Visisipra, wherewith the wandering merchant gained heaven's water.

verses.sa:
अनूनोदत्र हस्तयतो अद्रिरार्चन् येन दश मासो नवग्वाः ।
ऋतं यती सरमा गा अविन्दद् विश्वानि सत्याङ्गिराश्चकार॥
verses.tr: anūnodatra hastayato adrirārcan yena daśa māso navagvāḥ ṛtaṃ yatī saramā gā avindad viśvāni satyāṅgirāścakāra
verses.en: Here, urged by hands, loudly hath rung the press-stone wherewith Navagvas through ten months sang praises. Sarama went aright and found the cattle. Angiras gave effect to all their labours.

verses.sa:
विश्वे अस्या व्युषि माहिनायाः सं यद् गोभिरङ्गिरसो नवन्त ।
उत्स आसां परमे सधस्थ ऋतस्य पथा सरमा विदद् गाः॥
verses.tr: viśve asyā vyuṣi māhināyāḥ saṃ yad gobhiraṅgiraso navanta utsa āsāṃ parame sadhastha ṛtasya pathā saramā vidad gāḥ
verses.en: When at the dawning of this mighty Goddess, Angirases all sang forth with the cattle,- Their spring is in the loftiest place of meeting,-Sarama found the kine by Order's pathway.

verses.sa:
आ सूर्यो यातु सप्ताश्वः क्षेत्रं यदस्योर्विया दीर्घयाथे ।
रघुः श्येनः पतयदन्धो अच्छा युवा कविर्दीदयद् गोषु गच्छन्॥
verses.tr: ā sūryo yātu saptāśvaḥ kṣetraṃ yadasyorviyā dīrghayāthe raghuḥ śyenaḥ patayadandho acchā yuvā kavirdīdayad goṣu gacchan
verses.en: Borne by his Coursers Seven may Surya visit the field that spreadeth wide for his long journey. Down on the Soma swooped the rapid Falcon. Bright was the young Sage moving mid his cattle.

verses.sa:
आ सूर्यो अरुहच्छुक्रमर्णोऽयुक्त यद्धरितो वीतपृष्ठाः ।
उद्ना न नावमनयन्त धीरा आशृण्वतीरापो अर्वागतिष्ठन्॥
verses.tr: ā sūryo aruhacchukramarṇo'yukta yaddharito vītapṛṣṭhāḥ udnā na nāvamanayanta dhīrā āśṛṇvatīrāpo arvāgatiṣṭhan
verses.en: Surya hath mounted to the shining ocean when he hath yoked his fair-backed Tawny Horses. The wise have drawn him like a ship through water: the floods obedient have descended hither.

verses.sa:
धियं वो अप्सु दधिषे स्वर्षां ययातरन् दश मासो नवग्वाः ।
अया धिया स्याम देवगोपा अया धिया तुतुर्यामात्यंहः॥
verses.tr: dhiyaṃ vo apsu dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ yayātaran daśa māso navagvāḥ ayā dhiyā syāma devagopā ayā dhiyā tuturyāmātyaṃhaḥ
verses.en: I lay upon the Floods your hymn, light winning, wherewith Navagvas their ten months completed. Through this our hymn may we have Gods to guard us: through this our hymn pass safe beyond affliction.

verses.sa:
हयो न विद्वाँ अयुजि स्वयं धुरि तां वहामि प्रतरणीमवस्युवम् ।
नास्या वश्मि विमुचं नावृत पुनर्विद्वान् पथः पुरएत ऋजु नेषति॥
verses.tr: hayo na vidvāṃ ayuji svayaṃ dhuri tāṃ vahāmi prataraṇīmavasyuvam nāsyā vaśmi vimucaṃ nāvṛta punarvidvān pathaḥ puraeta ṛju neṣati
verses.en: Well knowing I have bound me, horselike, to the pole: I carry that which bears as on and gives us help. I seek for no release, no turning back therefrom. May he who knows the way, the Leader, guide me straight.

verses.sa:
अग्न इन्द्र वरुण मित्र देवाः शर्धः प्र यन्त मारुतोत विष्णो ।
उभा नासत्या रुद्रो अध ग्नाः पूषा भगः सरस्वती जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: agna indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta
verses.en: O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Visnu. May both Nasatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pusan, Sarasvati, Bhaga, accept us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणादितिं स्वः पृथिवीं द्यां मरुतः पर्वताँ अपः ।
हुवे विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं भगं नु शंसं सवितारमूतये॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditiṃ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ marutaḥ parvatāṃ apaḥ huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāramūtaye
verses.en: Indra and Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven, Visnu I call, Pusan, and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa, Savitar that they may help.

verses.sa:
उत नो विष्णुरुत वातो अस्रिधो द्रविणोदा उत सोमो मयस्करत् ।
उत ऋभव उत राये नो अश्विनोत त्वष्टोत विभ्वानु मंसते॥
verses.tr: uta no viṣṇuruta vāto asridho draviṇodā uta somo mayaskarat uta ṛbhava uta rāye no aśvinota tvaṣṭota vibhvānu maṃsate
verses.en: May Visnu also and Vata who injures none, and Soma granter of possessions give us joy; And may the Rbhus and the Asvins, Tvastar and Vibhvan remember us so that we may have wealth.

verses.sa:
उत त्यन्नो मारुतं शर्ध आ गमद् दिविक्षयं यजतं बर्हिरासदे ।
बृहस्पतिः शर्म पूषोत नो यमद् वरूथ्यं१ वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा॥
verses.tr: uta tyanno mārutaṃ śardha ā gamad divikṣayaṃ yajataṃ barhirāsade bṛhaspatiḥ śarma pūṣota no yamad varūthyaṃ1 varuṇo mitro aryamā
verses.en: So may the band of Maruts dwelling in the sky, the holy, come to us to sit on sacred grass; Brhaspati and Pusan grant us sure defense, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman guard and shelter us.

verses.sa:
उत त्ये नः पर्वतासः सुशस्तयः सुदीतयो नद्य१स्त्रामणे भुवन् ।
भगो विभक्ता शवसावसा गमदुरुव्यचा अदितिः श्रोतु मे हवम्॥
verses.tr: uta tye naḥ parvatāsaḥ suśastayaḥ sudītayo nadya1strāmaṇe bhuvan bhago vibhaktā śavasāvasā gamaduruvyacā aditiḥ śrotu me havam
verses.en: And may the Mountains famed in noble eulogies, and the fair-gleaming Rivers keep us safe from harm. May Bhaga the Dispenser come with power and grace, and far-pervading Aditi listen to my call.

verses.sa:
देवानां पत्नीरुशतीरवन्तु नः प्रावन्तु नस्तुजये वाजसातये ।
याः पार्थिवासो या अपामपि व्रते ता नो देवीः सुहवाः शर्म यच्छत॥
