verses.tr: devānāṃ patnīruśatīravantu naḥ prāvantu nastujaye vājasātaye yāḥ pārthivāso yā apāmapi vrate tā no devīḥ suhavāḥ śarma yacchata
verses.en: May the Gods' Spouses aid us of their own freewill, aid us to offspring and the winning of the spoil. Grant us protection, O ye gracious Goddesses, ye who are on the earth or in the waters' realm.

verses.sa:
उत ग्ना व्यन्तु देवपत्नीरिन्द्राण्य१ग्नाय्यश्विनी राट् ।
आ रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु व्यन्तु देवीर्य ऋतुर्जनीनाम्॥
verses.tr: uta gnā vyantu devapatnīrindrāṇya1gnāyyaśvinī rāṭ ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu vyantu devīrya ṛturjanīnām
verses.en: May the Dames, wives of Gods, enjoy our presents, Rat, Asvini, Agnayi, and Indrani. May Rodasi and Varunani hear us, and Goddesses come at the Matrons' season.

verses.sa:
प्रयुञ्जती दिव एति ब्रुवाणा मही माता दुहितुर्बोधयन्ती ।
आविवासन्ती युवतिर्मनीषा पितृभ्य आ सदने जोहुवाना॥
verses.tr: prayuñjatī diva eti bruvāṇā mahī mātā duhiturbodhayantī āvivāsantī yuvatirmanīṣā pitṛbhya ā sadane johuvānā
verses.en: Urging to toil and making proclamation, seeking Heaven's Daughter comes the Mighty Mother: She comes, the youthful Hymn, unto the Fathers, inviting to her home and loudly calling.

verses.sa:
अजिरासस्तदप ईयमाना आतस्थिवांसो अमृतस्य नाभिम् ।
अनन्तास उरवो विश्वतः सीं परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति पन्थाः॥
verses.tr: ajirāsastadapa īyamānā ātasthivāṃso amṛtasya nābhim anantāsa uravo viśvataḥ sīṃ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yanti panthāḥ
verses.en: Swift in their motion, hasting to their duty, reaching the central point of life immortal, On every side about the earth and heaven go forth the spacious paths without a limit.

verses.sa:
उक्षा समुद्रो अरुषः सुपर्णः पूर्वस्य योनिं पितुरा विवेश ।
मध्ये दिवो निहितः पृश्निरश्मा वि चक्रमे रजसस्पात्यन्तौ॥
verses.tr: ukṣā samudro aruṣaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yoniṃ piturā viveśa madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśniraśmā vi cakrame rajasaspātyantau
verses.en: Steer, Sea, Red Bird with strong wings, he hath entered the dwelling-place of the Primeval Father. A gay-hued Stone set in the midst of heaven, he hath gone forth and guards mid-air's two limits.

verses.sa:
चत्वार ईं बिभ्रति क्षेमयन्तो दश गर्भं चरसे धापयन्ते ।
त्रिधातवः परमा अस्य गावो दिवश्चरन्ति परि सद्यो अन्तान्॥
verses.tr: catvāra īṃ bibhrati kṣemayanto daśa garbhaṃ carase dhāpayante tridhātavaḥ paramā asya gāvo divaścaranti pari sadyo antān
verses.en: Four bear him up and give him rest and quiet, and ten invigorate the Babe for travel. His kine most excellent, of threefold nature, pass swiftly round the boundaries of heaven.

verses.sa:
इदं वपुर्निवचनं जनासश्चरन्ति यन्नद्यस्तस्थुरापः ।
द्वे यदीं बिभृतो मातुरन्ये इहेह जाते यम्या३ सबन्धू॥
verses.tr: idaṃ vapurnivacanaṃ janāsaścaranti yannadyastasthurāpaḥ dve yadīṃ bibhṛto māturanye iheha jāte yamyā3 sabandhū
verses.en: Wondrous, O people, is the mystic knowledge that while the waters stand the streams are flowing: That, separate from his Mother, Two support him, closely-united, twins, here made apparent.

verses.sa:
वि तन्वते धियो अस्मा अपांसि वस्त्रा पुत्राय मातरो वयन्ति ।
उपप्रक्षे वृषणो मोदमाना दिवस्पथा वध्वो यन्त्यच्छ॥
verses.tr: vi tanvate dhiyo asmā apāṃsi vastrā putrāya mātaro vayanti upaprakṣe vṛṣaṇo modamānā divaspathā vadhvo yantyaccha
verses.en: For him they lengthen prayers and acts of worship: the Mothers weave garments for him their offspring. Rejoicing, for the Steer's impregning contact, his Spouses move on paths or heaven to meet him.

verses.sa:
तदस्तु मित्रावरुणा तदग्ने शं योरस्मभ्यमिदमस्तु शस्तम् ।
अशीमहि गाधमुत प्रतिष्ठां नमो दिवे बृहते सादनाय॥
verses.tr: tadastu mitrāvaruṇā tadagne śaṃ yorasmabhyamidamastu śastam aśīmahi gādhamuta pratiṣṭhāṃ namo dive bṛhate sādanāya
verses.en: Be this our praise, O Varuna and Mitra may this be health and force to us, O Agni. May we obtain firm ground and room for resting: Glory to Heaven, the lofty habitation!

verses.sa:
कदु प्रियाय धाम्ने मनामहे स्वक्षत्राय स्वयशसे महे वयम् ।
आमेन्यस्य रजसो यदभ्र आँ अपो वृणाना वितनोति मायिनी॥
verses.tr: kadu priyāya dhāmne manāmahe svakṣatrāya svayaśase mahe vayam āmenyasya rajaso yadabhra āṃ apo vṛṇānā vitanoti māyinī
verses.en: What may we meditate for the beloved Power, mighty in native strength and glorious in itself, Which as a magic energy seeking waters spreads even to the immeasurable middle region's cloud?

verses.sa:
ता अत्नत वयुनं वीरवक्षणं समान्या वृतया विश्वमा रजः ।
अपो अपाचीरपरा अपेजते प्र पूर्वाभिस्तिरते देवयुर्जनः॥
verses.tr: tā atnata vayunaṃ vīravakṣaṇaṃ samānyā vṛtayā viśvamā rajaḥ apo apācīraparā apejate pra pūrvābhistirate devayurjanaḥ
verses.en: O'er all the region with their uniform advance these have spread out the lore that giveth heroes strength. Back, with their course reversed, the others pass away: the pious lengthens life with those that are before.

verses.sa:
आ ग्रावभिरहन्येभिरक्तुभिर्वरिष्ठं वज्रमा जिघर्ति मायिनि ।
शतं वा यस्य प्रचरन् त्स्वे दमे संवर्तयन्तो वि च वर्तयन्नहा॥
verses.tr: ā grāvabhirahanyebhiraktubhirvariṣṭhaṃ vajramā jigharti māyini śataṃ vā yasya pracaran tsve dame saṃvartayanto vi ca vartayannahā
verses.en: With pressing-stones and with the bright beams of the day he hurls his broadest bolt against the Guileful One. Even he whose hundred wander in his own abode, driving the days afar and bringing them again.

verses.sa:
तामस्य रीतिं परशोरिव प्रत्यनीकमख्यं भुजे अस्य वर्पसः ।
सचा यदि पितुमन्तमिव क्षयं रत्नं दधाति भरहूतये विशे॥
verses.tr: tāmasya rītiṃ paraśoriva pratyanīkamakhyaṃ bhuje asya varpasaḥ sacā yadi pitumantamiva kṣayaṃ ratnaṃ dadhāti bharahūtaye viśe
verses.en: I, to enjoy the beauty of his form, behold that rapid rush of his as 'twere an axe's edge, What time he gives the man who calls on him in fight wealth like a dwelling-house filled full with store of food.

verses.sa:
स जिह्वया चतुरनीक ऋञ्जते चारु वसानो वरुणो यतन्नरिम् ।
न तस्य विद्म पुरुषत्वता वयं यतो भगः सविता दाति वार्यम्॥
verses.tr: sa jihvayā caturanīka ṛñjate cāru vasāno varuṇo yatannarim na tasya vidma puruṣatvatā vayaṃ yato bhagaḥ savitā dāti vāryam
verses.en: Four-faced and nobly clad, Varuna, urging on the pious to his task, stirs himself with the tongue. Naught by our human nature do we know of him, him from whom Bhaga Savitar bestows the boon.

verses.sa:
देवं वो अद्य सवितारमेषे भगं च रत्नं विभजन्तमायोः ।
आ वां नरा पुरुभुजा ववृत्यां दिवेदिवे चिदश्विना सखीयन्॥
verses.tr: devaṃ vo adya savitārameṣe bhagaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantamāyoḥ ā vāṃ narā purubhujā vavṛtyāṃ divedive cidaśvinā sakhīyan
verses.en: This day I bring God Savitar to meet you, and Bhaga who allots the wealth of mortals. You, Asvins, Heroes rich in treasures, daily seeking your friendship fain would I turn hither.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्रयाणमसुरस्य विद्वान् त्सूक्तैर्देवं सवितारं दुवस्य ।
उप ब्रुवीत नमसा विजानञ्ज्येष्ठं च रत्नं विभजन्तमायोः॥
verses.tr: prati prayāṇamasurasya vidvān tsūktairdevaṃ savitāraṃ duvasya upa bruvīta namasā vijānañjyeṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ vibhajantamāyoḥ
verses.en: Knowing full well the Asura's time of coming, worship God Savitar with hymns and praises. Let him who rightly knoweth speak with homage to him who dealeth out man's noblest treasure.

verses.sa:
अदत्रया दयते वार्याणि पूषा भगो अदितिर्वस्त उस्रः ।
इन्द्रो विष्णुर्वरुणो मित्रो अग्निरहानि भद्रा जनयन्त दस्माः॥
verses.tr: adatrayā dayate vāryāṇi pūṣā bhago aditirvasta usraḥ indro viṣṇurvaruṇo mitro agnirahāni bhadrā janayanta dasmāḥ
verses.en: Not for reward doth Pusan send his blessings, Bhaga, or Aditi: his garb is splendour. May Indra, Visniu, Varuna, Mitra, Agni produce auspicious days, the Wonder-Workers.

verses.sa:
तन्नो अनर्वा सविता वरूथं तत् सिन्धव इषयन्तो अनु ग्मन् ।
उप यद् वोचे अध्वरस्य होता रायः स्याम पतयो वाजरत्नाः॥
verses.tr: tanno anarvā savitā varūthaṃ tat sindhava iṣayanto anu gman upa yad voce adhvarasya hotā rāyaḥ syāma patayo vājaratnāḥ
verses.en: Sending the shelter which we ask, the foeless Savitar and the Rivers shall approach us. When I, the sacrifice's priest, invite them, may we he lords of wealth and rich possessions.

verses.sa:
प्र ये वसुभ्य ईवदा नमो दुर्ये मित्रे वरुणे सूक्तवाचः ।
अवैत्वभ्वं कृणुता वरीयो दिवस्पृथिव्योरवसा मदेम॥
verses.tr: pra ye vasubhya īvadā namo durye mitre varuṇe sūktavācaḥ avaitvabhvaṃ kṛṇutā varīyo divaspṛthivyoravasā madema
verses.en: They who devote such worship to the Vasus, singing their hymns to Varuna and Mitra, Vouchsafe them ample room, far off be danger. Through grace of Heaven and Earth may we be happy.

verses.sa:
विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम् ।
विश्वो राय इषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे॥
verses.tr: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase
verses.en: Let every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth and seeks renown to prosper him.

verses.sa:
ते ते देव नेतर्ये चेमाँ अनुशसे ।
ते राया ते ह्या३पृचे सचेमहि सचथ्यैः॥
verses.tr: te te deva netarye cemāṃ anuśase te rāyā te hyā3pṛce sacemahi sacathyaiḥ
verses.en: These, leading God, are thine, and these here ready to speak after us. As such may we attain to wealth and wait with services on thee.

verses.sa:
अतो न आ नॄनतिथीनतः पत्नीर्दशस्यत ।
आरे विश्वं पथेष्ठां द्विषो युयोतु यूयुविः॥
verses.tr: ato na ā nṝnatithīnataḥ patnīrdaśasyata āre viśvaṃ patheṣṭhāṃ dviṣo yuyotu yūyuviḥ
verses.en: So further honour as our guests the Hero Gods and then the Dames. May he remove and keep afar our foes and all who block our path.

verses.sa:
यत्र वह्निरभिहितो दुद्रवद् द्रोण्यः पशुः ।
नृमणा वीरपस्त्योऽर्णा धीरेव सनिता॥
verses.tr: yatra vahnirabhihito dudravad droṇyaḥ paśuḥ nṛmaṇā vīrapastyo'rṇā dhīreva sanitā
verses.en: Where fire is set, and swiftly runs the victim dwelling in the trough, He wins, with heroes in his home, friendly to man, like constant streams.

verses.sa:
एष ते देव नेता रथस्पतिः शं रयिः ।
शं राये शं स्वस्तय इषःस्तुतो मनामहे देवस्तुतो मनामहे॥
verses.tr: eṣa te deva netā rathaspatiḥ śaṃ rayiḥ śaṃ rāye śaṃ svastaya iṣaḥstuto manāmahe devastuto manāmahe
verses.en: May these thy riches, Leader God! that rule the car, be blest to us, Yea, blest to us for wealth and weal. This will we ponder praising strength, this ponder as we praise the God.

verses.sa: अग्ने सुतस्य पीतये विश्वैरूमेभिरा गहि । देवेभिर्हव्यदातये॥
verses.tr: agne sutasya pītaye viśvairūmebhirā gahi devebhirhavyadātaye
verses.en: With all assistants, Agni, come hither to drink the Soma-juice; With Gods unto our sacred gifts.

verses.sa: ऋतधीतय आ गत सत्यधर्माणो अध्वरम् । अग्नेः पिबत जिह्वया॥
verses.tr: ṛtadhītaya ā gata satyadharmāṇo adhvaram agneḥ pibata jihvayā
verses.en: Come to the sacrifice, O ye whose ways are right, whose laws are true, And drink the draught with Agni's tongue.

verses.sa: विप्रेभिर्विप्र सन्त्य प्रातर्यावभिरा गहि । देवेभिः सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: viprebhirvipra santya prātaryāvabhirā gahi devebhiḥ somapītaye
verses.en: O Singer, with the singers, O Gracious, with those who move at dawn, Come to the Soma-draught with Gods.

verses.sa: अयं सोमश्चमू सुतोऽमत्रे परि षिच्यते । प्रिय इन्द्राय वायवे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ somaścamū suto'matre pari ṣicyate priya indrāya vāyave
verses.en: To Indra and to Vayu dear, this Soma, by the mortar pressed, Is now poured forth to fill the jar.

verses.sa: वायवा याहि वीतये जुषाणो हव्यदातये । पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो अभि प्रयः॥
verses.tr: vāyavā yāhi vītaye juṣāṇo havyadātaye pibā sutasyāndhaso abhi prayaḥ
verses.en: Vayu, come hither to the feast, well pleased unto our sacred gifts: Drink of the Soma juice effused come to the food.

verses.sa: इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सुतानां पीतिमर्हथः । ताञ्जुषेथामरेपसावभि प्रयः॥
verses.tr: indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ sutānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ tāñjuṣethāmarepasāvabhi prayaḥ
verses.en: Ye, Indra, Vayu, well deserve to drink the juices pressed by us. Gladly accept them, spotless Pair come to the food.

verses.sa: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । निम्नं न यन्ति सिन्धवोऽभि प्रयः॥
verses.tr: sutā indrāya vāyave somāso dadhyāśiraḥ nimnaṃ na yanti sindhavo'bhi prayaḥ
verses.en: For Indra and for Vayu pressed are Soma juices blent with curd, As rivers to the lowland flow: come to the food.

verses.sa: सजूर्विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरश्विभ्यामुषसा सजूः । आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत् सुते रण॥
verses.tr: sajūrviśvebhirdevebhiraśvibhyāmuṣasā sajūḥ ā yāhyagne atrivat sute raṇa
verses.en: Associate with all the Gods, come, with the Asvins and with Dawn, Agni, as erst with Atri, so enjoy the juice.

verses.sa: सजूर्मित्रावरुणाभ्यां सजूः सोमेन विष्णुना । आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत् सुते रण॥
verses.tr: sajūrmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ sajūḥ somena viṣṇunā ā yāhyagne atrivat sute raṇa
verses.en: Associate with Varuna, with Mitra, Soma, Visnu, come, Agni, as erstwith Atri, so enjoy the juice.

verses.sa: सजूरादित्यैर्वसुभिः सजूरिन्द्रेण वायुना । आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत् सुते रण॥
verses.tr: sajūrādityairvasubhiḥ sajūrindreṇa vāyunā ā yāhyagne atrivat sute raṇa
verses.en: Associate with Vasus, with Adityas, Indra, Viyu, come, Agni as erst with Atri, so enjoy the juice.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति नो मिमीतामश्विना भगः स्वस्ति देव्यदितिरनर्वणः ।
स्वस्ति पूषा असुरो दधातु नः स्वस्ति द्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना॥
verses.tr: svasti no mimītāmaśvinā bhagaḥ svasti devyaditiranarvaṇaḥ svasti pūṣā asuro dadhātu naḥ svasti dyāvāpṛthivī sucetunā
verses.en: May Bhaga and the Asvins grant us health and wealth, and Goddess Adid and he whom none resist. The Asura Pusan grant us all prosperity, and Heaven and Earth most wise vouchsafe us happiness.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तये वायुमुप ब्रवामहै सोमं स्वस्ति भुवनस्य यस्पतिः ।
बृहस्पतिं सर्वगणं स्वस्तये स्वस्तय आदित्यासो भवन्तु नः॥
verses.tr: svastaye vāyumupa bravāmahai somaṃ svasti bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ bṛhaspatiṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye svastaya ādityāso bhavantu naḥ
verses.en: Let us solicit Vayu for prosperity, and Soma who is Lord of all the world for weal; For weal Brhaspati with all his company. May the Adityas bring us health and happiness.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा नो अद्या स्वस्तये वैश्वानरो वसुरग्निः स्वस्तये ।
देवा अवन्त्वृभवः स्वस्तये स्वस्ति नो रुद्रः पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: viśve devā no adyā svastaye vaiśvānaro vasuragniḥ svastaye devā avantvṛbhavaḥ svastaye svasti no rudraḥ pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: May all the Gods, may Agni the beneficent, God of all men, this day be with us for our weal. Help us the Rbhus, the Divine Ones, for our good. May Rudra bless and keep us from calamity.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति मित्रावरुणा स्वस्ति पथ्ये रेवति ।
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च स्वस्ति नो अदिते कृधि॥
verses.tr: svasti mitrāvaruṇā svasti pathye revati svasti na indraścāgniśca svasti no adite kṛdhi
verses.en: Prosper us, Mitra, Varuna. O wealthy Pathya, prosper us. Indra and Agni, prosper us; prosper us thou, O Aditi.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति पन्थामनु चरेम सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविव ।
पुनर्ददताघ्नता जानता सं गमेमहि॥
verses.tr: svasti panthāmanu carema sūryācandramasāviva punardadatāghnatā jānatā saṃ gamemahi
verses.en: Like Sun and Moon may we pursue in full prosperity our path, And meet with one who gives again, -who knows us well and slays us not.

verses.sa:
प्र श्यावाश्व धृष्णुयार्चा मरुद्भिॠक्वभिः ।
ये अद्रोघमनुष्वधं श्रवो मदन्ति यज्ञियाः॥
verses.tr: pra śyāvāśva dhṛṣṇuyārcā marudbhiṝkvabhiḥ ye adroghamanuṣvadhaṃ śravo madanti yajñiyāḥ
verses.en: Sing boldly forth, Syavasva, with the Maruts who are loud in song, Who, holy, as their wont is, joy in glory that is free from guile.

verses.sa:
ते हि स्थिरस्य शवसः सखायः सन्ति धृष्णुया ।
ते यामन्ना धृषद्विनस्त्मना पान्ति शश्वतः॥
verses.tr: te hi sthirasya śavasaḥ sakhāyaḥ santi dhṛṣṇuyā te yāmannā dhṛṣadvinastmanā pānti śaśvataḥ
verses.en: For in their boldness they are friends of firm and sure heroic strength. They in their course, bold-spirited, guard all men of their own accord.

verses.sa:
ते स्यन्द्रासो नोक्षणोऽति ष्कन्दन्ति शर्वरीः ।
मरुतामधा महो दिवि क्षमा च मन्महे॥
verses.tr: te syandrāso nokṣaṇo'ti ṣkandanti śarvarīḥ marutāmadhā maho divi kṣamā ca manmahe
verses.en: Like steers in rapid motion they advance and overtake the nights; And thus the Maruts' power in heaven and on the earth we celebrate.

verses.sa:
मरुत्सु वो दधीमहि स्तोमं यज्ञं च धृष्णुया ।
विश्वे ये मानुषा युगा पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः॥
verses.tr: marutsu vo dadhīmahi stomaṃ yajñaṃ ca dhṛṣṇuyā viśve ye mānuṣā yugā pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ
verses.en: With boldness to your Maruts let us offer laud and sacrifice: Who all, through ages of mankind, guard mortal man from injury.

verses.sa:
अर्हन्तो ये सुदानवो नरो असामिशवसः ।
प्र यज्ञं यज्ञियेभ्यो दिवो अर्चा मरुद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: arhanto ye sudānavo naro asāmiśavasaḥ pra yajñaṃ yajñiyebhyo divo arcā marudbhyaḥ
verses.en: Praiseworthy, givers of good gifts, Heroes with full and perfect strength - To Maruts, Holy Ones of heaven, will I extol the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आ रुक्मैरा युधा नर ऋष्वा ऋष्टीरसृक्षत ।
अन्वेनाँ अह विद्युतो मरुतो जज्झतीरिव भानुरर्त त्मना दिवः॥
verses.tr: ā rukmairā yudhā nara ṛṣvā ṛṣṭīrasṛkṣata anvenāṃ aha vidyuto maruto jajjhatīriva bhānurarta tmanā divaḥ
verses.en: The lofty Heroes cast their spears and weapons bright with gleaming gold. After these Maruts followed close, like laughing lightning from the sky, a splendour of its own accord.

verses.sa:
ये वावृधन्त पार्थिवा य उरावन्तरिक्ष आ ।
वृजने वा नदीनां सधस्थे वा महो दिवः॥
verses.tr: ye vāvṛdhanta pārthivā ya urāvantarikṣa ā vṛjane vā nadīnāṃ sadhasthe vā maho divaḥ
verses.en: They who waxed mighty, of the earth, they who are in the wide mid-air, Or in the rivers' compass, or in the abode of ample heaven.

verses.sa:
शर्धो मारुतमुच्छंस सत्यशवसमृभ्वसम् ।
उत स्म ते शुभे नरः प्र स्यन्द्रा युजत त्मना॥
verses.tr: śardho mārutamucchaṃsa satyaśavasamṛbhvasam uta sma te śubhe naraḥ pra syandrā yujata tmanā
verses.en: Praise thou the Maruts' company, the valorous and truly strong, The Heroes, hasting, by themselves have yoked their deer for victory.

verses.sa:
उत स्म ते परुष्ण्यामूर्णा वसत शुन्ध्यवः ।
उत पव्या रथानामद्रिं भिन्दन्त्योजसा॥
verses.tr: uta sma te paruṣṇyāmūrṇā vasata śundhyavaḥ uta pavyā rathānāmadriṃ bhindantyojasā
verses.en: Fair-gleaming, on Parusni they have clothed themselves in robes of wool, And with their chariot tires they cleave the rock asunder in their might.

verses.sa:
आपथयो विपथयोऽन्तस्पथा अनुपथाः ।
एतेभिर्मह्यं नामभिर्यज्ञं विष्टार ओहते॥
verses.tr: āpathayo vipathayo'ntaspathā anupathāḥ etebhirmahyaṃ nāmabhiryajñaṃ viṣṭāra ohate
verses.en: Whether as wanderers from the way or speeders on or to the path, Under these names the spreading band tend well the sacrifice for me.

verses.sa:
अधा नरो न्योहतेऽधा नियुत ओहते ।
अधा पारावता इति चित्रा रूपाणि दर्श्या॥
verses.tr: adhā naro nyohate'dhā niyuta ohate adhā pārāvatā iti citrā rūpāṇi darśyā
verses.en: To this the Heroes well attend, well do their teams attend to this. Visible are their varied forms. Behold, they are Paravatas.

verses.sa:
छन्दःस्तुभः कुभन्यव उत्समा कीरिणो नृतुः ।
ते मे के चिन्न तायव ऊमा आसन् दृशि त्विषे॥
verses.tr: chandaḥstubhaḥ kubhanyava utsamā kīriṇo nṛtuḥ te me ke cinna tāyava ūmā āsan dṛśi tviṣe
verses.en: Hymn-singing, seeking water, they, praising, have danced about the spring. What are they unto me? No thieves, but helpers, splendid to behold.

verses.sa:
य ऋष्वा ऋष्टिविद्युतः कवयः सन्ति वेधसः ।
तमृषे मारुतं गणं नमस्या रमया गिरा॥
verses.tr: ya ṛṣvā ṛṣṭividyutaḥ kavayaḥ santi vedhasaḥ tamṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ namasyā ramayā girā
verses.en: Sublime, with lightnings for their spears, Sages and Orderers are they. Rsi, adore that Marut host, and make them happy with thy song.

verses.sa:
अच्छ ऋषे मारुतं गणं दाना मित्रं न योषणा ।
दिवो वा धृष्णव ओजसा स्तुता धीभिरिषण्यत॥
verses.tr: accha ṛṣe mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ dānā mitraṃ na yoṣaṇā divo vā dhṛṣṇava ojasā stutā dhībhiriṣaṇyata
verses.en: Rsi, invite the Marut band with offerings, as a maid her friend. From heaven, too, Bold Ones, in your might haste hither glorified with songs.

verses.sa:
नू मन्वान एषां देवाँ अच्छा न वक्षणा ।
दाना सचेत सूरिभिर्यामश्रुतेभिरञ्जिभिः॥
verses.tr: nū manvāna eṣāṃ devāṃ acchā na vakṣaṇā dānā saceta sūribhiryāmaśrutebhirañjibhiḥ
verses.en: Thinking of these now let him come, as with the escort of the Gods, And with the splendid Princes, famed for rapid courses, to the gifts.

verses.sa:
प्र ये मे बन्ध्वेषे गां वोचन्त सूरयः पृश्निं वोचन्त मातरम् ।
अधा पितरमिष्मिणं रुद्रं वोचन्त शिक्वसः॥
verses.tr: pra ye me bandhveṣe gāṃ vocanta sūrayaḥ pṛśniṃ vocanta mātaram adhā pitaramiṣmiṇaṃ rudraṃ vocanta śikvasaḥ
verses.en: Princes, who, when I asked their kin, named Prsni as their Mother-cow, And the impetuous Rudra they, the Mighty Ones, declared their Sire.

verses.sa:
सप्त मे सप्त शाकिन एकमेका शता ददुः ।
यमुनायामधि श्रुतमुद् राधो गव्यं मृजे नि राधो अश्व्यं मृजे॥
verses.tr: sapta me sapta śākina ekamekā śatā daduḥ yamunāyāmadhi śrutamud rādho gavyaṃ mṛje ni rādho aśvyaṃ mṛje
verses.en: The mighty ones, the seven times seven, have singly given me hundred gifts. I have obtained on Yamuna famed wealth in kine and wealth in steeds.

verses.sa:
को वेद जानमेषां को वा पुरा सुम्नेष्वास मरुताम् ।
यद् युयुज्रे किलास्यः॥
verses.tr: ko veda jānameṣāṃ ko vā purā sumneṣvāsa marutām yad yuyujre kilāsyaḥ
verses.en: Who knows the birth of these, or who lived in the Maruts' favour in the days of old What time their spotted deer were yoked?

verses.sa:
ऐतान् रथेषु तस्थुषः कः शुश्राव कथा ययुः ।
कस्मै सस्रुः सुदासे अन्वापय इळाभिर्वृष्टयः सह॥
verses.tr: aitān ratheṣu tasthuṣaḥ kaḥ śuśrāva kathā yayuḥ kasmai sasruḥ sudāse anvāpaya iḻābhirvṛṣṭayaḥ saha
verses.en: Who, when they stood upon their cars, hath heard them tell the way they went? Who was the bounteous man to whom their kindred rains flowed down with food of sacrifice?

verses.sa:
ते म आहुर्य आययुरुप द्युभिर्विभिर्मदे ।
नरो मर्या अरेपस इमान् पश्यन्निति ष्टुहि॥
verses.tr: te ma āhurya āyayurupa dyubhirvibhirmade naro maryā arepasa imān paśyanniti ṣṭuhi
verses.en: To me they told it, and they came with winged steeds radiant to the draught, Youths, Heroes free from spot or stain: Behold us here and praise thou us;

verses.sa:
ये अञ्जिषु ये वाशीषु स्वभानवः स्रक्षु रुक्मेषु खादिषु ।
श्राया रथेषु धन्वसु॥
verses.tr: ye añjiṣu ye vāśīṣu svabhānavaḥ srakṣu rukmeṣu khādiṣu śrāyā ratheṣu dhanvasu
verses.en: Who shine self-luminous with ornaments and swords, with breastplates, armlets, and with wreaths, Arrayed on chariots and with bows.

verses.sa:
युष्माकं स्मा रथाँ अनु मुदे दधे मरुतो जीरदानवः ।
वृष्टी द्यावो यतीरिव॥
verses.tr: yuṣmākaṃ smā rathāṃ anu mude dadhe maruto jīradānavaḥ vṛṣṭī dyāvo yatīriva
verses.en: O swift to pour your bounties down, ye Maruts, with delight I look upon your cars, Like splendours coming through the rain.

verses.sa:
आ यं नरः सुदानवो ददाशुषे दिवः कोशमचुच्यवुः ।
वि पर्जन्यं सृजन्ति रोदसी अनु धन्वना यन्ति वृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: ā yaṃ naraḥ sudānavo dadāśuṣe divaḥ kośamacucyavuḥ vi parjanyaṃ sṛjanti rodasī anu dhanvanā yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Munificent Heroes, they have cast heaven's treasury down for the worshipper's behoof: They set the storm-cloud free to stream through both the worlds, and rain floods flow o'er desert spots.

verses.sa:
ततृदानाः सिन्धवः क्षोदसा रजः प्र सस्रुर्धेनवो यथा ।
स्यन्ना अश्वा इवाध्वनो विमोचने वि यद् वर्तन्त एन्यः॥
verses.tr: tatṛdānāḥ sindhavaḥ kṣodasā rajaḥ pra sasrurdhenavo yathā syannā aśvā ivādhvano vimocane vi yad vartanta enyaḥ
verses.en: The bursting streams m billowy flood have spread abroad, like milch-kine, o'er the firmament. Like swift steeds hasting to their journey's resting-place, to every side run glittering brooks.

verses.sa:
आ यात मरुतो दिव आन्तरिक्षादमादुत ।
माव स्थात परावतः॥
verses.tr: ā yāta maruto diva āntarikṣādamāduta māva sthāta parāvataḥ
verses.en: Hither, O Maruts, come from heaven, from mid-air, or from near at hand Tarry not far away from us.

verses.sa:
मा वो रसानितभा कुभा क्रुमुर्मा वः सिन्धुर्नि रीरमत् ।
मा वः परि ष्ठात् सरयुः पुरीषिण्यस्मे इत् सुम्नमस्तु वः॥
verses.tr: mā vo rasānitabhā kubhā krumurmā vaḥ sindhurni rīramat mā vaḥ pari ṣṭhāt sarayuḥ purīṣiṇyasme it sumnamastu vaḥ
verses.en: So let not Rasa, Krumu, or Anitabha, Kubha, or Sindhu hold you back. Let not the watery Sarayti obstruct your way. With us be all the bliss ye give.

verses.sa:
तं वः शर्धं रथानां त्वेषं गणं मारुतं नव्यसीनाम् ।
अनु प्र यन्ति वृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ rathānāṃ tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām anu pra yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: That brilliant gathering of your cars, the company of Maruts, of the Youthful Ones, The rain-showers, speeding on, attend.

verses.sa:
शर्धंशर्धं व एषां व्रातंव्रातं गणंगणं सुशस्तिभिः ।
अनु क्रामेम धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: śardhaṃśardhaṃ va eṣāṃ vrātaṃvrātaṃ gaṇaṃgaṇaṃ suśastibhiḥ anu krāmema dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: With eulogies and hymns may we follow your army, troop by troop, and band by band, And company by company.

verses.sa: कस्मा अद्य सुजाताय रातहव्याय प्र ययुः । एना यामेन मरुतः॥
verses.tr: kasmā adya sujātāya rātahavyāya pra yayuḥ enā yāmena marutaḥ
verses.en: To what oblation-giver, sprung of noble ancestry, have sped The Maruts on this course to-day?

verses.sa:
येन तोकाय तनयाय धान्यं१ बीजं वहध्वे अक्षितम् ।
अस्मभ्यं तद् धत्तन यद् व ईमहे राधो विश्वायु सौभगम्॥
verses.tr: yena tokāya tanayāya dhānyaṃ1 bījaṃ vahadhve akṣitam asmabhyaṃ tad dhattana yad va īmahe rādho viśvāyu saubhagam
verses.en: Vouchsafe to us the bounty, that which we implore, through which, for child and progeny, Ye give the seed of corn that wasteth not away, and bliss that reacheth to all life.

verses.sa:
अतीयाम निदस्तिरः स्वस्तिभिर्हित्वावद्यमरातीः ।
वृष्ट्वी शं योराप उस्रि भेषजं स्याम मरुतः सह॥
verses.tr: atīyāma nidastiraḥ svastibhirhitvāvadyamarātīḥ vṛṣṭvī śaṃ yorāpa usri bheṣajaṃ syāma marutaḥ saha
verses.en: May we in safety pass by those who slander us, leaving behind disgrace and hate. Maruts, may we be there when ye, at dawn, in rest and toil, rain waters down and balm.

verses.sa: सुदेवः समहासति सुवीरो नरो मरुतः स मर्त्यः । यं त्रायध्वे स्याम ते॥
verses.tr: sudevaḥ samahāsati suvīro naro marutaḥ sa martyaḥ yaṃ trāyadhve syāma te
verses.en: Favoured by Gods shall he the man, O Heroes, Maruts! and possessed of noble sons, Whom ye protect. Such may we be.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि भोजान् त्स्तुवतो अस्य यामनि रणन् गावो न यवसे ।
यतः पूर्वाँ इव सखीँरनु ह्वय गिरा गृणीहि कामिनः॥
verses.tr: stuhi bhojān tstuvato asya yāmani raṇan gāvo na yavase yataḥ pūrvāṃ iva sakhīṃranu hvaya girā gṛṇīhi kāminaḥ
verses.en: Praise the Free-givers. At this liberal patron's rite they joy like cattle in the mead. So call thou unto them who come as ancient Friends: hymn those who love thee with a song.

verses.sa:
प्र शर्धाय मारुताय स्वभानव इमां वाचमनजा पर्वतच्युते ।
घर्मस्तुभे दिव आ पृष्ठयज्वने द्युम्नश्रवसे महि नृम्णमर्चत॥
verses.tr: pra śardhāya mārutāya svabhānava imāṃ vācamanajā parvatacyute gharmastubhe diva ā pṛṣṭhayajvane dyumnaśravase mahi nṛmṇamarcata
verses.en: This hymn will I make for the Marut host who bright in native splendour cast the mountains down. Sing the great strength of those illustrious in renown, who stay the heat, who sacrifice on heights of heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र वो मरुतस्तविषा उदन्यवो वयोवृधो अश्वयुजः परिज्रयः ।
सं विद्युता दधति वाशति त्रितः स्वरन्त्यापोऽवना परिज्रयः॥
verses.tr: pra vo marutastaviṣā udanyavo vayovṛdho aśvayujaḥ parijrayaḥ saṃ vidyutā dadhati vāśati tritaḥ svarantyāpo'vanā parijrayaḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, rich in water, strengtheners of life are your strong bands with harnessed steeds, that wander far. Trita roars out at him who aims the lightning-flash. The waters sweeping round are thundering on their way.

verses.sa:
विद्युन्महसो नरो अश्मदिद्यवो वातत्विषो मरुतः पर्वतच्युतः ।
अब्दया चिन्मुहुरा ह्रादुनीवृतः स्तनयदमा रभसा उदोजसः॥
verses.tr: vidyunmahaso naro aśmadidyavo vātatviṣo marutaḥ parvatacyutaḥ abdayā cinmuhurā hrādunīvṛtaḥ stanayadamā rabhasā udojasaḥ
verses.en: They gleam with lightning, Heroes, Casters of the Stone, wind-rapid Maruts, overthrowers of the bills, Oft through desire to rain coming with storm of hail, roaring in onset, violent and exceeding strong.

verses.sa:
व्य१क्तून् रुद्रा व्यहानि शिक्वसो व्य१न्तरिक्षं वि रजांसि धूतयः ।
वि यदज्राँ अजथ नाव ईं यथा वि दुर्गाणि मरुतो नाह रिष्यथ॥
verses.tr: vya1ktūn rudrā vyahāni śikvaso vya1ntarikṣaṃ vi rajāṃsi dhūtayaḥ vi yadajrāṃ ajatha nāva īṃ yathā vi durgāṇi maruto nāha riṣyatha
verses.en: When, mighty Rudras, through the nights and through the days, when through the sky and realms of air, shakers of all, When over the broad fields ye drive along like ships, e'en to strongholds ye come, Maruts, but are not harmed.

verses.sa:
तद् वीर्यं वो मरुतो महित्वनं दीर्घं ततान सूर्यो न योजनम् ।
एता न यामे अगृभीतशोचिषोऽनश्वदां यन्न्ययातना गिरिम्॥
verses.tr: tad vīryaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ dīrghaṃ tatāna sūryo na yojanam etā na yāme agṛbhītaśociṣo'naśvadāṃ yannyayātanā girim
verses.en: Maruts, this hero strength and majesty of yours hath, like the Sun, extended o'er a lengthened way, When in your course like deer with splendour unsubdued ye bowed the hill that gives imperishable rain.

verses.sa:
अभ्राजि शर्धो मरुतो यदर्णसं मोषथा वृक्षं कपनेव वेधसः ।
अध स्मा नो अरमतिं सजोषसश्चक्षुरिव यन्तमनु नेषथा सुगम्॥
verses.tr: abhrāji śardho maruto yadarṇasaṃ moṣathā vṛkṣaṃ kapaneva vedhasaḥ adha smā no aramatiṃ sajoṣasaścakṣuriva yantamanu neṣathā sugam
verses.en: Bright shone your host, ye Sages, Maruts, when ye smote the waving tree as when the worm consumeth it. Accordant, as the eye guides him who walks, have ye led our devotion onward by an easy path.

verses.sa:
न स जीयते मरुतो न हन्यते न स्रेधति न व्यथते न रिष्यति ।
नास्य राय उप दस्यन्ति नोतय ऋषिं वा यं राजानं वा सुषूदथ॥
verses.tr: na sa jīyate maruto na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na riṣyati nāsya rāya upa dasyanti notaya ṛṣiṃ vā yaṃ rājānaṃ vā suṣūdatha
verses.en: Never is he, O Maruts, slain or overcome, never doth he decay ne'er is distressed or harmed; His treasures, his resources, never waste away, whom. whether he be prince or Rsi, ye direct.

verses.sa:
नियुत्वन्तो ग्रामजितो यथा नरोऽर्यमणो न मरुतः कबन्धिनः ।
पिन्वन्त्युत्सं यदिनासो अस्वरन् व्युन्दन्ति पृथिवीं मध्वो अन्धसा॥
verses.tr: niyutvanto grāmajito yathā naro'ryamaṇo na marutaḥ kabandhinaḥ pinvantyutsaṃ yadināso asvaran vyundanti pṛthivīṃ madhvo andhasā
verses.en: With harnessed team like heroes overcoming troops, the friendly Maruts, laden with their water-casks, Let the spring flow, and when impetuous' they roar they inundate the earth with floods of pleasant meath.

verses.sa:
प्रवत्वतीयं पृथिवी मरुद्भ्यः प्रवत्वती द्यौर्भवति प्रयद्भ्यः ।
प्रवत्वतीः पथ्या अन्तरिक्ष्याः प्रवत्वन्तः पर्वता जीरदानवः॥
verses.tr: pravatvatīyaṃ pṛthivī marudbhyaḥ pravatvatī dyaurbhavati prayadbhyaḥ pravatvatīḥ pathyā antarikṣyāḥ pravatvantaḥ parvatā jīradānavaḥ
verses.en: Free for the Maruts is the earth with sloping ways, free for the rushing Ones is heaven with steep descents. The paths of air's mid-region are precipitous, precipitous the mountains with their running streams.

verses.sa:
यन्मरुतः सभरसः स्वर्णरः सूर्य उदिते मदथा दिवो नरः ।
न वोऽश्वाः श्रथयन्ताह सिस्रतः सद्यो अस्याध्वनः पारमश्नुथ॥
verses.tr: yanmarutaḥ sabharasaḥ svarṇaraḥ sūrya udite madathā divo naraḥ na vo'śvāḥ śrathayantāha sisrataḥ sadyo asyādhvanaḥ pāramaśnutha
verses.en: When, as the Sun hath risen up, ye take delight, O bounteous radiant Maruts, Heroes of the sky, Your coursers weary not when speeding on their way, and rapidly ye reach the end of this your path.

verses.sa:
अंसेषु व ऋष्टयः पत्सु खादयो वक्षःसु रुक्मा मरुतो रथे शुभः ।
अग्निभ्राजसो विद्युतो गभस्त्योः शिप्राः शीर्षसु वितता हिरण्ययीः॥
verses.tr: aṃseṣu va ṛṣṭayaḥ patsu khādayo vakṣaḥsu rukmā maruto rathe śubhaḥ agnibhrājaso vidyuto gabhastyoḥ śiprāḥ śīrṣasu vitatā hiraṇyayīḥ
verses.en: Lances are on your shoulders, anklets on your feet, gold chains are on your breasts, gems, Maruts, on your car. Lightnings aglow with flame are flashing in your hands, and visors wrought of gold are laid upon your heads.

verses.sa:
तं नाकमर्यो अगृभीतशोचिषं रुशत् पिप्पलं मरुतो वि धूनुथ ।
समच्यन्त वृजनातित्विषन्त यत्स्वरन्ति घोषं विततमृतायवः॥
verses.tr: taṃ nākamaryo agṛbhītaśociṣaṃ ruśat pippalaṃ maruto vi dhūnutha samacyanta vṛjanātitviṣanta yatsvaranti ghoṣaṃ vitatamṛtāyavaḥ
verses.en: Maruts, in eager stir ye shake the vault of heaven, splendid beyond conception, for its shining fruit. They gathered when they let their deeds of might flash forth. The Pious Ones send forth a far-resounding shout.

verses.sa:
युष्मादत्तस्य मरुतो विचेतसो रायः स्याम रथ्यो३ वयस्वतः ।
न यो युच्छति तिष्यो३ यथा दिवो३ऽस्मे रारन्त मरुतः सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: yuṣmādattasya maruto vicetaso rāyaḥ syāma rathyo3 vayasvataḥ na yo yucchati tiṣyo3 yathā divo3'sme rāranta marutaḥ sahasriṇam
verses.en: Sage Maruts, may we be the drivers of the car of riches full of life that have been given by you. O Maruts, let that wealth in thousands dwell with us which never vanishes like Tisya from the sky.

verses.sa:
यूयं रयिं मरुतः स्पार्हवीरं यूयमृषिमवथ सामविप्रम् ।
यूयमर्वन्तं भरताय वाजं यूयं धत्थ राजानं श्रुष्टिमन्तम्॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ rayiṃ marutaḥ spārhavīraṃ yūyamṛṣimavatha sāmavipram yūyamarvantaṃ bharatāya vājaṃ yūyaṃ dhattha rājānaṃ śruṣṭimantam
verses.en: Maruts, ye further wealth with longed for heroes, further the Rsi skilled in chanted verses. Ye give the Bharata as his strength, a charger, and ye bestow a king who quickly listens.

verses.sa:
तद् वो यामि द्रविणं सद्यऊतयो येना स्व१र्ण ततनाम नॄँरभि ।
इदं सु मे मरुतो हर्यता वचो यस्य तरेम तरसा शतं हिमाः॥
verses.tr: tad vo yāmi draviṇaṃ sadyaūtayo yenā sva1rṇa tatanāma nṝṃrabhi idaṃ su me maruto haryatā vaco yasya tarema tarasā śataṃ himāḥ
verses.en: Of you, most swift to succour! I solicit wealth wherewith we may spread forth mid men like as the Sun. Accept, O Maruts, graciously this hymn of mine that we may live a hundred winters through its power.

verses.sa:
प्रयज्यवो मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयो बृहद् वयो दधिरे रुक्मवक्षसः ।
ईयन्ते अश्वैः सुयमेभिराशुभिः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: prayajyavo maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayo bṛhad vayo dadhire rukmavakṣasaḥ īyante aśvaiḥ suyamebhirāśubhiḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: With gleaming lances, with their breasts adorned with gold, the Maruts, rushing onward, hold high power of life. They hasten with swift steeds easy to be controlled. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
स्वयं दधिध्वे तविषीं यथा विद बृहन्महान्त उर्विया वि राजथ ।
उतान्तरिक्षं ममिरे व्योजसा शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: svayaṃ dadhidhve taviṣīṃ yathā vida bṛhanmahānta urviyā vi rājatha utāntarikṣaṃ mamire vyojasā śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: Ye, as ye wist, have gained of your own selves your power: high, O ye Mighty Ones, and wide ye shine abroad. They with their strength have even measured out the sky. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
साकं जाताः सुभ्वः साकमुक्षिताः श्रिये चिदा प्रतरं वावृधुर्नरः ।
विरोकिणः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: sākaṃ jātāḥ subhvaḥ sākamukṣitāḥ śriye cidā prataraṃ vāvṛdhurnaraḥ virokiṇaḥ sūryasyeva raśmayaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: Strong, born together, they together have waxed great: the Heroes more and more have grown to majesty Resplendent as the Sun's beams in their light are they. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
आभूषेण्यं वो मरुतो महित्वनं दिदृक्षेण्यं सूर्यस्येव चक्षणम् ।
उतो अस्माँ अमृतत्वे दधातन शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: ābhūṣeṇyaṃ vo maruto mahitvanaṃ didṛkṣeṇyaṃ sūryasyeva cakṣaṇam uto asmāṃ amṛtatve dadhātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: Maruts, your mightiness deserves to be adored, sight to be longed for like the shining of the Sun. So lead us with your aid to immortality. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
उदीरयथा मरुतः समुद्रतो यूयं वृष्टिं वर्षयथा पुरीषिणः ।
न वो दस्रा उप दस्यन्ति धेनवः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: udīrayathā marutaḥ samudrato yūyaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ varṣayathā purīṣiṇaḥ na vo dasrā upa dasyanti dhenavaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: O Maruts, from the Ocean ye uplift the rain, and fraught with vaporous moisture pour the torrents down. Never, ye Wonder-Workers, are your Milch-kine dry. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
यदश्वान् धूर्षु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं हिरण्ययान् प्रत्यत्काँ अमुग्ध्वम् ।
विश्वा इत् स्पृधो मरुतो व्यस्यथ शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: yadaśvān dhūrṣu pṛṣatīrayugdhvaṃ hiraṇyayān pratyatkāṃ amugdhvam viśvā it spṛdho maruto vyasyatha śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: When to your car-poles ye have yoked your spotted deer to be your steeds, and put your golden mantles on, O Maruts, ye disperse all enemies abroad. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
न पर्वता न नद्यो वरन्त वो यत्राचिध्वं मरुतो गच्छथेदु तत् ।
उत द्यावापृथिवी याथना परि शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: na parvatā na nadyo varanta vo yatrācidhvaṃ maruto gacchathedu tat uta dyāvāpṛthivī yāthanā pari śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: Neither the mountains nor the rivers keep you back: whither ye have resolved thither ye, Maruts, go. Ye compass round about even the heaven and earth. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
यत् पूर्व्यं मरुतो यच्च नूतनं यदुद्यते वसवो यच्च शस्यते ।
विश्वस्य तस्य भवथा नवेदसः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: yat pūrvyaṃ maruto yacca nūtanaṃ yadudyate vasavo yacca śasyate viśvasya tasya bhavathā navedasaḥ śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: Whate'er is ancient, Maruts, what of recent time, whate'er is spoken, Vasus, what is chanted forth, They who take cognizance of all of this are ye. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
मृळत नो मरुतो मा वधिष्टनाऽस्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वि यन्तन ।
अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गातन शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत॥
verses.tr: mṛḻata no maruto mā vadhiṣṭanā'smabhyaṃ śarma bahulaṃ vi yantana adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gātana śubhaṃ yātāmanu rathā avṛtsata
verses.en: Be gracious unto us, ye Maruts, slay us not extend ye unto us shelter of many a sort. Pay due regard unto our friendship and our praise. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

verses.sa:
यूयमस्मान् नयत वस्यो अच्छा निरंहतिभ्यो मरुतो गृणानाः ।
जुषध्वं नो हव्यदातिं यजत्रा वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: yūyamasmān nayata vasyo acchā niraṃhatibhyo maruto gṛṇānāḥ juṣadhvaṃ no havyadātiṃ yajatrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: O Maruts, lead us on to higher fortune deliver us, when lauded, from afflictions. Accept, ye Holy Ones, the gifts we bring you. May we be masters of abundant riches.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शर्धन्तमा गणं पिष्टं रुक्मेभिरञ्जिभिः ।
विशो अद्य मरुतामव ह्वये दिवश्चिद् रोचनादधि॥
verses.tr: agne śardhantamā gaṇaṃ piṣṭaṃ rukmebhirañjibhiḥ viśo adya marutāmava hvaye divaścid rocanādadhi
verses.en: Agni, that valorous company adorned with ornaments of gold, The people of the Maruts, I call down to-day even from the luminous realm of heaven.

verses.sa:
यथा चिन्मन्यसे हृदा तदिन्मे जग्मुराशसः ।
ये ते नेदिष्ठं हवनान्यागमन् तान् वर्ध भीमसंदृशः॥
verses.tr: yathā cinmanyase hṛdā tadinme jagmurāśasaḥ ye te nediṣṭhaṃ havanānyāgaman tān vardha bhīmasaṃdṛśaḥ
verses.en: Even as thou thinkest in thy heart, thither my wishes also tend. Those who have come most near to thine invoking calls, strengthen them fearful to behold.

verses.sa:
मीळहुष्मतीव पृथिवी पराहता मदन्त्येत्यस्मदा ।
ऋक्षो न वो मरुतः शिमीवाँ अमो दुध्रो गौरिव भीमयुः॥
verses.tr: mīḻahuṣmatīva pṛthivī parāhatā madantyetyasmadā ṛkṣo na vo marutaḥ śimīvāṃ amo dudhro gauriva bhīmayuḥ
verses.en: Earth, like a bounteous lady, liberal of her gifts, struck down and shaken, yet exultant, comes to us. Impetuous as a bear, O Maruts, is you rush terrible as a dreadful bull..

verses.sa:
नि ये रिणन्त्योजसा वृथा गावो न दुर्धुरः ।
अश्मानं चित् स्वर्यं१ पर्वतं गिरिं प्र च्यावयन्ति यामभिः॥
verses.tr: ni ye riṇantyojasā vṛthā gāvo na durdhuraḥ aśmānaṃ cit svaryaṃ1 parvataṃ giriṃ pra cyāvayanti yāmabhiḥ
verses.en: They who with mighty strength o'erthrow like oxen difficult to yoke, Cause e'en the heavenly stone to shake ' yea, shake the rocky mountain as they race along.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठ नूनमेषां स्तोमैः समुक्षितानाम् ।
मरुतां पुरुतममपूर्व्यं गवां सर्गमिव ह्वये॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭha nūnameṣāṃ stomaiḥ samukṣitānām marutāṃ purutamamapūrvyaṃ gavāṃ sargamiva hvaye
verses.en: Rise up! even now with lauds I call the very numerous company, Unequalled, of these Maruts, like a herd of kine, grown up together in their strength.

verses.sa:
युङ्ग्ध्वं ह्यरुषी रथे युङ्ग्ध्वं रथेषु रोहितः ।
युङ्ग्ध्वं हरी अजिरा धुरि वोळहवे वहिष्ठा धुरि वोळहवे॥
verses.tr: yuṅgdhvaṃ hyaruṣī rathe yuṅgdhvaṃ ratheṣu rohitaḥ yuṅgdhvaṃ harī ajirā dhuri voḻahave vahiṣṭhā dhuri voḻahave
verses.en: Bind to your car the bright red mares, yoke the red coursers to your car. Bind to the pole, to draw, the fleet-foot tawny steeds, the best at drawing, to the pole.

verses.sa:
उत स्य वाज्यरुषस्तुविष्वणिरिह स्म धायि दर्शतः ।
मा वो यामेषु मरुतश्चिरं करत् प्र तं रथेषु चोदत॥
verses.tr: uta sya vājyaruṣastuviṣvaṇiriha sma dhāyi darśataḥ mā vo yāmeṣu marutaściraṃ karat pra taṃ ratheṣu codata
verses.en: Yea, and this loudly-neighing bright red vigorous horse who hath been stationed, fair to see, Let him not cause delay, O Maruts,, in your course, urge ye him onward in your cars.

verses.sa:
रथं नु मारुतं वयं श्रवस्युमा हुवामहे ।
आ यस्मिन् तस्थौ सुरणानि बिभ्रती सचा मरुत्सु रोदसी॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ nu mārutaṃ vayaṃ śravasyumā huvāmahe ā yasmin tasthau suraṇāni bibhratī sacā marutsu rodasī
verses.en: The Maruts' chariot, ever fain to gather glory, we invoke, Which Rodasi hath mounted, bringing pleasant gifts, with Maruts in her company.

verses.sa:
तं वः शर्धं रथेशुभं त्वेषं पनस्युमा हुवे ।
यस्मिन् त्सुजाता सुभगा महीयते सचा मरुत्सु मीळहुषी॥
verses.tr: taṃ vaḥ śardhaṃ ratheśubhaṃ tveṣaṃ panasyumā huve yasmin tsujātā subhagā mahīyate sacā marutsu mīḻahuṣī
verses.en: I call that brilliant band of yours, adorable, rapid on the car Whereon the bounteous Dame, auspicious, nobly born, shows glorious with the Marut host.

verses.sa:
आ रुद्रास इन्द्रवन्तः सजोषसो हिरण्यरथाः सुविताय गन्तन ।
इयं वो अस्मत् प्रति हर्यते मतिस्तृष्णजे न दिव उत्सा उदन्यवे॥
verses.tr: ā rudrāsa indravantaḥ sajoṣaso hiraṇyarathāḥ suvitāya gantana iyaṃ vo asmat prati haryate matistṛṣṇaje na diva utsā udanyave
verses.en: Of one accord, with Indra, O ye Rudras, come borne on your golden car for our prosperity. An offering from us, this hymn is brought to you, as, unto one who thirsts for water, heavenly springs.

verses.sa:
वाशीमन्त ऋष्टिमन्तो मनीषिणः सुधन्वान इषुमन्तो निषङ्गिणः ।
स्वश्वाः स्थ सुरथाः पृश्निमातरः स्वायुधा मरुतो याथना शुभम्॥
verses.tr: vāśīmanta ṛṣṭimanto manīṣiṇaḥ sudhanvāna iṣumanto niṣaṅgiṇaḥ svaśvāḥ stha surathāḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ svāyudhā maruto yāthanā śubham
verses.en: Armed with your daggers, full of wisdom, armed with spears, armed with your quivers, armed with arrows, with good bows, Good horses and good cars have ye, O Prsni's Sons: ye, Maruts, with good weapons go to victory.

verses.sa:
धूनुथ द्यां पर्वतान् दाशुषे वसु नि वो वना जिहते यामनो भिया ।
कोपयथ पृथिवीं पृश्निमातरः शुभे यदुग्राः पृषतीरयुग्ध्वम्॥
verses.tr: dhūnutha dyāṃ parvatān dāśuṣe vasu ni vo vanā jihate yāmano bhiyā kopayatha pṛthivīṃ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhe yadugrāḥ pṛṣatīrayugdhvam
verses.en: From hills and heaven ye shake wealth for the worshipper: in terror at your coming low the woods bow down. Ye make the earth to tremble, Sons of Prsni, when for victory ye have yoked, fierce Ones! your spotted deer.

verses.sa:
वातत्विषो मरुतो वर्षनिर्णिजो यमा इव सुसदृशः सुपेशसः ।
पिशङ्गाश्वा अरुणाश्वा अरेपसः प्रत्वक्षसो महिना द्यौरिवोरवः॥
verses.tr: vātatviṣo maruto varṣanirṇijo yamā iva susadṛśaḥ supeśasaḥ piśaṅgāśvā aruṇāśvā arepasaḥ pratvakṣaso mahinā dyaurivoravaḥ
verses.en: Bright with the blasts of wind, wrapped in their robes of rain, like twins of noble aspect and of lovely form, The Maruts, spotless, with steeds tawny hued and red, strong in their mightiness and spreading wide like heaven.

verses.sa:
पुरुद्रप्सा अञ्जिमन्तः सुदानवस्त्वेषसंदृशो अनवभ्रराधसः ।
सुजातासो जनुषा रुक्मवक्षसो दिवो अर्का अमृतं नाम भेजिरे॥
verses.tr: purudrapsā añjimantaḥ sudānavastveṣasaṃdṛśo anavabhrarādhasaḥ sujātāso januṣā rukmavakṣaso divo arkā amṛtaṃ nāma bhejire
verses.en: Rich in adornment, rich in drops, munificent, bright in their aspect, yielding bounties that endure, Noble by birth, adorned with gold upon their breasts, the Singers of the sky have won immortal fame.

verses.sa:
ऋष्टयो वो मरुतो अंसयोरधि सह ओजो बाह्वोर्वो बलं हितम् ।
नृम्णा शीर्षस्वायुधा रथेषु वो विश्वा वः श्रीरधि तनूषु पिपिशे॥
verses.tr: ṛṣṭayo vo maruto aṃsayoradhi saha ojo bāhvorvo balaṃ hitam nṛmṇā śīrṣasvāyudhā ratheṣu vo viśvā vaḥ śrīradhi tanūṣu pipiśe
verses.en: Borne on both shoulders, O ye Maruts, are your spears: within your arms is laid your energy and 3trength. Bold thoughts are in your heads, your weapons in your cars, all glorious majesty is moulded on your forms.

verses.sa:
गोमदश्वावद् रथवत् सुवीरं चन्द्रवद् राधो मरुतो ददा नः ।
प्रशस्तिं नः कृणुत रुद्रियासो भक्षीय वोऽवसो दैव्यस्य॥
verses.tr: gomadaśvāvad rathavat suvīraṃ candravad rādho maruto dadā naḥ praśastiṃ naḥ kṛṇuta rudriyāso bhakṣīya vo'vaso daivyasya
verses.en: Vouchsafe to us, O Maruts, splendid bounty in cattle and in steeds, in cars and heroes. Children of Rudra, give us high distinction: may I enjoy your Godlike help and favour.

verses.sa:
हये नरो मरुतो मृळता नस्तुवीमघासो अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
सत्यश्रुतः कवयो युवानो बृहद्गिरयो बृहदुक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: haye naro maruto mṛḻatā nastuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Ho! Maruts, Heroes, skilled in Law, immortal, be gracious unto us, ye rich in treasures, Ye hearers of the truth, ye sage and youthful, grown mighty, dwelling on the lofty mountains.

verses.sa:
तमु नूनं तविषीमन्तमेषां स्तुषे गणं मारुतं नव्यसीनाम् ।
य आश्वश्वा अमवद् वहन्त उतेशिरे अमृतस्य स्वराजः॥
verses.tr: tamu nūnaṃ taviṣīmantameṣāṃ stuṣe gaṇaṃ mārutaṃ navyasīnām ya āśvaśvā amavad vahanta uteśire amṛtasya svarājaḥ
verses.en: Now do I glorify their mighty cohort, the company of these the youthful Maruts, Who ride impetuous on with rapid horses, and radiant in themselves, are Lords of Amrta.

verses.sa:
त्वेषं गणं तवसं खादिहस्तं धुनिव्रतं मायिनं दातिवारम् ।
मयोभुवो ये अमिता महित्वा वन्दस्व विप्र तुविराधसो नॄन्॥
verses.tr: tveṣaṃ gaṇaṃ tavasaṃ khādihastaṃ dhunivrataṃ māyinaṃ dātivāram mayobhuvo ye amitā mahitvā vandasva vipra tuvirādhaso nṝn
verses.en: The mighty glittering band, arm-bound with bracelets, givers of bliss, unmeasured in their greatness, With magical powers, bountiful, ever-roaring,-these, liberal Heroes, venerate thou singer.

verses.sa:
आ वो यन्तूदवाहासो अद्य वृष्टिं ये विश्वे मरुतो जुनन्ति ।
अयं यो अग्निर्मरुतः समिद्ध एतं जुषध्वं कवयो युवानः॥
verses.tr: ā vo yantūdavāhāso adya vṛṣṭiṃ ye viśve maruto junanti ayaṃ yo agnirmarutaḥ samiddha etaṃ juṣadhvaṃ kavayo yuvānaḥ
verses.en: This day may all your water-bringers, Maruts, they who impel the falling rain, approach us. This fire, O Maruts, hath been duly kindled; let it find favour with you, youthful Sages.

verses.sa:
यूयं राजानमिर्यं जनाय विभ्वतष्टं जनयथा यजत्राः ।
युष्मदेति मुष्टिहा बाहुजूतो युष्मत् सदश्वो मरुतः सुवीरः॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ rājānamiryaṃ janāya vibhvataṣṭaṃ janayathā yajatrāḥ yuṣmadeti muṣṭihā bāhujūto yuṣmat sadaśvo marutaḥ suvīraḥ
verses.en: Ye raise up for the folk an active ruler whom, Holy Ones! a Master's hand hath fashioned. Ye send the fighter hand to hand, armmighty, and the brave hero, Maruts with good horses.

verses.sa:
अरा इवेदचरमा अहेव प्रप्र जायन्ते अकवा महोभिः ।
पृश्नेः पुत्रा उपमासो रभिष्ठाः स्वया मत्या मरुतः सं मिमिक्षुः॥
verses.tr: arā ivedacaramā aheva prapra jāyante akavā mahobhiḥ pṛśneḥ putrā upamāso rabhiṣṭhāḥ svayā matyā marutaḥ saṃ mimikṣuḥ
verses.en: They spring forth more and more, strong in their glories, like days, like spokes where none are last in order. Highest and mightiest are the Sons of Prsni. Firm to their own intention cling the Maruts.

verses.sa:
यत् प्रायासिष्ट पृषतीभिरश्वैर्वीळुपविभिर्मरुतो रथेभिः ।
क्षोदन्त आपो रिणते वनान्यवोस्रियो वृषभः क्रन्दतु द्यौः॥
verses.tr: yat prāyāsiṣṭa pṛṣatībhiraśvairvīḻupavibhirmaruto rathebhiḥ kṣodanta āpo riṇate vanānyavosriyo vṛṣabhaḥ krandatu dyauḥ
verses.en: When ye have hastened on with spotted coursers, O Maruts, on your cars with strong-wrought fellies, The waters are disturbed, the woods are shattered. Let Dyaus the Red Steer send his thunder downward.

verses.sa:
प्रथिष्ट यामन् पृथिवी चिदेषां भर्तेव गर्भं स्वमिच्छवो धुः ।
वातान् ह्यश्वान् धुर्यायुयुज्रे वर्षं स्वेदं चक्रिरे रुद्रियासः॥
verses.tr: prathiṣṭa yāman pṛthivī cideṣāṃ bharteva garbhaṃ svamicchavo dhuḥ vātān hyaśvān dhuryāyuyujre varṣaṃ svedaṃ cakrire rudriyāsaḥ
verses.en: Even Earth hath spread herself wide at their coming, and they as husbands have with power impregned her. They to the pole have yoked the winds for coursers: their sweat have they made rain, these Sons of Rudra.

verses.sa:
हये नरो मरुतो मृळता नस्तुवीमघासो अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
सत्यश्रुतः कवयो युवानो बृहद्गिरयो बृहदुक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: haye naro maruto mṛḻatā nastuvīmaghāso amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ satyaśrutaḥ kavayo yuvāno bṛhadgirayo bṛhadukṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Ho! Maruts, Heroes, skilled in Law, immortal, be gracious unto us, ye rich in treasures, Ye hearers of the truth, ye sage and youthful, grown mighty, dwelling on the lofty mountains.

verses.sa:
प्र वः स्पळक्रन् त्सुविताय दावनेऽर्चा दिवे प्र पृथिव्या ऋतं भरे ।
उक्षन्ते अश्वान् तरुषन्त आ रजोऽनु स्वं भानुं श्रथयन्ते अर्णवैः॥
verses.tr: pra vaḥ spaḻakran tsuvitāya dāvane'rcā dive pra pṛthivyā ṛtaṃ bhare ukṣante aśvān taruṣanta ā rajo'nu svaṃ bhānuṃ śrathayante arṇavaiḥ
verses.en: Your spy hath called to you to give prosperity. I sing to Heaven and Earth and offer sacrifice. They bathe their steeds and hasten through the firmament: they spread abroad their radiance through the sea of cloud.

verses.sa:
अमादेषां भियसा भूमिरेजति नौर्न पूर्णा क्षरति व्यथिर्यती ।
दूरेदृशो ये चितयन्त एमभिरन्तर्महे विदथे येतिरे नरः॥
verses.tr: amādeṣāṃ bhiyasā bhūmirejati naurna pūrṇā kṣarati vyathiryatī dūredṛśo ye citayanta emabhirantarmahe vidathe yetire naraḥ
verses.en: Earth shakes and reels in terror at their onward rush, like a full ship which, quivering, lets the water in. Marked on their ways are they, visible from afar: the Heroes press between in mighty armament.

verses.sa:
गवामिव श्रियसे शृङ्गमुत्तमं सूर्यो न चक्षू रजसो विसर्जने ।
अत्या इव सुभ्व१श्चारवः स्थन मर्या इव श्रियसे चेतथा नरः॥
verses.tr: gavāmiva śriyase śṛṅgamuttamaṃ sūryo na cakṣū rajaso visarjane atyā iva subhva1ścāravaḥ sthana maryā iva śriyase cetathā naraḥ
verses.en: As the exalted horn of bulls for splendid might, as the Sun's eye set in the firmament's expanse, Like vigorous horses ye are beauteous to behold, and for your glory show like bridegrooms, O ye Men.

verses.sa:
को वो महान्ति महतामुदश्नवत् कस्काव्या मरुतः को ह पौंस्या ।
यूयं ह भूमिं किरणं न रेजथ प्र यद् भरध्वे सुविताय दावने॥
verses.tr: ko vo mahānti mahatāmudaśnavat kaskāvyā marutaḥ ko ha pauṃsyā yūyaṃ ha bhūmiṃ kiraṇaṃ na rejatha pra yad bharadhve suvitāya dāvane
verses.en: Who, O ye Maruts, may attain the mighty lore of you the mighty, who may reach your manly deeds? Ye, verily, make earth tremble like a ray of light what time ye bring your boons to give prosperity,

verses.sa:
अश्वा इवेदरुषासः सबन्धवः शूरा इव प्रयुधः प्रोत युयुधुः ।
मर्या इव सुवृधो वावृधुर्नरः सूर्यस्य चक्षुः प्र मिनन्ति वृष्टिभिः॥
verses.tr: aśvā ivedaruṣāsaḥ sabandhavaḥ śūrā iva prayudhaḥ prota yuyudhuḥ maryā iva suvṛdho vāvṛdhurnaraḥ sūryasya cakṣuḥ pra minanti vṛṣṭibhiḥ
verses.en: Like steeds of ruddy colour, scions of one race, as foremost champions they have battled in the van. The Heroes have waxed strong like we.1grown manly youths; with floods of rain they make the Sun's eye fade away,

verses.sa:
ते अज्येष्ठा अकनिष्ठास उद्भिदोऽमध्यमासो महसा वि वावृधुः ।
सुजातासो जनुषा पृश्निमातरो दिवो मर्या आ नो अच्छा जिगातन॥
verses.tr: te ajyeṣṭhā akaniṣṭhāsa udbhido'madhyamāso mahasā vi vāvṛdhuḥ sujātāso januṣā pṛśnimātaro divo maryā ā no acchā jigātana
verses.en: Having no eldest and no youngest in their band, no middlemost, preeminent they have waxed in might, These Sons of Prsni, sprung of noble ancestry: come hitherward to us, ye bridegrooms of the sky.

verses.sa:
वयो न ये श्रेणीः पप्तुरोजसा ऽन्तान् दिवो बृहतः सानुनस्परि ।
अश्वास एषामुभये यथा विदुः प्र पर्वतस्य नभनूँरचुच्यवुः॥
verses.tr: vayo na ye śreṇīḥ papturojasā 'ntān divo bṛhataḥ sānunaspari aśvāsa eṣāmubhaye yathā viduḥ pra parvatasya nabhanūṃracucyavuḥ
verses.en: Like birds of air they flew with might in lengthened lines from heaven's high ridges to the borders of the sky. The steeds who carry them, as Gods and mortals know, have caused the waters of the mountains to descend.

verses.sa:
मिमातु द्यौरदितिर्वीतये नः सं दानुचित्रा उषसो यतन्ताम् ।
आचुच्यवुर्दिव्यं कोशमेत ऋषे रुद्रस्य मरुतो गृणानाः॥
verses.tr: mimātu dyauraditirvītaye naḥ saṃ dānucitrā uṣaso yatantām ācucyavurdivyaṃ kośameta ṛṣe rudrasya maruto gṛṇānāḥ
verses.en: May Dyaus, the Infinite, roar for our banquet: may Dawns toil for us, glittering with moisture. Lauded by thee, these Maruts, Sons o Rudra, O Rsi, have sent down the heavenly treasure.

verses.sa:
ईळे अग्निं स्ववसं नमोभिरिह प्रसत्तो वि चयत् कृतं नः ।
रथैरिव प्र भरे वाजयद्भिः प्रदक्षिणिन्मरुतां स्तोममृध्याम्॥
verses.tr: īḻe agniṃ svavasaṃ namobhiriha prasatto vi cayat kṛtaṃ naḥ rathairiva pra bhare vājayadbhiḥ pradakṣiṇinmarutāṃ stomamṛdhyām
verses.en: I LAUD with reverence the gracious Agni: here may he sit and part our meed among us. As with spoil-seeking cars I bring oblation: turned rightward I will swell the Marut's, praise-song.

verses.sa:
आ ये तस्थुः पृषतीषु श्रुतासु सुखेषु रुद्रा मरुतो रथेषु ।
वना चिदुग्रा जिहते नि वो भिया पृथिवी चिद् रेजते पर्वतश्चित्॥
verses.tr: ā ye tasthuḥ pṛṣatīṣu śrutāsu sukheṣu rudrā maruto ratheṣu vanā cidugrā jihate ni vo bhiyā pṛthivī cid rejate parvataścit
verses.en: The Maruts, yea, the Rudras, who have mounted their famous spotted deer and cars swift-moving,- Before you, fierce Ones! woods bow down in terror: Earth, even the mountain, trembles at your coming.

verses.sa:
पर्वतश्चिन्महि वृद्धो बिभाय दिवश्चित् सानु रेजत स्वने वः ।
यत् क्रीळथ मरुत ऋष्टिमन्त आप इव सध्र्यञ्चो धवध्वे॥
verses.tr: parvataścinmahi vṛddho bibhāya divaścit sānu rejata svane vaḥ yat krīḻatha maruta ṛṣṭimanta āpa iva sadhryañco dhavadhve
verses.en: Though vast and tall, the mountain is affrighted, the height of heaven is shaken at your roaring When, armed with lances, ye are sporting, Maruts, and rush along together like the waters.

verses.sa:
वरा इवेद् रैवतासो हिरण्यैरभि स्वधाभिस्तन्वः पिपिश्रे ।
श्रिये श्रेयांसस्तवसो रथेषु सत्रा महांसि चक्रिरे तनूषु॥
verses.tr: varā ived raivatāso hiraṇyairabhi svadhābhistanvaḥ pipiśre śriye śreyāṃsastavaso ratheṣu satrā mahāṃsi cakrire tanūṣu
verses.en: They, like young suitors, sons of wealthy houses, have with their golden natures decked their bodies. Strong on their cars, the lordly Ones, for glory, have set their splendours on their forms for ever.

verses.sa:
अज्येष्ठासो अकनिष्ठास एते सं भ्रातरो वावृधुः सौभगाय ।
युवा पिता स्वपा रुद्र एषां सुदुघा पृश्निः सुदिना मरुद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: ajyeṣṭhāso akaniṣṭhāsa ete saṃ bhrātaro vāvṛdhuḥ saubhagāya yuvā pitā svapā rudra eṣāṃ sudughā pṛśniḥ sudinā marudbhyaḥ
verses.en: None being eldest, none among them youngest, as brothers they have grown to happy fortune. May their Sire Rudra, young and deft, and Prsni pouring much milk, bring fair days to the Maruts.

verses.sa:
यदुत्तमे मरुतो मध्यमे वा यद् वावमे सुभगासो दिवि ष्ठ ।
अतो नो रुद्रा उत वा न्व१स्याऽग्ने वित्ताद्धविषो यद् यजाम॥
verses.tr: yaduttame maruto madhyame vā yad vāvame subhagāso divi ṣṭha ato no rudrā uta vā nva1syā'gne vittāddhaviṣo yad yajāma
verses.en: Whether, O blessed Maruts, ye be dwelling in highest, midmost, or in lowest heaven, Thence, O ye Rudras, and thou also, Agni, notice the sacrificial food we offer.

verses.sa:
अग्निश्च यन्मरुतो विश्ववेदसो दिवो वहध्व उत्तरादधि ष्णुभिः ।
ते मन्दसाना धुनयो रिशादसो वामं धत्त यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: agniśca yanmaruto viśvavedaso divo vahadhva uttarādadhi ṣṇubhiḥ te mandasānā dhunayo riśādaso vāmaṃ dhatta yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: O Maruts, Lords of all, when Agni and when ye drive downward from sublimest heaven along the heights, Shakers of all, rejoicing, slayers of the foe, give riches to the Soma-pressing worshipper.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मरुद्भिः शुभयद्भिर्ऋक्वभिः सोमं पिब मन्दसानो गणश्रिभिः ।
पावकेभिर्विश्वमिन्वेभिरायुभिर्वैश्वानर प्रदिवा केतुना सजूः॥
verses.tr: agne marudbhiḥ śubhayadbhirṛkvabhiḥ somaṃ piba mandasāno gaṇaśribhiḥ pāvakebhirviśvaminvebhirāyubhirvaiśvānara pradivā ketunā sajūḥ
verses.en: O Agni, with the Maruts as they gleam and sing, gathered in troop, rejoicing drink the Soma juice; With these the living ones who cleanse and further all, joined with thy banner, O Vaisvanara, from of old.

verses.sa: के ष्ठा नरः श्रेष्ठतमा य एकएक आयय । परमस्याः परावतः॥
verses.tr: ke ṣṭhā naraḥ śreṣṭhatamā ya ekaeka āyaya paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ
verses.en: O HEROES lordliest of all, who are ye that have singly come Forth from a region most remote?

verses.sa: क्व१ वोऽश्वाः क्वा३भीशवः कथं शेक कथा यय । पृष्ठे सदो नसोर्यमः॥
verses.tr: kva1 vo'śvāḥ kvā3bhīśavaḥ kathaṃ śeka kathā yaya pṛṣṭhe sado nasoryamaḥ
verses.en: Where are your horses, where the reins? How came ye? how had ye the power? Rein was on nose and seat on back.

verses.sa: जघने चोद एषां वि सक्थानि नरो यमुः । पुत्रकृथे न जनयः॥
verses.tr: jaghane coda eṣāṃ vi sakthāni naro yamuḥ putrakṛthe na janayaḥ
verses.en: The whip is laid upon the flank. The heroes stretch their thighs apart, Like women when the babe is born.

verses.sa: परा वीरास एतन मर्यासो भद्रजानयः । अग्नितपो यथासथ॥
verses.tr: parā vīrāsa etana maryāso bhadrajānayaḥ agnitapo yathāsatha
verses.en: Go ye, O Heroes, far away, ye bridegrooms with a lovely Spouse That ye may warm you at the fire.

verses.sa: सनत् साश्व्यं पशुमुत गव्यं शतावयम् । श्यावाश्वस्तुताय या दोर्वीरायोपबर्बृहत्॥
verses.tr: sanat sāśvyaṃ paśumuta gavyaṃ śatāvayam śyāvāśvastutāya yā dorvīrāyopabarbṛhat
verses.en: May she gain cattle for her meed, hundreds of sheep and steeds and kine, Who threw embracing arms around the hero whom Gyavaiva praised.

verses.sa: उत त्वा स्त्री शशीयसी पुंसो भवति वस्यसी । अदेवत्रादराधसः॥
verses.tr: uta tvā strī śaśīyasī puṃso bhavati vasyasī adevatrādarādhasaḥ
verses.en: Yea, many a woman is more firm and better than the man who turns Away from Gods, and offers not.

verses.sa: वि या जानाति जसुरिं वि तृष्यन्तं वि कामिनम् । देवत्रा कृणुते मनः॥
verses.tr: vi yā jānāti jasuriṃ vi tṛṣyantaṃ vi kāminam devatrā kṛṇute manaḥ
verses.en: She who discerns the weak and worn, the man who thirsts and is in want She sets her mind upon the Gods.

verses.sa: उत घा नेमो अस्तुतः पुमाँ इति ब्रुवे पणिः । स वैरदेय इत् समः॥
verses.tr: uta ghā nemo astutaḥ pumāṃ iti bruve paṇiḥ sa vairadeya it samaḥ
verses.en: And yet full many a one, unpraised, mean niggard, is entitled man: Only in were gild is he such.

verses.sa:
उत मेऽरपद् युवतिर्ममन्दुषी प्रति श्यावाय वर्तनिम् ।
वि रोहिता पुरुमीळहाय येमतुर्विप्राय दीर्घयशसे॥
verses.tr: uta me'rapad yuvatirmamanduṣī prati śyāvāya vartanim vi rohitā purumīḻahāya yematurviprāya dīrghayaśase
verses.en: And she, the young, the joyous-spirited, divulged the path to Syava, yea, to me. Two red steeds carried me to Purumilha's side, that sage of far-extended fame,

verses.sa: यो मे धेनूनां शतं वैददश्विर्यथा ददत् । तरन्त इव मंहना॥
verses.tr: yo me dhenūnāṃ śataṃ vaidadaśviryathā dadat taranta iva maṃhanā
verses.en: Him who, like Vaidadasvi, like Taranta, hath bestowed on me A hundred cows in liberal gift.

verses.sa: य ईं वहन्त आशुभिः पिबन्तो मदिरं मधु । अत्र श्रवांसि दधिरे॥
verses.tr: ya īṃ vahanta āśubhiḥ pibanto madiraṃ madhu atra śravāṃsi dadhire
verses.en: They who are borne by rapid steeds, drinking the meath that gives delight, They have attained high glories here.

verses.sa: येषां श्रियाधि रोदसी विभ्राजन्ते रथेष्वा । दिवि रुक्म इवोपरि॥
verses.tr: yeṣāṃ śriyādhi rodasī vibhrājante ratheṣvā divi rukma ivopari
verses.en: They by whose splendour both the worlds are over-spread they shine on cars As the gold gleams above in heaven.

verses.sa: युवा स मारुतो गणस्त्वेषरथो अनेद्यः । शुभंयावाप्रतिष्कुतः॥
verses.tr: yuvā sa māruto gaṇastveṣaratho anedyaḥ śubhaṃyāvāpratiṣkutaḥ
verses.en: That Marut band is ever young, borne on bright cars, unblamable, Moving to victory, checked by none.

verses.sa: को वेद नूनमेषां यत्रा मदन्ति धूतयः । ऋतजाता अरेपसः॥
verses.tr: ko veda nūnameṣāṃ yatrā madanti dhūtayaḥ ṛtajātā arepasaḥ
verses.en: Who knoweth, verily, of these where the All-shakers take delight, Born, spotless, after sacred Law?

verses.sa: यूयं मर्तं विपन्यवः प्रणेतार इत्था धिया । श्रोतारो यामहूतिषु॥
verses.tr: yūyaṃ martaṃ vipanyavaḥ praṇetāra itthā dhiyā śrotāro yāmahūtiṣu
verses.en: Guides are ye, lovers of the song to mortal man through holy hymn, And hearers when he cries for help.

verses.sa: ते नो वसूनि काम्या पुरुश्चन्द्रा रिशादसः । आ यज्ञियासो ववृत्तन॥
verses.tr: te no vasūni kāmyā puruścandrā riśādasaḥ ā yajñiyāso vavṛttana
verses.en: Do ye, destroyers of the foe, worshipful and exceeding bright, Send down the treasures that we crave.

verses.sa: एतं मे स्तोममूर्म्ये दार्भ्याय परा वह । गिरो देवि रथीरिव॥
verses.tr: etaṃ me stomamūrmye dārbhyāya parā vaha giro devi rathīriva
verses.en: OUrmya, bear thou far away to Darbhya this my hymn of praise, Songs, Goddess, as if chariot-borne.

verses.sa: उत मे वोचतादिति सुतसोमे रथवीतौ । न कामो अप वेति मे॥
verses.tr: uta me vocatāditi sutasome rathavītau na kāmo apa veti me
verses.en: From me to Rathaviti say, when he hath pressed the Soma juice, The wish I had departeth not.

verses.sa: एष क्षेति रथवीतिर्मघवा गोमतीरनु । पर्वतेष्वपश्रितः॥
verses.tr: eṣa kṣeti rathavītirmaghavā gomatīranu parvateṣvapaśritaḥ
verses.en: This wealthy Rathaviti dwells among the people rich in kine, Among the mountains, far withdrawn.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन ऋतमपिहितं ध्रुवं वां सूर्यस्य यत्र विमुचन्त्यश्वान् ।
दश शता सह तस्थुस्तदेकं देवानां श्रेष्ठं वपुषामपश्यम्॥
verses.tr: ṛtena ṛtamapihitaṃ dhruvaṃ vāṃ sūryasya yatra vimucantyaśvān daśa śatā saha tasthustadekaṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vapuṣāmapaśyam
verses.en: By your high Law firm order is established there where they loose for travel Surya's horses. Ten hundred stood together: there I looked on this the most marvellous Deities' one chief glory.

verses.sa:
तत् सु वां मित्रावरुणा महित्वमीर्मा तस्थुषीरहभिर्दुदुह्रे ।
विश्वाः पिन्वथः स्वसरस्य धेना अनु वामेकः पविरा ववर्त॥
verses.tr: tat su vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā mahitvamīrmā tasthuṣīrahabhirduduhre viśvāḥ pinvathaḥ svasarasya dhenā anu vāmekaḥ pavirā vavarta
verses.en: This, Mitra-Varuna, is your special greatness: floods that stood there they with the days attracted. Ye cause to flow all voices of the cow pen: your single chariot felly hath rolled hither.

verses.sa:
अधारयतं पृथिवीमुत द्यां मित्रराजाना वरुणा महोभिः ।
वर्धयतमोषधीः पिन्वतं गा अव वृष्टिं सृजतं जीरदानू॥
verses.tr: adhārayataṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ mitrarājānā varuṇā mahobhiḥ vardhayatamoṣadhīḥ pinvataṃ gā ava vṛṣṭiṃ sṛjataṃ jīradānū
verses.en: O Mitra-Varuna, ye by your greatness, both Kings, have firmly stablished earth and heaven, Ye caused the cows to stream, the plants to flourish, and, scattering swift drops, sent down the rain-flood.

verses.sa:
आ वामश्वासः सुयुजो वहन्तु यतरश्मय उप यन्त्वर्वाक् ।
घृतस्य निर्णिगनु वर्तते वामुप सिन्धवः प्रदिवि क्षरन्ति॥
verses.tr: ā vāmaśvāsaḥ suyujo vahantu yataraśmaya upa yantvarvāk ghṛtasya nirṇiganu vartate vāmupa sindhavaḥ pradivi kṣaranti
verses.en: Let your well-harnessed horses bear you hither: hitherward let them come with reins drawn tightly. A covering cloud of sacred oil attends you, and your streams flow to us from days aforetime.

verses.sa:
अनु श्रुताममतिं वर्धदुर्वीं बर्हिरिव यजुषा रक्षमाणा ।
नमस्वन्ता धृतदक्षाधि गर्ते मित्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वन्तः॥
verses.tr: anu śrutāmamatiṃ vardhadurvīṃ barhiriva yajuṣā rakṣamāṇā namasvantā dhṛtadakṣādhi garte mitrāsāthe varuṇeḻāsvantaḥ
verses.en: To make the lustre wider and more famous, guarding the sacred grass with veneration, Ye, Mitra-Varuna, firm, strong, awe-inspiring, are seated on a throne amid oblations.

verses.sa:
अक्रविहस्ता सुकृते परस्पा यं त्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वन्तः ।
राजाना क्षत्रमहृणीयमाना सहस्रस्थूणं बिभृथः सह द्वौ॥
verses.tr: akravihastā sukṛte paraspā yaṃ trāsāthe varuṇeḻāsvantaḥ rājānā kṣatramahṛṇīyamānā sahasrasthūṇaṃ bibhṛthaḥ saha dvau
verses.en: With hands that shed no blood, guarding the pious, whom, Varuni3, ye save amid oblations. Ye Twain, together, Kings of willing spirit, uphold dominion based on thousand pillars.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यनिर्णिगयो अस्य स्थूणा वि भ्राजते दिव्य१श्वाजनीव ।
भद्रे क्षेत्रे निमिता तिल्विले वा सनेम मध्वो अधिगर्त्यस्य॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyanirṇigayo asya sthūṇā vi bhrājate divya1śvājanīva bhadre kṣetre nimitā tilvile vā sanema madhvo adhigartyasya
verses.en: Adorned with gold, its columns are of iron. in heaven it glitters like a whip for horses; Or stablished on a field deep-spoiled and fruitful. So may we share the meath that loads your car-seat.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यरूपमुषसो व्युष्टावयःस्थूणमुदिता सूर्यस्य ।
आ रोहथो वरुण मित्र गर्तमतश्चक्षाथे अदितिं दितिं च॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyarūpamuṣaso vyuṣṭāvayaḥsthūṇamuditā sūryasya ā rohatho varuṇa mitra gartamataścakṣāthe aditiṃ ditiṃ ca
verses.en: Ye mount your car gold-hued at break of morning, and iron-pillared when the Sun is setting, And from that place, O Varuna and Mitra, behold infinity and limitation.

verses.sa:
यद् बंहिष्ठं नातिविधे सुदानू अच्छिद्रं शर्म भुवनस्य गोपा ।
तेन नो मित्रावरुणावविष्टं सिषासन्तो जिगीवांसः स्याम॥
verses.tr: yad baṃhiṣṭhaṃ nātividhe sudānū acchidraṃ śarma bhuvanasya gopā tena no mitrāvaruṇāvaviṣṭaṃ siṣāsanto jigīvāṃsaḥ syāma
verses.en: Bountiful guardians of the world! the shelter that is impenetrable, strongest, flawless, Aid us with that, O Varuna and Mitra, and when we long to win may we be victors.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य गोपावधि तिष्ठथो रथं सत्यधर्माणा परमे व्योमनि ।
यमत्र मित्रावरुणावथो युवं तस्मै वृष्टिर्मधुमत् पिन्वते दिवः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya gopāvadhi tiṣṭhatho rathaṃ satyadharmāṇā parame vyomani yamatra mitrāvaruṇāvatho yuvaṃ tasmai vṛṣṭirmadhumat pinvate divaḥ
verses.en: Guardians of Order, ye whose Laws are ever true, in the sublimest heaven your chariot ye ascend. O Mitra-Varuna whomsoe'er ye: favour, here, to him the rain with sweetness streameth down from heaven.

verses.sa:
सम्राजावस्य भुवनस्य राजथो मित्रावरुणा विदथे स्वर्दृशा ।
वृष्टिं वां राधो अमृतत्वमीमहे द्यावापृथिवी वि चरन्ति तन्यवः॥
verses.tr: samrājāvasya bhuvanasya rājatho mitrāvaruṇā vidathe svardṛśā vṛṣṭiṃ vāṃ rādho amṛtatvamīmahe dyāvāpṛthivī vi caranti tanyavaḥ
verses.en: This world's imperial Kings, O Mitra-Varuna, ye rule in holy synod, looking on the light. We pray for rain, your boon, and immortality. Through heaven and over earth the thunderers take their way.

verses.sa:
सम्राजा उग्रा वृषभा दिवस्पती पृथिव्या मित्रावरुणा विचर्षणी ।
चित्रेभिरभ्रैरुप तिष्ठथो रवं द्यां वर्षयथो असुरस्य मायया॥
verses.tr: samrājā ugrā vṛṣabhā divaspatī pṛthivyā mitrāvaruṇā vicarṣaṇī citrebhirabhrairupa tiṣṭhatho ravaṃ dyāṃ varṣayatho asurasya māyayā
verses.en: Imperial Kings, strong, Heroes, Lords of earth and heaven, Mitra and Varuna, ye ever active Ones, Ye wait on thunder with the many-tinted clouds, and by the Asura's magic power cause Heaven to rain.

verses.sa:
माया वां मित्रावरुणा दिवि श्रिता सूर्यो ज्योतिश्चरति चित्रमायुधम् ।
तमभ्रेण वृष्ट्या गूहथो दिवि पर्जन्य द्रप्सा मधुमन्त ईरते॥
verses.tr: māyā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā divi śritā sūryo jyotiścarati citramāyudham tamabhreṇa vṛṣṭyā gūhatho divi parjanya drapsā madhumanta īrate
verses.en: Your magic, Mitra-Varuna, resteth in the heaven. The Sun, the wondrous weapon, cometh forth as light. Ye hide him in the sky with cloud and flood of rain, and water-drops, Parjanya! full of sweetness flow.

verses.sa:
रथं युञ्जते मरुतः शुभे सुखं शूरो न मित्रावरुणा गविष्टिषु ।
रजांसि चित्रा वि चरन्ति तन्यवो दिवः सम्राजा पयसा न उक्षतम्॥
verses.tr: rathaṃ yuñjate marutaḥ śubhe sukhaṃ śūro na mitrāvaruṇā gaviṣṭiṣu rajāṃsi citrā vi caranti tanyavo divaḥ samrājā payasā na ukṣatam
verses.en: The Maruts yoke their easy car for victory, O Mitra-Varuna, as a hero in the wars. The thunderers roam through regions varied in their hues. Imperial Kings, bedew us with the milk of heaven.

verses.sa:
वाचं सु मित्रावरुणाविरावतीं पर्जन्यश्चित्रां वदति त्विषीमतीम् ।
अभ्रा वसत मरुतः सु मायया द्यां वर्षयतमरुणामरेपसम्॥
verses.tr: vācaṃ su mitrāvaruṇāvirāvatīṃ parjanyaścitrāṃ vadati tviṣīmatīm abhrā vasata marutaḥ su māyayā dyāṃ varṣayatamaruṇāmarepasam
verses.en: Refreshing is your voice, O Mitra-Varuna: Parjanya sendeth out a wondrous mighty voice. With magic power the Maruts clothe them with the clouds. Ye Two cause Heaven to rain, the red, the spotless One.

verses.sa:
धर्मणा मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता व्रता रक्षेथे असुरस्य मायया ।
ऋतेन विश्वं भुवनं वि राजथः सूर्यमा धत्थो दिवि चित्र्यं रथम्॥
verses.tr: dharmaṇā mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā vratā rakṣethe asurasya māyayā ṛtena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājathaḥ sūryamā dhattho divi citryaṃ ratham
verses.en: Wise, with your Law and through the Asura's magic power ye guard the ordinances, Mitra-Varuna. Ye by eternal Order govern all the world. Ye set the Sun in heaven as a refulgent car.

verses.sa: वरुणं वो रिशादसमृचा मित्रं हवामहे । परि व्रजेव बाह्वोर्जगन्वांसा स्वर्णरम्॥
verses.tr: varuṇaṃ vo riśādasamṛcā mitraṃ havāmahe pari vrajeva bāhvorjaganvāṃsā svarṇaram
verses.en: You, foeman-slaying Varuna and Mitra, we invoke with song, Who, as with penfold of your arms, encompass round the realm of light.

verses.sa: ता बाहवा सुचेतुना प्र यन्तमस्मा अर्चते । शेवं हि जार्यं वां विश्वासु क्षासु जोगुवे॥
verses.tr: tā bāhavā sucetunā pra yantamasmā arcate śevaṃ hi jāryaṃ vāṃ viśvāsu kṣāsu joguve
verses.en: Stretch out your arms with favouring love unto this man who singeth hymns, For in all places is sung forth your ever gracious friendliness.

verses.sa: यन्नूनमश्यां गतिं मित्रस्य यायां पथा । अस्य प्रियस्य शर्मण्यहिंसानस्य सश्चिरे॥
verses.tr: yannūnamaśyāṃ gatiṃ mitrasya yāyāṃ pathā asya priyasya śarmaṇyahiṃsānasya saścire
verses.en: That I may gain a refuge now, may my steps be on Mitra's path. Men go protected in the charge of this dear Friend who harms us not.

verses.sa: युवाभ्यां मित्रावरुणोपमं धेयामृचा । यद्ध क्षये मघोनां स्तोतॄणां च स्पूर्धसे॥
verses.tr: yuvābhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇopamaṃ dheyāmṛcā yaddha kṣaye maghonāṃ stotṝṇāṃ ca spūrdhase
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, from you may I, by song, win noblest meed. That shall stir envy in the homes of wealthy chiefs and those who praise.

verses.sa: आ नो मित्र सुदीतिभिर्वरुणश्च सधस्थ आ । स्वे क्षये मघोनां सखीनां च वृधसे॥
verses.tr: ā no mitra sudītibhirvaruṇaśca sadhastha ā sve kṣaye maghonāṃ sakhīnāṃ ca vṛdhase
verses.en: With your fair splendours, Varuna and Mitra, to our gathering come, That in their homes the wealthy chiefs and they who are your friends may thrive.

verses.sa: युवं नो येषु वरुण क्षत्रं बृहच्च बिभृथः । उरु णो वाजसातये कृतं राये स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ no yeṣu varuṇa kṣatraṃ bṛhacca bibhṛthaḥ uru ṇo vājasātaye kṛtaṃ rāye svastaye
verses.en: With those, moreover, among whom ye hold your high supremacy, Vouchsafe us room that we may win strength for prosperity and wealth.

verses.sa:
उच्छन्त्यां मे यजता देवक्षत्रे रुशद्गवि ।
सुतं सोमं न हस्तिभिरा पड्भिर्धावतं नरा बिभ्रतावर्चनानसम्॥
verses.tr: ucchantyāṃ me yajatā devakṣatre ruśadgavi sutaṃ somaṃ na hastibhirā paḍbhirdhāvataṃ narā bibhratāvarcanānasam
verses.en: When morning flushes, Holy Ones! in the Gods' realm where white Cows shine, Supporting Arcananas, speed, ye Heroes, with your active feet hither to my pressed Soma juice.

verses.sa: यश्चिकेत स सुक्रतुर्देवत्रा स ब्रवीतु नः । वरुणो यस्य दर्शतो मित्रो वा वनते गिरः॥
verses.tr: yaściketa sa sukraturdevatrā sa bravītu naḥ varuṇo yasya darśato mitro vā vanate giraḥ
verses.en: Full wise is he who hath discerned: let him speak to us of the Gods,— The man whose praise-songs Varuṇa the beautiful, or Mitra, loves.

verses.sa: ता हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा । ता सत्पती ऋतावृध ऋतावाना जनेजने॥
verses.tr: tā hi śreṣṭhavarcasā rājānā dīrghaśruttamā tā satpatī ṛtāvṛdha ṛtāvānā janejane
verses.en: For they are Kings of noblest might, of glorious fame most widely spread; Lords of the brave, who strengthen Law, the Holy Ones with every race.

verses.sa: ता वामियानोऽवसे पूर्वा उप ब्रुवे सचा । स्वश्वासः सु चेतुना वाजाँ अभि प्र दावने॥
verses.tr: tā vāmiyāno'vase pūrvā upa bruve sacā svaśvāsaḥ su cetunā vājāṃ abhi pra dāvane
verses.en: Approaching you with prayer for aid, together I address you first We who have good steeds call on you, Most Sage, to give us strength besides.

verses.sa: मित्रो अंहोश्चिदादुरु क्षयाय गातुं वनते । मित्रस्य हि प्रतूर्वतः सुमतिरस्ति विधतः॥
verses.tr: mitro aṃhościdāduru kṣayāya gātuṃ vanate mitrasya hi pratūrvataḥ sumatirasti vidhataḥ
verses.en: E’en out of misery Mitra gives a way to dwelling at our case, For he who worships hath the grace of Mitra, fighter in the van. '

verses.sa: वयं मित्रस्यावसि स्याम सप्रथस्तमे । अनेहसस्त्वोतयः सत्रा वरुणशेषसः॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ mitrasyāvasi syāma saprathastame anehasastvotayaḥ satrā varuṇaśeṣasaḥ
verses.en: In Mitra's shelter that extends to utmost distance may we dwell, Unmenaced, guarded by the care, ever as sons of Varuṇa.

verses.sa:
युवं मित्रेमं जनं यतथः सं च नयथः ।
मा मघोनः परि ख्यतं मो अस्माकमृषीणां गोपीथे न उरुष्यतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ mitremaṃ janaṃ yatathaḥ saṃ ca nayathaḥ mā maghonaḥ pari khyataṃ mo asmākamṛṣīṇāṃ gopīthe na uruṣyatam
verses.en: Ye, Mitra, urge this people on, and to one end direct their ways. Neglect not ye the wealthy chiefs, neglect not us the Ṛṣis: be our guardians when ye quaff the milk.

verses.sa: आ चिकितान सुक्रतू देवौ मर्त रिशादसा । वरुणाय ऋतपेशसे दधीत प्रयसे महे॥
verses.tr: ā cikitāna sukratū devau marta riśādasā varuṇāya ṛtapeśase dadhīta prayase mahe
verses.en: O SAPIENT man, call the Two Gods, the very wise, who slay the foe. For Varuna, whose form is Law, place offerings for his great delight.

verses.sa: ता हि क्षत्रमविह्रुतं सम्यगसुर्य१माशाते । अध व्रतेव मानुषं स्व१र्ण धायि दर्शतम्॥
verses.tr: tā hi kṣatramavihrutaṃ samyagasurya1māśāte adha vrateva mānuṣaṃ sva1rṇa dhāyi darśatam
verses.en: For they have won unbroken sway in full perfection, power divine. And, like high laws, the world of man hath been made beautiful as light.

verses.sa: ता वामेषे रथानामुर्वीं गव्यूतिमेषाम् । रातहव्यस्य सुष्टुतिं दधृक् स्तोमैर्मनामहे॥
verses.tr: tā vāmeṣe rathānāmurvīṃ gavyūtimeṣām rātahavyasya suṣṭutiṃ dadhṛk stomairmanāmahe
verses.en: Therefore we praise you that your cars may travel far in front of ours- You who accept the eulogy of Ratahavya with his hymns.

verses.sa: अधा हि काव्या युवं दक्षस्य पूर्भिरद्भुता । नि केतुना जनानां चिकेथे पूतदक्षसा॥
verses.tr: adhā hi kāvyā yuvaṃ dakṣasya pūrbhiradbhutā ni ketunā janānāṃ cikethe pūtadakṣasā
verses.en: And ye show whom, Wondrous Gods with fulness of intelligence. By men's discernment are ye marked, O ye whose might is purified.

verses.sa: तदृतं पृथिवि बृहच्छ्रवएष ऋषीणाम् । ज्रयसानावरं पृथ्वति क्षरन्ति यामभिः॥
verses.tr: tadṛtaṃ pṛthivi bṛhacchravaeṣa ṛṣīṇām jrayasānāvaraṃ pṛthvati kṣaranti yāmabhiḥ
verses.en: This is the Law sublime, O Earth: to aid the Rsis' toil for fame The Two, wide-spreading, are prepared. They come with ample overflow.

verses.sa: आ यद् वामीयचक्षसा मित्र वयं च सूरयः । व्यचिष्ठे बहुपाय्ये यतेमहि स्वराज्ये॥
verses.tr: ā yad vāmīyacakṣasā mitra vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ vyaciṣṭhe bahupāyye yatemahi svarājye
verses.en: Mitra, ye Gods with wandering eyes, would that the worshippers and we Might strive to reach the realm ye rule, most spacious and protected well,

verses.sa: बळित्था देव निष्कृतमादित्या यजतं बृहत् । वरुण मित्रार्यमन् वर्षिष्ठं क्षत्रमाशाथे॥
verses.tr: baḻitthā deva niṣkṛtamādityā yajataṃ bṛhat varuṇa mitrāryaman varṣiṣṭhaṃ kṣatramāśāthe
verses.en: Ye Gods, Adityas, Varuna, Aryaman, Mitra, verily Have here obtained supremest sway, high, holy, set apart for you.

verses.sa: आ यद् योनिं हिरण्ययं वरुण मित्र सदथः । धर्तारा चर्षणीनां यन्तं सुम्नं रिशादसा॥
verses.tr: ā yad yoniṃ hiraṇyayaṃ varuṇa mitra sadathaḥ dhartārā carṣaṇīnāṃ yantaṃ sumnaṃ riśādasā
verses.en: When, Varuna and Mitra, ye sit in your golden dwelling-place, Ye Twain, supporters of mankind, foe slayers, give felicity.

verses.sa: विश्वे हि विश्ववेदसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । व्रता पदेव सश्चिरे पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः॥
verses.tr: viśve hi viśvavedaso varuṇo mitro aryamā vratā padeva saścire pānti martyaṃ riṣaḥ
verses.en: All these, possessors of all wealth, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Follow their ways, as if with feet, and guard from injury mortal man.

verses.sa: ते हि सत्या ऋतस्पृश ऋतावानो जनेजने । सुनीथासः सुदानवोंऽहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयः॥
verses.tr: te hi satyā ṛtaspṛśa ṛtāvāno janejane sunīthāsaḥ sudānavoṃ'hościdurucakrayaḥ
verses.en: For they are true, they cleave to Law, held holy among every race, Good leaders, bounteous in their gifts, deliverers even from distress.

verses.sa: को नु वां मित्रास्तुतो वरुणो वा तनूनाम् । तत् सु वामेषते मतिरत्रिभ्य एषते मतिः॥
verses.tr: ko nu vāṃ mitrāstuto varuṇo vā tanūnām tat su vāmeṣate matiratribhya eṣate matiḥ
verses.en: Which of your persons, Varuna or Mitra, merits not our praise? Therefore our thought is turned to you, the Atris' thought is turned to you.

verses.sa: प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा । महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: pra vo mitrāya gāyata varuṇāya vipā girā mahikṣatrāvṛtaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: Sing forth unto your Varuna and Mitra with a song inspired. They, Mighty Lords, are lofty Law

verses.sa: सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च । देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता॥
verses.tr: samrājā yā ghṛtayonī mitraścobhā varuṇaśca devā deveṣu praśastā
verses.en: Full springs of fatness, Sovran Kings, Mitra. and Varuna, the Twain, Gods glorified among the Gods.

verses.sa: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य । महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु॥
verses.tr: tā naḥ śaktaṃ pārthivasya maho rāyo divyasya mahi vāṃ kṣatraṃ deveṣu
verses.en: So help ye us to riches, great terrestrial and celestial wealth: Vast is your sway among the Gods.

verses.sa: ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते । अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते॥
verses.tr: ṛtamṛtena sapanteṣiraṃ dakṣamāśāte adruhā devau vardhete
verses.en: Carefully tending Law with Law they have attained their vigorous might. The two Gods wax devoid of guile.

verses.sa: वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः । बृहन्तं गर्तमाशाते॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṭidyāvā rītyāpeṣaspatī dānumatyāḥ bṛhantaṃ gartamāśāte
verses.en: With rainy skies and streaming floods, Lords of the strength that bringeth gifts, A lofty seat have they attained.

verses.sa:
त्री रोचना वरुण त्रीँरुत द्यून् त्रीणि मित्र धारयथो रजांसि ।
वावृधानावमतिं क्षत्रियस्याऽनु व्रतं रक्षमाणावजुर्यम्॥
verses.tr: trī rocanā varuṇa trīṃruta dyūn trīṇi mitra dhārayatho rajāṃsi vāvṛdhānāvamatiṃ kṣatriyasyā'nu vrataṃ rakṣamāṇāvajuryam
verses.en: Three spheres of light, O Varuna, three heavens, three firmaments ye comprehend, O Mitra: Waxed strong, ye keep the splendour of dominion, guarding the Ordinance that lasts for ever.

verses.sa:
इरावतीर्वरुण धेनवो वां मधुमद् वां सिन्धवो मित्र दुह्रे ।
त्रयस्तस्थुर्वृषभासस्तिसृणां धिषणानां रेतोधा वि द्युमन्तः॥
verses.tr: irāvatīrvaruṇa dhenavo vāṃ madhumad vāṃ sindhavo mitra duhre trayastasthurvṛṣabhāsastisṛṇāṃ dhiṣaṇānāṃ retodhā vi dyumantaḥ
verses.en: Ye, Varuna, have kine who yield refreshment; Mitra, your floods pour water full of sweetness. There stand the Three Steers, splendid in their brightness, who fill the three world-bowls with genial moisture.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्देवीमदितिं जोहवीमि मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य ।
राये मित्रावरुणा सर्वतातेळे तोकाय तनयाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: prātardevīmaditiṃ johavīmi madhyaṃdina uditā sūryasya rāye mitrāvaruṇā sarvatāteḻe tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: I call at dawn on Aditi the Goddess, I call at noon and when the Sun is setting. I pray, O Mitra-Varuna, for safety, for wealth and progeny, in rest and trouble.

verses.sa:
या धर्तारा रजसो रोचनस्योतादित्या दिव्या पार्थिवस्य ।
न वां देवा अमृता आ मिनन्ति व्रतानि मित्रावरुणा ध्रुवाणि॥
verses.tr: yā dhartārā rajaso rocanasyotādityā divyā pārthivasya na vāṃ devā amṛtā ā minanti vratāni mitrāvaruṇā dhruvāṇi
