verses.en: Ye who uphold the region, sphere of brightness, ye who support earth's realm Divine Adityas, The Immortal Gods, O Varuna and Mitra, never impair your everlasting statutes.

verses.sa: पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण । मित्र वंसि वां सुमतिम्॥
verses.tr: purūruṇā ciddhyastyavo nūnaṃ vāṃ varuṇa mitra vaṃsi vāṃ sumatim
verses.en: Even far and wide, O Varuna and Mitra, doth your grace extend. May I obtain your kind good-will.

verses.sa: ता वां सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धायसे । वयं ते रुद्रा स्याम॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ samyagadruhvāṇeṣamaśyāma dhāyase vayaṃ te rudrā syāma
verses.en: From you, benignant Gods, may we gain fully food for sustenance. Such, O ye Rudras, my we be.

verses.sa: पातं नो रुद्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथां सुत्रात्रा । तुर्याम दस्यून् तनूभिः॥
verses.tr: pātaṃ no rudrā pāyubhiruta trāyethāṃ sutrātrā turyāma dasyūn tanūbhiḥ
verses.en: Guard us, O Rudras. with your guard save us, ye skilled to save, my we Subdue the Dasyus, we ourselves,

verses.sa: मा कस्याद्भुतक्रतू यक्षं भुजेमा तनूभिः । मा शेषसा मा तनसा॥
verses.tr: mā kasyādbhutakratū yakṣaṃ bhujemā tanūbhiḥ mā śeṣasā mā tanasā
verses.en: Or ne'er may we, O Wondrous Strong, enjoy another's solemn feast, Ourselves, our sons, or progeny.

verses.sa: आ नो गन्तं रिशादसा वरुण मित्र बर्हणा । उपेमं चारुमध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: ā no gantaṃ riśādasā varuṇa mitra barhaṇā upemaṃ cārumadhvaram
verses.en: O Varuna and Mitra, ye who slay the foemen, come with might To this our goodly sacrifice.

verses.sa: विश्वस्य हि प्रचेतसा वरुण मित्र राजथः । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः॥
verses.tr: viśvasya hi pracetasā varuṇa mitra rājathaḥ īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ
verses.en: For, Varuna and Mitra, ye Sages are Rulers over all. Fill full our songs, for this ye can.

verses.sa: उप नः सुतमा गतं वरुण मित्र दाशुषः । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ sutamā gataṃ varuṇa mitra dāśuṣaḥ asya somasya pītaye
verses.en: Come to the juice that we have pressed. Varuna, Mitra, come to drink This Soma of the worshipper.

verses.sa: आ मित्रे वरुणे वयं गीर्भिर्जुहुमो अत्रिवत् । नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: ā mitre varuṇe vayaṃ gīrbhirjuhumo atrivat ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye
verses.en: To Varuna and Mitra we offer with songs, as Atri did. Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: व्रतेन स्थो ध्रुवक्षेमा धर्मणा यातयज्जना । नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: vratena stho dhruvakṣemā dharmaṇā yātayajjanā ni barhiṣi sadataṃ somapītaye
verses.en: By Ordinance and Law ye dwell in peace secure, bestirring men. Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: मित्रश्च नो वरुणश्च जुषेतां यज्ञमिष्टये । नि बर्हिषि सदतां सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: mitraśca no varuṇaśca juṣetāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye ni barhiṣi sadatāṃ somapītaye
verses.en: May Varuna and Mitra, for our help, accept the sacrifice. Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: यदद्य स्थः परावति यदर्वावत्यश्विना । यद् वा पुरू पुरुभुजा यदन्तरिक्ष आ गतम्॥
verses.tr: yadadya sthaḥ parāvati yadarvāvatyaśvinā yad vā purū purubhujā yadantarikṣa ā gatam
verses.en: Whether, O Asvins, ye this day be far remote or near at hand, In many spots or in mid-air, come hither, Lords of ample wealth.

verses.sa: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा पुरू दंसांसि बिभ्रता । वरस्या याम्यध्रिगू हुवे तुविष्टमा भुजे॥
verses.tr: iha tyā purubhūtamā purū daṃsāṃsi bibhratā varasyā yāmyadhrigū huve tuviṣṭamā bhuje
verses.en: These here, who show o'er widest space, bringing full many a wondrous act, Resistless, lovingly I seek, I call the Mightiest to enjoy.

verses.sa: ईर्मान्यद् वपुषे वपुश्चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः । पर्यन्या नाहुषा युगा मह्ना रजांसि दीयथः॥
verses.tr: īrmānyad vapuṣe vapuścakraṃ rathasya yemathuḥ paryanyā nāhuṣā yugā mahnā rajāṃsi dīyathaḥ
verses.en: Another beauteous wheel have ye fixed there to decorate your car. With others through the realms ye roam in might unto the neighbouring tribes.

verses.sa: तदू षु वामेना कृतं विश्वा यद् वामनु ष्टवे । नाना जातावरेपसा समस्मे बन्धुमेयथुः॥
verses.tr: tadū ṣu vāmenā kṛtaṃ viśvā yad vāmanu ṣṭave nānā jātāvarepasā samasme bandhumeyathuḥ
verses.en: That deed of yours that is extolled, Visvas! hath all been done with this. Born otherwise, and spotless, ye have entered kinship's bonds with us.

verses.sa: आ यद् वां सूर्या रथं तिष्ठद् रघुष्यदं सदा । परि वामरुषा वयो घृणा वरन्त आतपः॥
verses.tr: ā yad vāṃ sūryā rathaṃ tiṣṭhad raghuṣyadaṃ sadā pari vāmaruṣā vayo ghṛṇā varanta ātapaḥ
verses.en: When Surya mounted on your car that rolls for ever rapidly, Birds of red hue were round about and burning splendours compassed you.

verses.sa: युवोरत्रिश्चिकेतति नरा सुम्नेन चेतसा । घर्मं यद् वामरेपसं नासत्यास्ना भुरण्यति॥
verses.tr: yuvoratriściketati narā sumnena cetasā gharmaṃ yad vāmarepasaṃ nāsatyāsnā bhuraṇyati
verses.en: Atri bethinks himself of you, O Heroes, with a friendly mind, What time, Nasatyas, with his mouth he stirs the spotless flame for you.

verses.sa: उग्रो वां ककुहो ययिः शृण्वे यामेषु संतनिः । यद् वां दंसोभिरश्विनाऽत्रिर्नराववर्तति॥
verses.tr: ugro vāṃ kakuho yayiḥ śṛṇve yāmeṣu saṃtaniḥ yad vāṃ daṃsobhiraśvinā'trirnarāvavartati
verses.en: Strong is your swiftly moving steed, famed his exertion in the course When by your great deeds, Asvins, Chiefs, Atri is brought to us again.

verses.sa: मध्व ऊ षु मधूयुवा रुद्रा सिषक्ति पिप्युषी । यत् समुद्राति पर्षथः पक्वाः पृक्षो भरन्त वाम्॥
verses.tr: madhva ū ṣu madhūyuvā rudrā siṣakti pipyuṣī yat samudrāti parṣathaḥ pakvāḥ pṛkṣo bharanta vām
verses.en: Lovers of sweetness, Rudras, she who streams with sweetness waits on you. When ye have travelled through the seas men bring you gifts of well-dressed food.

verses.sa: सत्यमिद् वा उ अश्विना युवामाहुर्मयोभुवा । ता यामन् यामहूतमा यामन्ना मृळयत्तमा॥
verses.tr: satyamid vā u aśvinā yuvāmāhurmayobhuvā tā yāman yāmahūtamā yāmannā mṛḻayattamā
verses.en: Asvins, with truth they call you Twain bestowers of felicity; At sacrifice most prompt to hear, most gracious ye at sacrifice.

verses.sa: इमा ब्रह्माणि वर्धना ऽश्विभ्यां सन्तु शंतमा । या तक्षाम रथाँ इवाऽवोचाम बृहन्नमः॥
verses.tr: imā brahmāṇi vardhanā 'śvibhyāṃ santu śaṃtamā yā takṣāma rathāṃ ivā'vocāma bṛhannamaḥ
verses.en: Most pleasing to the Asvins be these prayers which magnify their might, Which we have fashioned, even as cars high reverence have we spoken forth.

verses.sa: कूष्ठो देवावश्विना ऽद्या दिवो मनावसू । तच्छ्रवथो वृषण्वसू अत्रिर्वामा विवासति॥
verses.tr: kūṣṭho devāvaśvinā 'dyā divo manāvasū tacchravatho vṛṣaṇvasū atrirvāmā vivāsati
verses.en: Where in the heavens are ye to-day, Gods, Asvins, rich in constancy? Hear this, ye excellent as Steers: Atri inviteth you to come.

verses.sa: कुह त्या कुह नु श्रुता दिवि देवा नासत्या । कस्मिन्ना यतथो जने को वां नदीनां सचा॥
verses.tr: kuha tyā kuha nu śrutā divi devā nāsatyā kasminnā yatatho jane ko vāṃ nadīnāṃ sacā
verses.en: Where are they now? Where are the Twain, the famed Nasatyas, Gods in heaven? Who is the man ye strive to reach? Who of your suppliants is with you?

verses.sa: कं याथः कं ह गच्छथः कमच्छा युञ्जाथे रथम् । कस्य ब्रह्माणि रण्यथो वयं वामुश्मसीष्टये॥
verses.tr: kaṃ yāthaḥ kaṃ ha gacchathaḥ kamacchā yuñjāthe ratham kasya brahmāṇi raṇyatho vayaṃ vāmuśmasīṣṭaye
verses.en: Whom do ye visit, whom approach? to whom direct your harnessed car? With whose devotions are ye pleased? We long for you to further us.

verses.sa: पौरं चिद्ध्युदप्रुतं पौर पौराय जिन्वथः । यदीं गृभीततातये सिंहमिव द्रुहस्पदे॥
verses.tr: pauraṃ ciddhyudaprutaṃ paura paurāya jinvathaḥ yadīṃ gṛbhītatātaye siṃhamiva druhaspade
verses.en: Ye, Strengtheners, for Paura stir the filler swimming in the flood, Advancing to be captured like a lion to the ambuscade.

verses.sa: प्र च्यवानाज्जुजुरुषो वव्रिमत्कं न मुञ्चथः । युवा यदी कृथः पुनरा काममृण्वे वध्वः॥
verses.tr: pra cyavānājjujuruṣo vavrimatkaṃ na muñcathaḥ yuvā yadī kṛthaḥ punarā kāmamṛṇve vadhvaḥ
verses.en: Ye from Cyavana worn with age removed his skin as 'twere a robe. So, when ye made him young again, he stirred the longing of a dame.

verses.sa: अस्ति हि वामिह स्तोता स्मसि वां संदृशि श्रिये । नू श्रुतं म आ गतमवोभिर्वाजिनीवसू॥
verses.tr: asti hi vāmiha stotā smasi vāṃ saṃdṛśi śriye nū śrutaṃ ma ā gatamavobhirvājinīvasū
verses.en: Here is the man who lauds you both: to see your glory are we here. Now bear me, come with saving help, ye who are rich in store of wealth.

verses.sa: को वामद्य पुरूणामा वव्ने मर्त्यानाम् । को विप्रो विप्रवाहसा को यज्ञैर्वाजिनीवसू॥
verses.tr: ko vāmadya purūṇāmā vavne martyānām ko vipro vipravāhasā ko yajñairvājinīvasū
verses.en: Who among many mortal men this day hath won you to himself? What bard, accepters of the bard? Who, rich in wealth! with sacrifice?

verses.sa: आ वां रथो रथानां येष्ठो यात्वश्विना । पुरू चिदस्मयुस्तिर आङ्गूषो मर्त्येष्वा॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ ratho rathānāṃ yeṣṭho yātvaśvinā purū cidasmayustira āṅgūṣo martyeṣvā
verses.en: O Asvins, may your car approach, most excellent of cars for speed. Through many regions may our praise pass onward among mortal men.

verses.sa: शमू षु वां मधूयुवास्माकमस्तु चर्कृतिः । अर्वाचीना विचेतसा विभिः श्येनेव दीयतम्॥
verses.tr: śamū ṣu vāṃ madhūyuvāsmākamastu carkṛtiḥ arvācīnā vicetasā vibhiḥ śyeneva dīyatam
verses.en: May our laudation of you Twain, lovers of meath! be sweet to you. Fly hitherward, ye wise of heart, like falcons with your winged steeds.

verses.sa: अश्विना यद्ध कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् । वस्वीरू षु वां भुजः पृञ्चन्ति सु वां पृचः॥
verses.tr: aśvinā yaddha karhi cicchuśrūyātamimaṃ havam vasvīrū ṣu vāṃ bhujaḥ pṛñcanti su vāṃ pṛcaḥ
verses.en: O Asvins, when at any time ye listen to this call of mine, For you is dainty food prepared: they mix refreshing food for you.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्रियतमं रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनम् ।
स्तोता वामश्विनावृषिः स्तोमेन प्रति भूषति माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam stotā vāmaśvināvṛṣiḥ stomena prati bhūṣati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: To meet your treasure-bringing car, the mighty car most dear to us, Asvins, the Rsi is prepared, your raiser, with his song of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहं सना ।
दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी सुषुम्ना सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: atyāyātamaśvinā tiro viśvā ahaṃ sanā dasrā hiraṇyavartanī suṣumnā sindhuvāhasā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: Pass, O ye Asvins, pass away beyond all tribes of selfish men, Wonderful, with your golden paths, most gracious, bringers of the flood. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवम् ।
रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: ā no ratnāni bibhratāvaśvinā gacchataṃ yuvam rudrā hiraṇyavartanī juṣāṇā vājinīvasū mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: Come to us, O ye Asvin Pair, bringing your precious treasures, come Ye Rudras, on your paths of gold, rejoicing, rich in store of wealth. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
सुष्टुभो वां वृषण्वसू रथे वाणीच्याहिता ।
उत वां ककुहो मृगः पृक्षः कृणोति वापुषो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: suṣṭubho vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū rathe vāṇīcyāhitā uta vāṃ kakuho mṛgaḥ pṛkṣaḥ kṛṇoti vāpuṣo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: O strong and Good, the voice of him who lauds you well cleaves to your car. And that great beast, your chariot-steed, fair, wonderful, makes dainty food. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
बोधिन्मनसा रथ्येषिरा हवनश्रुता ।
विभिश्च्यवानमश्विना नि याथो अद्वयाविनं माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: bodhinmanasā rathyeṣirā havanaśrutā vibhiścyavānamaśvinā ni yātho advayāvinaṃ mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: Watchful in spirit, born on cars, impetuous, listing to his cry, Asvins, with winged steeds ye speed down to Cyavana void of guile. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
आ वां नरा मनोयुजोऽश्वासः प्रुषितप्सवः ।
वयो वहन्तु पीतये सह सुम्नेभिरश्विना माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ narā manoyujo'śvāsaḥ pruṣitapsavaḥ vayo vahantu pītaye saha sumnebhiraśvinā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: Hither, O Heroes, let your steeds, of dappled hue, yoked at the thought, Your flying steeds, O Asvins, bring you hitherward, with bliss, to drink. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतम् ।
तिरश्चिदर्यया परि वर्तिर्यातमदाभ्या माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam tiraścidaryayā pari vartiryātamadābhyā mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: O Asvins, hither come to us; Nasatyas, be not disinclined. Through longing for the pious turn out of the way to reach our home. Lovers of sweetness, bear my call.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् यज्ञे अदाभ्या जरितारं शुभस्पती ।
अवस्युमश्विना युवं गृणन्तमुप भूषथो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: asmin yajñe adābhyā jaritāraṃ śubhaspatī avasyumaśvinā yuvaṃ gṛṇantamupa bhūṣatho mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: Ye Lords of Splendour, free from guile, come, stand at this our sacrifice. Beside the singer, Asvins, who longs for your grace and lauds you both. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
अभूदुषा रुशत् पशुराग्निरधाय्यृत्वियः ।
अयोजि वां वृषण्वसू रथो दस्रावमर्त्यो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम्॥
verses.tr: abhūduṣā ruśat paśurāgniradhāyyṛtviyaḥ ayoji vāṃ vṛṣaṇvasū ratho dasrāvamartyo mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
verses.en: Dawn with her white herd hath appeared, and in due time hath fire been placed. Harnessed is your immortal car, O Wonder Workers, strong and kind. Lovers of sweetness, bear my call.

verses.sa:
आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद् विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः ।
अर्वाञ्चा नूनं रथ्येह यातं पीपिवांसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ॥
verses.tr: ā bhātyagniruṣasāmanīkamud viprāṇāṃ devayā vāco asthuḥ arvāñcā nūnaṃ rathyeha yātaṃ pīpivāṃsamaśvinā gharmamaccha
verses.en: Agni, the bright face of the Dawns, is shining; the singers' pious voices have ascended. Borne on your chariot, Asvins, turn you hither and come unto our full and rich libation.

verses.sa:
न संस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठा ऽन्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह ।
दिवाभिपित्वेऽवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा॥
verses.tr: na saṃskṛtaṃ pra mimīto gamiṣṭhā 'nti nūnamaśvinopastuteha divābhipitve'vasāgamiṣṭhā pratyavartiṃ dāśuṣe śambhaviṣṭhā
verses.en: Most frequent guests, they scorn not what is ready: even now the lauded Asvins are beside us. With promptest aid they come at morn and evening, the worshipper's most blessed guards from trouble.

verses.sa:
उता यातं संगवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य ।
दिवा नक्तमवसा शंतमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान॥
verses.tr: utā yātaṃ saṃgave prātarahno madhyaṃdina uditā sūryasya divā naktamavasā śaṃtamena nedānīṃ pītiraśvinā tatāna
verses.en: Yea, come at milking-time, at early morning, at noon of day and when the Sun is setting, By day, by night, with favour most auspicious. Not only now the draught hath drawn the Asvins.

verses.sa:
इदं हि वां प्रदिवि स्थानमोक इमे गृहा अश्विनेदं दुरोणम् ।
आ नो दिवो बृहतः पर्वतादा ऽद्भ्यो यातमिषमूर्जं वहन्ता॥
verses.tr: idaṃ hi vāṃ pradivi sthānamoka ime gṛhā aśvinedaṃ duroṇam ā no divo bṛhataḥ parvatādā 'dbhyo yātamiṣamūrjaṃ vahantā
verses.en: For this place, Asvins, was of old your dwelling, these were your houses, this your habitation. Come to us from high heaven and from the mountain. Come from the waters bringing food and vigour.

verses.sa:
समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।
आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि॥
verses.tr: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni
verses.en: May we obtain the Asvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance. Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sa:
प्रातर्यावाणा प्रथमा यजध्वं पुरा गृध्रादररुषः पिबातः ।
प्रातर्हि यज्ञमश्विना दधाते प्र शंसन्ति कवयः पूर्वभाजः॥
verses.tr: prātaryāvāṇā prathamā yajadhvaṃ purā gṛdhrādararuṣaḥ pibātaḥ prātarhi yajñamaśvinā dadhāte pra śaṃsanti kavayaḥ pūrvabhājaḥ
verses.en: First worship those who come at early morning: let the Twain drink before the giftless niggard. The Asvins claim the sacrifice at daybreak: the sages yielding the first share extol them.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्यजध्वमश्विना हिनोत न सायमस्ति देवया अजुष्टम् ।
उतान्यो अस्मद् यजते वि चावः पूर्वःपूर्वो यजमानो वनीयान्॥
verses.tr: prātaryajadhvamaśvinā hinota na sāyamasti devayā ajuṣṭam utānyo asmad yajate vi cāvaḥ pūrvaḥpūrvo yajamāno vanīyān
verses.en: Worship at dawn and instigate the Asvins: nor is the worshipper at eve rejected. Besides ourselves another craves and worships: each first in worship is most highly favoured.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यत्वङ्मधुवर्णो घृतस्नुः पृक्षो वहन्ना रथो वर्तते वाम् ।
मनोजवा अश्विना वातरंहा येनातियाथो दुरितानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyatvaṅmadhuvarṇo ghṛtasnuḥ pṛkṣo vahannā ratho vartate vām manojavā aśvinā vātaraṃhā yenātiyātho duritāni viśvā
verses.en: Covered with gold, meath-tinted, dropping fatness, your chariot with its freight of food comes hither, Swift as thought, Asvins, rapid as the tempest, wherewith ye travel over all obstructions.

verses.sa:
यो भूयिष्ठं नासत्याभ्यां विवेष चनिष्ठं पित्वो ररते विभागे ।
स तोकमस्य पीपरच्छमीभिरनूर्ध्वभासः सदमित् तुतुर्यात्॥
verses.tr: yo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ nāsatyābhyāṃ viveṣa caniṣṭhaṃ pitvo rarate vibhāge sa tokamasya pīparacchamībhiranūrdhvabhāsaḥ sadamit tuturyāt
verses.en: He who hath served most often the Nasatyas, and gives the sweetest food at distribution, Furthers with his own holy works his offspring, and ever passes those whose flames ascend not.

verses.sa:
समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।
आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि॥
verses.tr: samaśvinoravasā nūtanena mayobhuvā supraṇītī gamema ā no rayiṃ vahatamota vīrānā viśvānyamṛtā saubhagāni
verses.en: May we obtain the Asvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance. Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sa: अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतम् । हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप॥
verses.tr: aśvināveha gacchataṃ nāsatyā mā vi venatam haṃsāviva patatamā sutāṃ upa
verses.en: Ye Asvins, hither come to us: Nasatyas, be not disinclined. Fly hither like two swans unto the juice we shed.

verses.sa: अश्विना हरिणाविव गौराविवानु यवसम् । हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप॥
verses.tr: aśvinā hariṇāviva gaurāvivānu yavasam haṃsāviva patatamā sutāṃ upa
verses.en: O Asvins, like a pair of deer, like two wild cattle to the mead: Fly hither like two swans unto the juice we shed.

verses.sa: अश्विना वाजिनीवसू जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये । हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप॥
verses.tr: aśvinā vājinīvasū juṣethāṃ yajñamiṣṭaye haṃsāviva patatamā sutāṃ upa
verses.en: O Asvins rich in gifts, accept our sacrifice to prosper it: Fly hither like two swans unto the juice we shed.

verses.sa:
अत्रिर्यद् वामवरोहन्नृबीसमजोहवीन्नाधमानेव योषा ।
श्येनस्य चिज्जवसा नूतनेना ऽऽगच्छतमश्विना शंतमेन॥
verses.tr: atriryad vāmavarohannṛbīsamajohavīnnādhamāneva yoṣā śyenasya cijjavasā nūtanenā ''gacchatamaśvinā śaṃtamena
verses.en: As Atri when descending to the cave called on you loudly like a wailing woman. Ye came to him, O Asvins, with the freshest and most auspicious fleetness of a falcon.

verses.sa: वि जिहीष्व वनस्पते योनिः सूष्यन्त्या इव । श्रुतं मे अश्विना हवं सप्तवध्रिं च मुञ्चतम्॥
verses.tr: vi jihīṣva vanaspate yoniḥ sūṣyantyā iva śrutaṃ me aśvinā havaṃ saptavadhriṃ ca muñcatam
verses.en: Tree, part asunder like the side of her who bringeth forth a child. Ye Asvins, listen to my call: loose Saptavadhri from his bonds.

verses.sa: भीताय नाधमानाय ऋषये सप्तवध्रये । मायाभिरश्विना युवं वृक्षं सं च वि चाचथः॥
verses.tr: bhītāya nādhamānāya ṛṣaye saptavadhraye māyābhiraśvinā yuvaṃ vṛkṣaṃ saṃ ca vi cācathaḥ
verses.en: For Saptavadhri, for the seer affrighted when he wept and waffled, Ye, Asvins, with your magic powers rent up the tree and shattered it.

verses.sa: यथा वातः पुष्करिणीं समिङ्गयति सर्वतः । एवा ते गर्भ एजतु निरैतु दशमास्यः॥
verses.tr: yathā vātaḥ puṣkariṇīṃ samiṅgayati sarvataḥ evā te garbha ejatu niraitu daśamāsyaḥ
verses.en: Like as the wind on every side ruffles a pool of lotuses, So stir in thee the babe unborn, so may the ten-month babe descend.

verses.sa: यथा वातो यथा वनं यथा समुद्र एजति । एवा त्वं दशमास्य सहावेहि जरायुणा॥
verses.tr: yathā vāto yathā vanaṃ yathā samudra ejati evā tvaṃ daśamāsya sahāvehi jarāyuṇā
verses.en: Like as the wind, like as the wood, like as the sea is set astir, So also, ten-month babe, descend together with the after-birth.

verses.sa: दश मासाञ्छशयानः कुमारो अधि मातरि । निरैतु जीवो अक्षतो जीवो जीवन्त्या अधि॥
verses.tr: daśa māsāñchaśayānaḥ kumāro adhi mātari niraitu jīvo akṣato jīvo jīvantyā adhi
verses.en: The child who hath for ten months' time been lying in his mother's side,- May he come forth alive, unharmed, yea, living from the living dame.

verses.sa:
महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती ।
यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī yathā cinno abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: O HEAVENLY Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence to-day Even as thou hast wakened us with Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः ।
सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: yā sunīthe śaucadrathe vyauccho duhitardivaḥ sā vyuccha sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: Daughter of Heaven, thou dawnedst on Sunitha Sucadratha's son, So dawn thou on one mightier still, on Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः ।
यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: sā no adyābharadvasurvyucchā duhitardivaḥ yo vyaucchaḥ sahīyasi satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: So, bringing treasure, dawn to-day on us thou Daughter of the Sky, As thou, O mightier yet. didst shine for Satyatravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
अभि ये त्वा विभावरि स्तोमैर्गृणन्ति वह्नयः ।
मघैर्मघोनि सुश्रियो दामन्वन्तः सुरातयः सुजात अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: abhi ye tvā vibhāvari stomairgṛṇanti vahnayaḥ maghairmaghoni suśriyo dāmanvantaḥ surātayaḥ sujāta aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: Here round about thee are the priests who laud thee, Bright One, with their hymns, And men with gifts, O Bounteous Dame, splendid with wealth and offering much, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि ते गणा इमे छदयन्ति मघत्तये ।
परि चिद् वष्टयो दधुर्ददतो राधो अह्रयं सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: yacciddhi te gaṇā ime chadayanti maghattaye pari cid vaṣṭayo dadhurdadato rādho ahrayaṃ sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: Whatever these thy bands perform to please thee or to win them wealth, E'en fain they gird us round and give rich gifts which ne'er are left away, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
ऐषु धा वीरवद् यश उषो मघोनि सूरिषु ।
ये नो राधांस्यह्रया मघवानो अरासत सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: aiṣu dhā vīravad yaśa uṣo maghoni sūriṣu ye no rādhāṃsyahrayā maghavāno arāsata sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: Give to these wealthy patrons fame, O affluent Dawn, with hero sons, To these our princes who have brought rich gifts ne'er to be left away, highborn! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
तेभ्यो द्युम्नं बृहद् यश उषो मघोन्या वह ।
ये नो राधांस्यश्व्या गव्या भजन्त सूरयः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: tebhyo dyumnaṃ bṛhad yaśa uṣo maghonyā vaha ye no rādhāṃsyaśvyā gavyā bhajanta sūrayaḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: Bring lofty and resplendent fame, O thou munificent Dawn, to these Our wealthy patrons who bestow rich gifts on us of steeds and kine, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
उत नो गोमतीरिष आ वहा दुहितर्दिवः ।
साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः शुक्रैः शोचद्भिरर्चिभिः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: uta no gomatīriṣa ā vahā duhitardivaḥ sākaṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ śukraiḥ śocadbhirarcibhiḥ sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: Bring us, O Daughter of the Sky, subsistence in our herds of kine, Together with the sunbeams, with the shine of pure refulgent flames, highborn! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवो मा चिरं तनुथा अपः ।
नेत् त्वा स्तेनं यथा रिपुं तपाति सूरो अर्चिषा सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: vyucchā duhitardivo mā ciraṃ tanuthā apaḥ net tvā stenaṃ yathā ripuṃ tapāti sūro arciṣā sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: O Daughter of the Sky, shine forth; delay not to perform thy task. Let not the Sun with fervent heat consume thee like a robber foe, high-born! delightful with the steeds!

verses.sa:
एतावद् वेदुषस्त्वं भूयो वा दातुमर्हसि ।
या स्तोतृभ्यो विभावर्युच्छन्ती न प्रमीयसे सुजाते अश्वसूनृते॥
verses.tr: etāvad veduṣastvaṃ bhūyo vā dātumarhasi yā stotṛbhyo vibhāvaryucchantī na pramīyase sujāte aśvasūnṛte
verses.en: So much, and more exceedingly, O Dawn, it suits thee to bestow, Thou Radiant One who ceasest not to shine for those who sing thy praise, highborn! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
द्युतद्यामानं बृहतीमृतेन ऋतावरीमरुणप्सुं विभातीम् ।
देवीमुषसं स्वरावहन्तीं प्रति विप्रासो मतिभिर्जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: dyutadyāmānaṃ bṛhatīmṛtena ṛtāvarīmaruṇapsuṃ vibhātīm devīmuṣasaṃ svarāvahantīṃ prati viprāso matibhirjarante
verses.en: The singers welcome with their hymns and praises the Goddess Dawn who bringeth in the sunlight, Sublime, by Law true to eternal Order, bright on her path, red-tinted, far-refulgent.

verses.sa:
एषा जनं दर्शता बोधयन्ती सुगान् पथः कृण्वती यात्यग्रे ।
बृहद्रथा बृहती विश्वमिन्वोषा ज्योतिर्यच्छत्यग्रे अह्नाम्॥
verses.tr: eṣā janaṃ darśatā bodhayantī sugān pathaḥ kṛṇvatī yātyagre bṛhadrathā bṛhatī viśvaminvoṣā jyotiryacchatyagre ahnām
verses.en: She comes in front, fair, rousing up the people, making the pathways easy to be travelled. High, on her lofty chariot, all-impelling, Dawn gives her splendour at the days' beginning.

verses.sa:
एषा गोभिररुणेभिर्युजाना ऽस्रेधन्ती रयिमप्रायु चक्रे ।
पथो रदन्ती सुविताय देवी पुरुष्टुता विश्ववारा वि भाति॥
verses.tr: eṣā gobhiraruṇebhiryujānā 'sredhantī rayimaprāyu cakre patho radantī suvitāya devī puruṣṭutā viśvavārā vi bhāti
verses.en: She, harnessing her car with purple oxen. injuring none, hath brought perpetual riches. Opening paths to happiness, the Goddess shines, praised by all, giver of every blessing.

verses.sa:
एषा व्येनी भवति द्विबर्हा आविष्कृण्वाना तन्वं पुरस्तात् ।
ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेति साधु प्रजानतीव न दिशो मिनाति॥
verses.tr: eṣā vyenī bhavati dvibarhā āviṣkṛṇvānā tanvaṃ purastāt ṛtasya panthāmanveti sādhu prajānatīva na diśo mināti
verses.en: With changing tints she gleams in double splendour while from the eastward she displays her body. She travels perfectly the path of Order, nor fails to reach, as one who knows, the quarters.

verses.sa:
एषा शुभ्रा न तन्वो विदानोर्ध्वेव स्नाती दृशये नो अस्थात् ।
अप द्वेषो बाधमाना तमांस्युषा दिवो दुहिता ज्योतिषागात्॥
verses.tr: eṣā śubhrā na tanvo vidānordhveva snātī dṛśaye no asthāt apa dveṣo bādhamānā tamāṃsyuṣā divo duhitā jyotiṣāgāt
verses.en: As conscious that her limbs are bright with bathing, she stands, as 'twere, erect that we may see her. Driving away malignity and darkness, Dawn, Child of Heaven, hath come to us with lustre.

verses.sa:
एषा प्रतीची दुहिता दिवो नॄन् योषेव भद्रा नि रिणीते अप्सः ।
व्यूर्ण्वती दाशुषे वार्याणि पुनर्ज्योतिर्युवतिः पूर्वथाकः॥
verses.tr: eṣā pratīcī duhitā divo nṝn yoṣeva bhadrā ni riṇīte apsaḥ vyūrṇvatī dāśuṣe vāryāṇi punarjyotiryuvatiḥ pūrvathākaḥ
verses.en: The Daughter of the Sky, like some chaste woman, bends, opposite to men, her forehead downward. The Maid, disclosing boons to him who worships, hath brought again the daylight as aforetime.

verses.sa:
युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः ।
वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः॥
verses.tr: yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ
verses.en: The priests of him the lofty Priest well-skilled in hymns harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only knowing works assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.

verses.sa:
विश्वा रूपाणि प्रति मुञ्चते कविः प्रासावीद् भद्रं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ।
वि नाकमख्यत् सविता वरेण्योऽनु प्रयाणमुषसो वि राजति॥
verses.tr: viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīd bhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade vi nākamakhyat savitā vareṇyo'nu prayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati
verses.en: The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault, and shineth after the outgoing of the Dawn.

verses.sa:
यस्य प्रयाणमन्वन्य इद् ययुर्देवा देवस्य महिमानमोजसा ।
यः पार्थिवानि विममे स एतशो रजांसि देवः सविता महित्वना॥
verses.tr: yasya prayāṇamanvanya id yayurdevā devasya mahimānamojasā yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṃsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā
verses.en: Even he, the God whose going-forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the terrestrial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.

verses.sa:
उत यासि सवितस्त्रीणि रोचनोत सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः समुच्यसि ।
उत रात्रीमुभयतः परीयस उत मित्रो भवसि देव धर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: uta yāsi savitastrīṇi rocanota sūryasya raśmibhiḥ samucyasi uta rātrīmubhayataḥ parīyasa uta mitro bhavasi deva dharmabhiḥ
verses.en: To the three spheres of light thou goest, Savitar, and with the rays of Sidrya thou combinest thee. Around, on both sides thou encompassest the night: yea, thou, O God, art Mitra through thy righteous laws.

verses.sa:
उतेशिषे प्रसवस्य त्वमेक इदुत पूषा भवसि देव यामभिः ।
उतेदं विश्वं भुवनं वि राजसि श्यावाश्वस्ते सवित स्तोममानशे॥
verses.tr: uteśiṣe prasavasya tvameka iduta pūṣā bhavasi deva yāmabhiḥ utedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi rājasi śyāvāśvaste savita stomamānaśe
verses.en: Over all generation thou art Lord alone: Pusan art thou, O God, in all thy goings-forth. Yea, thou hast domination over all this world. Syavasva hath brought praise to thee, O Savitar,

verses.sa: तत् सवितुर्वृणीमहे वयं देवस्य भोजनम् । श्रेष्ठं सर्वधातमं तुरं भगस्य धीमहि॥
verses.tr: tat saviturvṛṇīmahe vayaṃ devasya bhojanam śreṣṭhaṃ sarvadhātamaṃ turaṃ bhagasya dhīmahi
verses.en: We crave of Savitar the God this treasure much to be enjoyed. The best, all-yielding, conquering gift of Bhaga we would gladly win.

verses.sa: अस्य हि स्वयशस्तरं सवितुः कच्चन प्रियम् । न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम्॥
verses.tr: asya hi svayaśastaraṃ savituḥ kaccana priyam na minanti svarājyam
verses.en: Savitar's own supremacy, most glorious and beloved of all, No one diminisheth in aught.

verses.sa: स हि रत्नानि दाशुषे सुवाति सविता भगः । तं भागं चित्रमीमहे॥
verses.tr: sa hi ratnāni dāśuṣe suvāti savitā bhagaḥ taṃ bhāgaṃ citramīmahe
verses.en: For Savitar who is Bhaga shall send riches to his worshipper. That wondrous portion we implore.

verses.sa: अद्या नो देव सवितः प्रजावत् सावीः सौभगम् । परा दुष्ष्वप्न्यं सुव॥
verses.tr: adyā no deva savitaḥ prajāvat sāvīḥ saubhagam parā duṣṣvapnyaṃ suva
verses.en: Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny. Drive thou the evil dream away.

verses.sa: विश्वानि देव सवितर्दुरितानि परा सुव । यद् भद्रं तन्न आ सुव॥
verses.tr: viśvāni deva savitarduritāni parā suva yad bhadraṃ tanna ā suva
verses.en: Savitar, God, send far away all sorrows and calamities, And send us only what is good.

verses.sa: अनागसो अदितये देवस्य सवितुः सवे । विश्वा वामानि धीमहि॥
verses.tr: anāgaso aditaye devasya savituḥ save viśvā vāmāni dhīmahi
verses.en: Sinless in sight of Aditi through the God Savitar's influence, May we obtain all lovely things.

verses.sa: आ विश्वदेवं सत्पतिं सूक्तैरद्या वृणीमहे । सत्यसवं सवितारम्॥
verses.tr: ā viśvadevaṃ satpatiṃ sūktairadyā vṛṇīmahe satyasavaṃ savitāram
verses.en: We with our hymns this day elect the general God, Lord of the good, Savitar whose decrees are true.

verses.sa: य इमे उभे अहनी पुर एत्यप्रयुच्छन् । स्वाधीर्देवः सविता॥
verses.tr: ya ime ubhe ahanī pura etyaprayucchan svādhīrdevaḥ savitā
verses.en: He who for ever vigilant precedes these Twain, the Day and Night, Is Savitar the thoughtful God.

verses.sa: य इमा विश्वा जातान्याश्रावयति श्लोकेन । प्र च सुवाति सविता॥
verses.tr: ya imā viśvā jātānyāśrāvayati ślokena pra ca suvāti savitā
verses.en: He who gives glory unto all these living creatures with the song, And brings them forth, is Savitar.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वद तवसं गीर्भिराभिः स्तुहि पर्जन्यं नमसा विवास ।
कनिक्रदद् वृषभो जीरदानू रेतो दधात्योषधीषु गर्भम्॥
verses.tr: acchā vada tavasaṃ gīrbhirābhiḥ stuhi parjanyaṃ namasā vivāsa kanikradad vṛṣabho jīradānū reto dadhātyoṣadhīṣu garbham
verses.en: Sing with these songs thy welcome to the Mighty, with adoration praise and call Parjanya. The Bull, loud roaring, swift to send his bounty, lays in the plants the seed. for germination.

verses.sa:
वि वृक्षान् हन्त्युत हन्ति रक्षसो विश्वं बिभाय भुवनं महावधात् ।
उतानागा ईषते वृष्ण्यावतो यत् पर्जन्यः स्तनयन्हन्ति दुष्कृतः॥
verses.tr: vi vṛkṣān hantyuta hanti rakṣaso viśvaṃ bibhāya bhuvanaṃ mahāvadhāt utānāgā īṣate vṛṣṇyāvato yat parjanyaḥ stanayanhanti duṣkṛtaḥ
verses.en: He smites the trees apart, he slays the demons: all life fears him who wields the mighty weapon. From him exceeding strong faces e'en the guiltless, when thundering Parjanya smites the wicked.

verses.sa:
रथीव कशयाश्वाँ अभिक्षिपन्नाविर्दूतान् कृणुते वर्ष्याँ३ अह ।
दूरात् सिंहस्य स्तनथा उदीरते यत् पर्जन्यः कृणुते वर्ष्यं१ नभः॥
verses.tr: rathīva kaśayāśvāṃ abhikṣipannāvirdūtān kṛṇute varṣyāṃ3 aha dūrāt siṃhasya stanathā udīrate yat parjanyaḥ kṛṇute varṣyaṃ1 nabhaḥ
verses.en: Like a car-driver whipping on his horses, he makes the messengers of rain spring forward. Far off resounds the roaring of the lion, what time Parjanya fills the sky with rain-cloud.

verses.sa:
प्र वाता वान्ति पतयन्ति विद्युत उदोषधीर्जिहते पिन्वते स्वः ।
इरा विश्वस्मै भुवनाय जायते यत् पर्जन्यः पृथिवीं रेतसावति॥
verses.tr: pra vātā vānti patayanti vidyuta udoṣadhīrjihate pinvate svaḥ irā viśvasmai bhuvanāya jāyate yat parjanyaḥ pṛthivīṃ retasāvati
verses.en: Forth burst the winds, down come the lightning-flashes: the plants shoot up, the realm of light is streaming. Food springs abundant for all living creatures, what time Parjanya quickens earth with moisture.

verses.sa:
यस्य व्रते पृथिवी नन्नमीति यस्य व्रते शफवज्जर्भुरीति ।
यस्य व्रत ओषधीर्विश्वरूपाः स नः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ॥
verses.tr: yasya vrate pṛthivī nannamīti yasya vrate śaphavajjarbhurīti yasya vrata oṣadhīrviśvarūpāḥ sa naḥ parjanya mahi śarma yaccha
verses.en: Thou at whose bidding earth bows low before thee, at whose command hoofed cattle fly in terror, At whose behest the plants assume all colours, even thou Parjanya, yield us great protection.

verses.sa:
दिवो नो वृष्टिं मरुतो ररीध्वं प्र पिन्वत वृष्णो अश्वस्य धाराः ।
अर्वाङेतेन स्तनयित्नुनेह्यपो निषिञ्चन्नसुरः पिता नः॥
verses.tr: divo no vṛṣṭiṃ maruto rarīdhvaṃ pra pinvata vṛṣṇo aśvasya dhārāḥ arvāṅetena stanayitnunehyapo niṣiñcannasuraḥ pitā naḥ
verses.en: Send down for us the rain of heaven, ye Maruts, and let the Stallion's flood descend in torrents. Come hither with this thunder while thou pourest the waters down, our heavenly Lord and Father.

verses.sa:
अभि क्रन्द स्तनय गर्भमा धा उदन्वता परि दीया रथेन ।
दृतिं सु कर्ष विषितं न्यञ्चं समा भवन्तूद्वतो निपादाः॥
verses.tr: abhi kranda stanaya garbhamā dhā udanvatā pari dīyā rathena dṛtiṃ su karṣa viṣitaṃ nyañcaṃ samā bhavantūdvato nipādāḥ
verses.en: Thunder and roar: the germ of life deposit. Fly round us on thy chariot waterladen. Thine opened water-skin draw with thee downward, and let the hollows and the heights be level.

verses.sa:
महान्तं कोशमुदचा नि षिञ्च स्यन्दन्तां कुल्या विषिताः पुरस्तात् ।
घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी व्युन्धि सुप्रपाणं भवत्वघ्न्याभ्यः॥
verses.tr: mahāntaṃ kośamudacā ni ṣiñca syandantāṃ kulyā viṣitāḥ purastāt ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī vyundhi suprapāṇaṃ bhavatvaghnyābhyaḥ
verses.en: Lift up the mighty vessel, pour down water, and let the liberated streams rush forward. Saturate both the earth and heaven with fatness, and for the cows let there be drink abundant.

verses.sa:
यत् पर्जन्य कनिक्रदत् स्तनयन्हंसि दुष्कृतः ।
प्रतीदं विश्वं मोदते यत् किं च पृथिव्यामधि॥
verses.tr: yat parjanya kanikradat stanayanhaṃsi duṣkṛtaḥ pratīdaṃ viśvaṃ modate yat kiṃ ca pṛthivyāmadhi
verses.en: When thou, with thunder and with roar, Parjanya, smitest sinners down, This universe exults thereat, yea, all that is upon the earth.

verses.sa:
अवर्षीर्वर्षमुदु षू गृभायाऽकर्धन्वान्यत्येतवा उ ।
अजीजन ओषधीर्भोजनाय कमुत प्रजाभ्योऽविदो मनीषाम्॥
verses.tr: avarṣīrvarṣamudu ṣū gṛbhāyā'kardhanvānyatyetavā u ajījana oṣadhīrbhojanāya kamuta prajābhyo'vido manīṣām
verses.en: Thou hast poured down the rain-flood now withhold it. Thou hast made desert places fit for travel. Thou hast made herbs to grow for our enjoyment: yea, thou hast won thee praise from living creatures.

verses.sa: बळित्था पर्वतानां खिद्रं बिभर्षि पृथिवि । प्र या भूमिं प्रवत्वति मह्ना जिनोषि महिनि॥
verses.tr: baḻitthā parvatānāṃ khidraṃ bibharṣi pṛthivi pra yā bhūmiṃ pravatvati mahnā jinoṣi mahini
verses.en: Thou, of a truth, O Prthivi, bearest the tool that rends the hills: Thou rich in torrents, who with might quickenest earth, O Mighty One.

verses.sa: स्तोमासस्त्वा विचारिणि प्रति ष्टोभन्त्यक्तुभिः । प्र या वाजं न हेषन्तं पेरुमस्यस्यर्जुनि॥
verses.tr: stomāsastvā vicāriṇi prati ṣṭobhantyaktubhiḥ pra yā vājaṃ na heṣantaṃ perumasyasyarjuni
verses.en: To thee, O wanderer at will, ring out the lauds with beams of day, Who drivest, like a neighing steed, the swelling cloud, O bright of hue.

verses.sa: दृळहा चिद् या वनस्पतीन् क्ष्मया दर्धर्ष्योजसा । यत् ते अभ्रस्य विद्युतो दिवो वर्षन्ति वृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: dṛḻahā cid yā vanaspatīn kṣmayā dardharṣyojasā yat te abhrasya vidyuto divo varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: Who graspest with thy might on earth. e'en the strong sovrans of the wood, When from the lightning of thy cloud the rain-floods of the heaven descend.

verses.sa:
प्र सम्राजे बृहदर्चा गभीरं ब्रह्म प्रियं वरुणाय श्रुताय ।
वि यो जघान शमितेव चर्मोपस्तिरे पृथिवीं सूर्याय॥
verses.tr: pra samrāje bṛhadarcā gabhīraṃ brahma priyaṃ varuṇāya śrutāya vi yo jaghāna śamiteva carmopastire pṛthivīṃ sūryāya
verses.en: Sing forth a hymn sublime and solemn, grateful to glorious. Varuna, imperial Ruler, Who hath struck out, like one who slays the victim, earth as a skin to spread in front of Surya.

verses.sa:
वनेषु व्य१न्तरिक्षं ततान वाजमर्वत्सु पय उस्रियासु ।
हृत्सु क्रतुं वरुणो अप्स्व१ग्निं दिवि सूर्यमदधात् सोममद्रौ॥
verses.tr: vaneṣu vya1ntarikṣaṃ tatāna vājamarvatsu paya usriyāsu hṛtsu kratuṃ varuṇo apsva1gniṃ divi sūryamadadhāt somamadrau
verses.en: In the tree-tops the air he hath extended, put milk in kine and vigorous speed in horses, Set intellect in hearts, fire in the waters, Surya in heaven and Soma on the mountain.

verses.sa:
नीचीनबारं वरुणः कवन्धं प्र ससर्ज रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
तेन विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा यवं न वृष्टिर्व्युनत्ति भूम॥
verses.tr: nīcīnabāraṃ varuṇaḥ kavandhaṃ pra sasarja rodasī antarikṣam tena viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā yavaṃ na vṛṣṭirvyunatti bhūma
verses.en: Varuna lets the big cask, opening downward, flow through the heaven and earth and air's mid-region. Therewith the universe's Sovran waters earth as the shower of rain bedews the barley.

verses.sa:
उनत्ति भूमिं पृथिवीमुत द्यां यदा दुग्धं वरुणो वष्ट्यादित् ।
समभ्रेण वसत पर्वतासस्तविषीयन्तः श्रथयन्त वीराः॥
verses.tr: unatti bhūmiṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ yadā dugdhaṃ varuṇo vaṣṭyādit samabhreṇa vasata parvatāsastaviṣīyantaḥ śrathayanta vīrāḥ
verses.en: When Varuna is fain for milk he moistens the sky, the land, and earth to her foundation. Then straight the mountains clothe them in the rain-cloud: the Heroes, putting forth their vigour, loose them.

verses.sa:
इमामू ष्वासुरस्य श्रुतस्य महीं मायां वरुणस्य प्र वोचम् ।
मानेनेव तस्थिवाँ अन्तरिक्षे वि यो ममे पृथिवीं सूर्येण॥
verses.tr: imāmū ṣvāsurasya śrutasya mahīṃ māyāṃ varuṇasya pra vocam māneneva tasthivāṃ antarikṣe vi yo mame pṛthivīṃ sūryeṇa
verses.en: I will declare this mighty deed of magic, of glorious Varuna the Lord Immortal, Who standing in the firmament hath meted the earth out with the Sun as with a measure.

verses.sa:
इमामू नु कवितमस्य मायां महीं देवस्य नकिरा दधर्ष ।
एकं यदुद्ना न पृणन्त्येनीरासिञ्चन्तीरवनयः समुद्रम्॥
verses.tr: imāmū nu kavitamasya māyāṃ mahīṃ devasya nakirā dadharṣa ekaṃ yadudnā na pṛṇantyenīrāsiñcantīravanayaḥ samudram
verses.en: None, verily, hath ever let or hindered this the most wise God's mighty deed of magic, Whereby with all their flood, the lucid rivers fill not one sea wherein they pour their waters.

verses.sa:
अर्यम्यं वरुण मित्र्यं वा सखायं वा सदमिद् भ्रातरं वा ।
वेशं वा नित्यं वरुणारणं वा यत् सीमागश्चकृमा शिश्रथस्तत्॥
verses.tr: aryamyaṃ varuṇa mitryaṃ vā sakhāyaṃ vā sadamid bhrātaraṃ vā veśaṃ vā nityaṃ varuṇāraṇaṃ vā yat sīmāgaścakṛmā śiśrathastat
verses.en: If we have sinned against the man who loves us, have ever wronged a brother, friend, or comrade, The neighbour ever with us, or a stranger, O Varuna, remove from us the trespass.

verses.sa:
कितवासो यद् रिरिपुर्न दीवि यद् वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म ।
सर्वा ता वि ष्य शिथिरेव देवाऽधा ते स्याम वरुण प्रियासः॥
verses.tr: kitavāso yad riripurna dīvi yad vā ghā satyamuta yanna vidma sarvā tā vi ṣya śithireva devā'dhā te syāma varuṇa priyāsaḥ
verses.en: If we, as gamesters cheat at play, have cheated, done wrong unwittingly or sinned of purpose, Cast all these sins away like loosened fetters, and, Varuna let us be thine own beloved.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी यमवथ उभा वाजेषु मर्त्यम् । दृळहा चित् स प्र भेदति द्युम्ना वाणीरिव त्रितः॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī yamavatha ubhā vājeṣu martyam dṛḻahā cit sa pra bhedati dyumnā vāṇīriva tritaḥ
verses.en: The mortal man whom ye, the Twain, Indra and Agni, help in fight, Breaks through e'en strongly-guarded wealth as Trta burst his way through reeds.

verses.sa: या पृतनासु दुष्टरा या वाजेषु श्रवाय्या । या पञ्च चर्षणीरभीन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yā pṛtanāsu duṣṭarā yā vājeṣu śravāyyā yā pañca carṣaṇīrabhīndrāgnī tā havāmahe
verses.en: The Twain invincible in war, worthy to be renowned in frays, Lords of the Fivefold. People, these, Indra and Agni, we invoke.

verses.sa: तयोरिदमवच्छवस्तिग्मा दिद्युन्मघोनोः । प्रति द्रुणा गभस्त्योर्गवां वृत्रघ्न एषते॥
verses.tr: tayoridamavacchavastigmā didyunmaghonoḥ prati druṇā gabhastyorgavāṃ vṛtraghna eṣate
verses.en: Impetuous is their strength, and keen the lightning of the mighty Pair, Which from their arms speeds with the car to Vrtra's slayer for the kine.

verses.sa: ता वामेषे रथानामिन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । पती तुरस्य राधसो विद्वांसा गिर्वणस्तमा॥
verses.tr: tā vāmeṣe rathānāmindrāgnī havāmahe patī turasya rādhaso vidvāṃsā girvaṇastamā
verses.en: Indra and Agni, we invoke you both, as such, to send your cars: Lords of quick-coming bounty, ye who know, chief lovers of the song.

verses.sa: ता वृधन्तावनु द्यून् मर्ताय देवावदभा । अर्हन्ता चित् पुरो दधेंऽशेव देवावर्वते॥
verses.tr: tā vṛdhantāvanu dyūn martāya devāvadabhā arhantā cit puro dadheṃ'śeva devāvarvate
verses.en: These who give increase day by day, Gods without guile for mortal man, Worthy themselves, I honour most, Two Gods as partners, for my horse.

verses.sa:
एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यामहावि हव्यं शूष्यं घृतं न पूतमद्रिभिः ।
ता सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्रयिं गृणत्सु दिधृतमिषं गृणत्सु दिधृतम्॥
verses.tr: evendrāgnibhyāmahāvi havyaṃ śūṣyaṃ ghṛtaṃ na pūtamadribhiḥ tā sūriṣu śravo bṛhadrayiṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtamiṣaṃ gṛṇatsu didhṛtam
verses.en: The strength-bestowing offering thus to Indra-Agni hath been paid, as butter, purified by stones. Deal to our princes high renown, deal wealth to those who sing your praise, deal food to those who sing your praise.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे मतयो यन्तु विष्णवे मरुत्वते गिरिजा एवयामरुत् ।
प्र शर्धाय प्रयज्यवे सुखादये तवसे भन्ददिष्टये धुनिव्रताय शवसे॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut pra śardhāya prayajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase
verses.en: To Visnu, to the Mighty whom the Maruts follow let your hymns born in song go forth, Evayamarut; To the impetuous, strong band, adorned with bracelets, that rushes on in joy and ever roars for vigour.

verses.sa:
प्र ये जाता महिना ये च नु स्वयं प्र विद्मना ब्रुवत एवयामरुत् ।
क्रत्वा तद् वो मरुतो नाधृषे शवो दाना मह्ना तदेषामधृष्टासो नाद्रयः॥
verses.tr: pra ye jātā mahinā ye ca nu svayaṃ pra vidmanā bruvata evayāmarut kratvā tad vo maruto nādhṛṣe śavo dānā mahnā tadeṣāmadhṛṣṭāso nādrayaḥ
verses.en: They who with might were manifest, and who willingly by their own knowledge told it forth, Evayamarut. Maruts, this strength of yours no wisdom comprehendeth: through their gifts' greatness they are moveless as the mountains.

verses.sa:
प्र ये दिवो बृहतः शृण्विरे गिरा सुशुक्वानः सुभ्व एवयामरुत् ।
न येषामिरी सधस्थ ईष्ट आँ अग्नयो न स्वविद्युतः प्र स्यन्द्रासो धुनीनाम्॥
verses.tr: pra ye divo bṛhataḥ śṛṇvire girā suśukvānaḥ subhva evayāmarut na yeṣāmirī sadhastha īṣṭa āṃ agnayo na svavidyutaḥ pra syandrāso dhunīnām
verses.en: Who by the psalm they sing are heard, from lofty heaven, the strong, the brightly shining Ones, Evayamarut; In whose abode there is no mightier one to move them, whose lightnings are as fires, who urge the roaring rivers.

verses.sa:
स चक्रमे महतो निरुरुक्रमः समानस्मात् सदस एवयामरुत् ।
यदायुक्त त्मना स्वादधि ष्णुभिर्विष्पर्धसो विमहसो जिगाति शेवृधो नृभिः॥
verses.tr: sa cakrame mahato nirurukramaḥ samānasmāt sadasa evayāmarut yadāyukta tmanā svādadhi ṣṇubhirviṣpardhaso vimahaso jigāti śevṛdho nṛbhiḥ
verses.en: He of the Mighty Stride forth strode, Evayamarut, out of the spacious dwelling-place, their home in common. When he, himself, hath yoked his emulous strong horses on heights, he cometh forth, joy-giving, with the Heroes.

verses.sa:
स्वनो न वोऽमवान् रेजयद् वृषा त्वेषो ययिस्तविष एवयामरुत् ।
येना सहन्त ऋञ्जत स्वरोचिषः स्थारश्मानो हिरण्ययाः स्वायुधास इष्मिणः॥
verses.tr: svano na vo'mavān rejayad vṛṣā tveṣo yayistaviṣa evayāmarut yenā sahanta ṛñjata svarociṣaḥ sthāraśmāno hiraṇyayāḥ svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ
verses.en: Like your tremendous roar, the rainer with light flashing, strong, speeding, hath made all tremble, Evayamarut, Wherewith victorious ye, self-luminous, press onward, with strong reins, decked with gold, impetuous and well-weaponed.

verses.sa:
अपारो वो महिमा वृद्धशवसस्त्वेषं शवोऽवत्वेवयामरुत् ।
स्थातारो हि प्रसितौ संदृशि स्थन ते न उरुष्यता निदः शुशुक्वांसो नाग्नयः॥
verses.tr: apāro vo mahimā vṛddhaśavasastveṣaṃ śavo'vatvevayāmarut sthātāro hi prasitau saṃdṛśi sthana te na uruṣyatā nidaḥ śuśukvāṃso nāgnayaḥ
verses.en: Unbounded is your greatness, ye of mighty power: may your bright vigour be our aid, Evayamarut; For ye are visible helpers in the time of trouble: like fires, aglow with light, save us from shame and insult.

verses.sa:
ते रुद्रासः सुमखा अग्नयो यथा तुविद्युम्ना अवन्त्वेवयामरुत् ।
दीर्घं पृथु पप्रथे सद्म पार्थिवं येषामज्मेष्वा महः शर्धांस्यद्भुतैनसाम्॥
verses.tr: te rudrāsaḥ sumakhā agnayo yathā tuvidyumnā avantvevayāmarut dīrghaṃ pṛthu paprathe sadma pārthivaṃ yeṣāmajmeṣvā mahaḥ śardhāṃsyadbhutainasām
verses.en: So may the Rudras, mighty warriors, Evayamarut, with splendid brilliancy, like fires, be our protectors; They whose terrestrial dwelling-place is wide-extended, whom none suspect of sin, whose bands have lofty courage.

verses.sa:
अद्वेषो नो मरुतो गातुमेतन श्रोता हवं जरितुरेवयामरुत् ।
विष्णोर्महः समन्यवो युयोतन स्मद् रथ्यो३ न दंसना ऽप द्वेषांसि सनुतः॥
verses.tr: adveṣo no maruto gātumetana śrotā havaṃ jariturevayāmarut viṣṇormahaḥ samanyavo yuyotana smad rathyo3 na daṃsanā 'pa dveṣāṃsi sanutaḥ
verses.en: Come in a friendly spirit, come to us, O Maruts, and hear his call who praises you, Evayamarut. Like car-borne men, one-minded with the mighty Visnu, keep enmity far from us with your deeds of wonder.

verses.sa:
गन्ता नो यज्ञं यज्ञियाः सुशमि श्रोता हवमरक्ष एवयामरुत् ।
ज्येष्ठासो न पर्वतासो व्योमनि यूयं तस्य प्रचेतसः स्यात दुर्धर्तवो निदः॥
verses.tr: gantā no yajñaṃ yajñiyāḥ suśami śrotā havamarakṣa evayāmarut jyeṣṭhāso na parvatāso vyomani yūyaṃ tasya pracetasaḥ syāta durdhartavo nidaḥ
verses.en: Come to our sacrifice, ye Hnly Ones, to bless it, and, free from demons, hear our call, Evayamarut.
